wikidata-Q20819142.caption: From a rooftop terrace at the lower right, Juliet and her nurse overlook a crowded Venetian square. Fireworks light the sky beyond the domes and bell tower.

artic-100829.caption: White magnolia blossoms and glossy leaves rest on folds of blue-green velvet. Heade gives the petals a smooth, almost waxy finish, setting their pale curves against the darker cloth and plain brown background.

artic-111442.caption: A woman supports a child on her lap and washes one small foot in a basin. Their lowered faces draw close together, while the striped dress, patterned carpet and painted furniture fill the room with interlocking shapes.

artic-14572.caption: A milliner studies an orange-brown hat in her hands, surrounded by displays of pink, cream, green and blue headwear. Loose strokes build the shop around her sober olive dress.

artic-14620.caption: Two young women walk along the flowered cliff at Pourville, one beneath a red parasol. The headland cuts into a blue-green sea dotted with small sailboats.

artic-14655.caption: A young woman in a red hat sits beside a little girl on a riverside terrace. Despite the title, the models were not sisters; Renoir links them through bright touches of colour that reappear in the basket of yarn and the shimmering foliage.

artic-15468.caption: An armoured saint on a rearing white horse holds his lance high, its point hanging down by the horse's chest above a winged dragon that sprawls across the foreground, jaws open and one clawed foot reaching up at his stirrup. Gold tooling picks out his halo and the horse's harness. Behind, townspeople crowd a grey castle's walls, and a crowned young woman in pink raises her hands beside a sheep.

artic-16146.caption: A circus rider balances on a cantering white horse as she prepares to rise and leap through a paper hoop held in the foreground. Sketchy pastel and charcoal strokes keep horse, rider and ring in motion.

artic-16298.caption: A man seen to the waist turns towards the left, eyes looking aside, his raised hands pressed together palm to palm with a ring on one finger. He has dark hair cut in a straight fringe and wears a black gown trimmed with fur at the neck and cuff, over a red collar and a white undershirt. The background is a plain dark blue.
artic-16298.artist: Rogier van der Weyden and workshop

artic-16327.caption: Gabriel kneels at the left in a green robe over a pale blue-grey gown, one hand raised and a gold sceptre in the other. Mary kneels at a wooden desk with an open book, in a blue dress and red mantle; her right hand is raised, palm out, and her left is held lower, open, above the book. A white dove in a soft glow flies between them. A marbled column, an arched vault and a red-curtained bed fill the room around them.

artic-234781.caption: Christ, crowned with thorns and dressed in pale blue, leans his head against the cross with his eyes nearly shut, both hands gripping the beam. Behind him crowd a young man and a man in a steel helmet. Beyond, at upper right, tiny figures and riders cross a dim landscape below a distant city and a reddish sky.

artic-23972.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress under a blue and green mantle, looks down at the Christ Child sitting on her knee with one small hand raised. The young Saint John kneels beside her, bare-backed, with a band of fur at his waist and a blue cloth round his legs; her hand rests at his back. On one side a wooden lattice is hung with leaves and pale fruit; on the other, trees and blue mountains.

artic-27310.caption: The infant Christ reaches up to touch Mary’s face as she supports his bare body on her lap. Joseph and Elizabeth lean into the group, while the young John approaches beside a lamb; their linked gestures make the sacred gathering feel intimate.

artic-4081.caption: A black-clad nobleman stands full-length with a white-and-brown dog beside him. The checkerboard floor and crisp white collar sharpen a sombre arrangement of velvet, stone and dark drapery.

artic-43145.caption: A procession winds below a cliffside temple bathed in warm late light. Claude restores ancient Delphi to imagined grandeur, using atmospheric distance to soften the hills beyond.

artic-4758.caption: A church tower rises beyond a sunlit village, while a cart stands in the shady lane beneath spreading trees. Constable’s broken white highlights flicker across sky and ground, giving the rough paint surface the sparkle of a landscape still wet after rain.

artic-5848.caption: Saint John writes among fragments of ancient stone, with an eagle just behind him. Beyond this small foreground scene, Poussin arranges trees, an obelisk, a temple and distant hills into a landscape of measured intervals and clear, steady light.

artic-59847.caption: Mars raises a knotted cord over the blindfolded Cupid while Venus reaches across to restrain him. Cupid’s wings spread beneath his body; a bow, arrows and helmet lie on the ground as doves fly away at the upper right.

artic-61128.caption: Regulars crowd a cropped table at the Moulin Rouge while singer May Milton’s face enters from the right edge in acid green light. Off-centre figures, mirrors and empty floor keep the nightclub space unsettled.

artic-65916.caption: Bold black outlines bind red, orange, blue and white forms around several circular shapes. Hartley’s thick paint and compressed rhythm evoke the energy of modern Berlin and music without resolving into a single scene.

artic-80530.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle and a transparent veil, holds the Child against her cheek as he reaches round her neck and looks up at her. At the left a smaller angel with joined hands looks up at them, beside a metal vase. Behind, an arched opening shows hills and trees under a pale sky.

artic-8991.caption: Broad planes of blue, red and gold surge around two black cannon barrels at lower right. Kandinsky frees colour and line from ordinary description, leaving the martial forms suspended at the edge of abstraction.

artic-97910.caption: A wounded cavalry scout slumps over his horse while the troops behind him flee an unseen ambush. Remington's crisp desert light and taut, muscular horses charge the scene with narrative tension.

cleveland-102578.caption: A deep blue, fur-lined gown pools across the floor as Dora Wheeler rests against a carved chair. Chase sets her against the embroidered silk tapestry she designed, with a porcelain vase and yellow flowers beside her.

cleveland-110180.caption: A skeleton, standing for Death, rides a pale horse at full gallop to the left around the fenced curve of an empty racecourse, raising a long curved scythe. A snake rears its head in the dark foreground at lower left, and a bare, dead tree stands by the rail at right. Heavy dark clouds hang over low hills beyond.

cleveland-117808.caption: The Medicine Master Buddha sits in the upper centre before a large halo, above a tall tiered pedestal, one hand raised and the other resting palm-up in his lap around a small dark shape. Two pale-faced attendants stand beside the pedestal, and armoured generals, far smaller than the Buddha and several red-faced, gather at both sides and along the bottom of the dark ground; inscribed panels fill the two top corners.

cleveland-127571.caption: A richly dressed gentleman sits at an outdoor table and points beyond the frame, his other hand resting on a sheet of paper beside clover and jasmine. A gold chain and sword advertise his status beneath a stormy blue sky.

cleveland-128842.caption: Peter sits with clasped hands beside a rooster, recalling his denial of Christ before the bird crowed. The lantern at his feet lights his face, fingers and robe, drawing a small circle of warmth within the dark room.

cleveland-135428.caption: Courtiers and dogs drive stags across a river toward Saxony's rulers, with Hartenfels Castle on the horizon. Cranach packs the elaborate hunt into a dense forest panorama filled with tiny, vivid incidents.

cleveland-135592.caption: A dragon claws through clouds above rough waves on one screen while a tiger sits in a wind-whipped bamboo grove on the other. Swirling ink washes bind the paired creatures into a turbulent exchange.

cleveland-142559.caption: Saint Catherine appears twice in this small panel: on the right she gives her cloak to a beggar; on the left, Christ returns it to her. Giovanni di Paolo brings successive moments of the story together within one architectural setting.

cleveland-144961.caption: A green-skinned goddess sits on a lotus seat in the red, arched niche of a tiered shrine, one foot stepping down onto a small pink lotus. Rearing beasts standing on elephants flank her throne, a tiny figure with joined hands sits by her lowered hand, and leafy trees and three white domes with gold spires crown the shrine against a dark ground.

cleveland-144966.caption: Inside a round frame, the Virgin, under a sheer veil, bends her head until her cheek rests against the Child's brow, as she holds him upright on her lap. He reaches one arm across to rest his hand at the base of her neck. At left the young Baptist, in a red cloak, looks up with his hands pressed together, a thin cross on a long staff beside him. Green hills rise on both sides under a pale blue sky.

cleveland-145463.caption: Danaë reclines on white and gold sheets, reaching toward the shower of gold in which Jupiter enters her chamber, while a winged attendant lifts the dark curtain. Dramatic light makes the figures tangible against the deep shadow.

cleveland-148301.caption: An old bearded man in a red robe sits in a wooden chair at the left, writing on a sheet of paper with a pen. Next to him a young woman in dark green, low on the floor, holds out a newborn on a white cloth. Behind them a woman lies in a bed hung with green curtains, and at the right another woman holding a dish stands in front of a carved wooden structure with an open door.

cleveland-149112.caption: A bird's-eye view of Lower Manhattan reduces buildings, tracks and the passing Church Street elevated train to flat planes of salmon, cream and black. Sheeler concentrates the city into a rhythmic pattern of shape, colour, light and shadow.

cleveland-152440.caption: The Hell Courtesan turns before a folding screen, her richly patterned robes spilling across the floor. Kyōsai fills the garment with figures from the Seven Gods of Good Fortune and the court of Enma, making the costume itself carry a second, intricate story.

cleveland-155783.caption: A fiddler and two listeners gather inside a barn, while a Black labourer listens from outside the open door. Music connects the four men across the composition, but Mount keeps their spaces visibly divided, reflecting the racial boundaries of antebellum America.

cleveland-159234.caption: Christ, eyes open, is fixed to a dark blue cross, upright body, legs side by side with the feet splayed apart, arms stretched along the crossbeam, a gold halo behind his head and a dark loincloth tied with an orange sash. Six small scenes on gold flank his body, pairs of standing figures fill the arm ends, a row of figures runs across the top, and white letters mark a red block at the foot.

cleveland-160885.caption: The wealthy merchant Tieleman Roosterman poses in a sober black suit set off by a broad white collar and lace-edged cuff, one hand gloved. Hals's visible brushstrokes and the sitter's direct, confident gaze animate the formal likeness.

cleveland-168322.caption: The Virgin, in a dark red mantle over a blue headcloth, presses her cheek to the Christ Child's. He tips his head back to look up at her and holds a rolled scroll tied with cord, while her hand supports him from below. Behind them is a cracked gold ground, and the panel's top corners are cut away.

cleveland-173641.caption: A seated woman holds a young child while an older child sleeps on the grass beside her outstretched legs. Through a gap in the trees, the dome of St Peter’s places this carefully composed rest within a distant view of Rome.

met-10159.caption: A trader and his son travel down the Missouri in a narrow canoe, their reflections stretching across still water. A small tethered animal sits at the bow, its dark silhouette balancing the paddler against the pale, hazy distance.

met-10810.caption: A standing musician plays a double pipe while two companions recline on the grass. Eakins sets their unadorned bodies within a deep green woodland clearing, giving a classical pastoral subject the particularity of observed models.

met-11145.caption: A lone farmer, seen from behind in a broad-brimmed hat, white shirt, braces and grey trousers, swings a scythe through a field of tall golden wheat under a blue sky. Cut stalks lie around his feet, and a discarded dark jacket in the stubble at lower right marks him as a former Union soldier.

met-12127.caption: Virginie Amélie Avegno Gautreau stands in a low-cut black gown with jewelled straps, her pale face turned in sharp profile to the right. Her right hand rests on a round table with an ornate gold-coloured base, and her left holds a folded dark fan against her skirt. Her auburn hair is swept up with a small jewel, against a plain brown background.

met-16584.caption: Washington’s pale face and white neckcloth stand out against his dark coat and a green curtain. This portrait belongs to Stuart’s Vaughan group, one of the sets of likenesses through which he established the president’s public image.

met-247009.caption: A woman in a white mantle over a dark dress sits on a carved red chair with a large golden kithara in her hands. Behind the chair a girl stands, one hand on its top rail and the other showing through the slats. Both look straight out, against a red wall.

met-37802.caption: A square palace with a gate on each side sits inside the rings of a mandala. At its centre a blue goddess with six arms sits cross-legged, with eight smaller figures around her. Roundels of deities and lamas fill the corners, and rows of small figures run along the top and bottom.

met-37813.title: Amitayus, the Buddha of Eternal Life
met-37813.caption: A large figure in a jewelled crown sits cross-legged on a lotus, holding a small object in his lap. Two standing figures flank him and smaller crowned figures sit in rows on either side; seven robed figures, most in flat hats, line the top edge, and a couple and a monk sit in the bottom corners.

met-37966.caption: A green Buddha, crowned and jewelled, sits cross-legged on a lotus throne with his right hand raised palm outward, before a large arched backing striped in red, pink and gold. Two standing attendants flank him and eight smaller seated figures fill the upper corners; along the bottom, five many-armed goddesses in red arches sit beside an offering stand and a seated monk.

met-38021.caption: At the centre of a six-petalled lotus, a dark blue, many-armed figure embraces a partner and stands on two figures lying beneath his feet, one pale and one red; a smaller figure appears on each petal. A square palace with a gateway on each side encloses them, inside circular bands that include a ring of flames. Small figures, trees and fires crowd the outer edges, and five haloed figures sit in arched niches along the bottom.

met-39668.caption: Two robed figures, each with a smaller companion, cross a plank bridge towards a two-storey pavilion on a rise; twisted, nearly bare trees hung with vines stand nearby, and fainter trees fade into haze.

met-39915.caption: Steep, wooded peaks crowd the left half of the long scroll, the tallest rising just left of centre, while lower ridges fade into mist above a wide river on the right. Boats with tall masts are moored along the near shore at lower right, and tiered roofs show among trees at the foot of the peaks.

met-39936.caption: Two finches perch on separate sprays of pale blue-green bamboo, one higher at left, the other lower near the centre, beside a craggy rock at right; red seals crowd both edges of the silk, and a bold black ink mark sits over a large seal at upper right.

met-40081.caption: Wang Xizhi, in a white robe and a hat with long black ribbons, stands at the rail of a pavilion looking out over the water, where two white geese float to the right, turned back towards him. A smaller figure waits behind him. Bright blue rocks, pale green banks, bamboo and leafy trees surround the pavilion.

met-435600.caption: A young, curly-haired Saint John in a red robe sits on a rock, writing in a book on his knee with an inkpot in his other hand. He looks up at the Virgin and Child, who appear at upper left in a golden glow ringed by clouds, the Virgin standing on a crescent moon. At lower left a black eagle with a halo stands on a closed book; behind John stretch a lake, blue mountains and a tall tree.

met-435724.caption: Mary, in a blue-green mantle, sits on a gold cloth with the naked Child on her lap inside the roofless walls of a ruined castle. Three kings bring gold vessels: one kneels in front in pink, two stand at right, one of them dark-skinned and dressed in white. An old man kneels at left with a staff, a white dog sits in the foreground and an ox lies in an archway. Overhead, angels stretch a green cloth across the sky above a wide landscape.

met-435728.caption: In his cell, Saint Jerome, a bald old man with a long grey beard, kneels in white with his hands joined while a priest in a pink cope holds the communion wafer to his open mouth. Two brown-robed friars lean over him, and one gathers his robe at the hip. Two boys hold tall candles at the left, and at the back stands an altar with a crucifix and palm fronds.

met-435826.caption: A knight and Cupid flank a maiden playing a chamber organ amid a border of flowers, Burne-Jones dissolving medieval romance into a hushed, jewel-toned reverie. Cupid works the bellows while the figures remain absorbed in music and thought.

met-435844.caption: Four boys in loose classical robes crowd together. At the centre one in a white shirt and a red mantle holds a lute, fingers on its strings, and looks out at us, while another behind him turns towards us with parted lips. At right a boy seen from behind, a white cloth slipping from his shoulder and a dark red sash at his waist, holds open a sheet of music. At left a winged boy with a quiver of arrows, dressed as Cupid, bends over a bunch of grapes, and a violin and bow lie on the cloth in front.

met-435851.caption: Christ’s dead body rests on a damaged throne between Saint Jerome and the prophet Job. Bare rock and leafless branches at the left give way to a cultivated, inhabited landscape at the right, extending the painting’s meditation on death and life.

met-435868.caption: Three men concentrate on their cards while a fourth stands behind them, smoking a pipe. Cézanne built this compact gathering from studies of local farmhands, giving each hat, coat and bent arm a carefully balanced place around the table.

met-436037.caption: Paris, dressed as an armoured knight, faces three goddesses beneath a tree. Above them Cupid draws his bow toward Venus, while a castle perched on a sheer rock turns the ancient story into a fantastical northern landscape.

met-436052.caption: Mary, in a white veil and a blue-and-gold patterned gown, holds the Christ Child, who sits on a cushion on a ledge draped with yellow cloth and clutches a small bird. A cucumber and apples hang among leaves at the top, in front of a pink hanging, with trees and sky on either side. A large fly sits on the white marble ledge at the left, and a small paper label pinned to the yellow cloth carries the painter's signature.

met-436102.caption: The Virgin stands in a red mantle under a tall arch, holding the Child, while two angels in flight hold a gold crown above her. Below, an angel in green plays a harp and an angel in blue a lute. Behind her lies a walled garden with a small figure in white, and towers beyond.

met-436258.caption: The young Van Dyck paints himself with tousled hair and an appraising sidelong glance, lifting one languid hand to his chin. The fluid black cloak and absence of palette or brushes present the painter with aristocratic ease.

met-436489.caption: The banker Francesco Sassetti faces almost frontally, while his young son Teodoro turns toward him in profile. Their red caps echo one another against a pale, distant landscape; the boy’s patterned tunic contrasts with his father’s broad red robe.

met-436504.caption: Under a wooden stable roof, Mary, wrapped in a dark blue-green mantle, lies on a red mattress, looking down. Below her an old king kneels, his crown on the ground, and lifts the Christ Child out of the manger. Joseph holds out a small red gift, two crowned kings wait at right, and angels fly over the roof against the gold.

met-436521.caption: A man with thick dark hair cut in a fringe and a short, stubbly beard looks off to the right, his hands pressed together in prayer at the lower edge. He wears a dark robe with a high collar. Behind him, past a slim stone column, a window opens onto blue sky, a green hill and trees.

met-436528.caption: Van Gogh fills a white pitcher with cobalt irises whose thick, urgent strokes electrify the pale ground. The violet-blue flowers and green leaves turn the still life into an experiment in vibrating colour.

met-436548.caption: Two majas in pale, gold-trimmed dresses lean across a wrought-iron balcony rail, sharing a teasing glance as shadowy, cloaked men loom behind them. The scene's authorship is currently attributed to Francisco Goya.

met-436658.caption: Hermann von Wedigh rests his arm on a green-covered table, a book and protruding slip of paper before him. Gold lettering stands out against the blue background, while the folds of his black coat give weight to the sharply observed face and hands.

met-436839.caption: Mary Magdalen clasps her hands over a skull on her lap. A candle burns beside her and appears again in the mirror, its doubled flame illuminating her profile, white blouse and orange-red skirt against the surrounding darkness.

met-436892.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle over a red dress, holds the naked Christ Child as he lies across her lap and turns the pages of a book set on a red cushion. An open pomegranate lies beside the book. Through a window behind them, two columns frame a walled town, a river and bridges.

met-436896.caption: A woman in strict profile stands in a room, in a red gown edged with pale fur over a dark, gold-flecked sleeve, a pearl necklace and a tall red headdress trimmed with pearls. At left a man in a red hat looks in through a narrow opening, his hands on a shield striped black and gold, and a window behind her opens onto a small landscape.

met-436897.caption: A young saint with a gold halo, in a grey-blue dalmatic with a green mantle over his shoulder and knees, sits on a grey stone throne holding a palm and a red book. Two haloed saints in round red hats stand on either side, each with a palm: the one at the left in a yellow-orange cloak over pink and blue, the one at the right in a pink cloak over a blue tunic. Before the throne three men kneel in prayer, two in red at the left and one in pink at the right, all against a gold background.

met-436918.caption: Cupid urinates through the wreath held above the reclining Venus, a playful image of fertility. Her bridal veil, crown and pearl earring suggest that Lotto painted this unusual mythological scene to celebrate a marriage.

met-436947.caption: Abruptly cropped boat and sail press a sailor and his companion against broad planes of aquamarine water. Manet combines bright, sketchy outdoor painting with strong diagonals and flattened colour inspired by Japanese prints.

met-436966.caption: Mary kneels with joined hands, her blue mantle spread on the ground, and the naked Christ child lies on its hem among cherubs in blue clouds. Joseph sleeps at the left in a yellow cloak, by a wattle fence and an ox. At the right two shepherds in torn clothes lean in, one with joined hands, the other holding his hat. Beyond them a river winds through fields, and two more figures approach at the far right.

met-437056.caption: Two panels shown side by side. On the left, a man with short brown hair and a dark robe presses his hands together in prayer against a black ground. On the right, a young woman in a dark red gown with a broad white collar, a jewelled gold necklace and a tall black headdress with a sheer veil also joins her hands. Each figure sits inside a painted frame.

met-437261.caption: Three arched panels share one landscape. At left Christ stands in a river as a kneeling man baptizes him; at centre a bearded old man kneels on a grassy ledge, a stone raised in one hand and a small crucifix on the ground before him; at right a monk in black holds a red book and beads while strange creatures crowd behind him. Rocky crags rise behind, and a wide stretch of water opens out at the right.

met-437283.caption: Fire breaks out in a dark forest while nude men, men in animal skins and goat-legged satyrs hunt, one swinging a club. In the centre foreground a lion, two bears and a man are locked together, and to their left a white beast on the back of a second, roaring lion bites its head; deer and other beasts flee at the left, and a dead man lies at the lower right.

met-437310.caption: A bird's-eye view looks down the boulevard Montmartre in Paris as it runs into a misty grey distance between rows of bare winter trees. Carriages and other horse-drawn vehicles move along the pale roadway and people walk the pavements, past a tall street lamp in the foreground and a kiosk at right. Long rows of cream-coloured buildings with grey roofs and chimneys line the right-hand side.

met-437392.caption: The cabinetmaker Herman Doomer turns toward the viewer beneath a broad black hat. Fine strokes pick out his moustache and pleated white collar, while his hand and dark clothing emerge more softly from the brown shadows.

met-437395.caption: A plumed hat, richly tooled sword belt and fur-trimmed costume emerge from the surrounding dark as the standard bearer grips his flagstaff. Rembrandt's vigorous handling models the face, hair and details with concentrated force.

met-437397.caption: Rembrandt painted himself here at fifty-four. Thick touches of paint catch the light across his brow, nose and cheeks, while his dark cap and brown coat frame a face rendered with close attention to its changing texture.

met-437455.caption: Mary and the Christ Child form a bright foreground group with Saints Anne and Catherine of Alexandria, while Joseph and another figure recede into shadow. A woven basket of fruit glows at the lower right, grounding the sacred gathering in ordinary detail.

met-437490.caption: At left the angel Gabriel, with wings marked by eye-like spots, wears a gold-and-maroon patterned robe over white and holds a tall staff. At right Mary kneels at a reading desk in a deep blue mantle over red, one hand raised, a book open in front of her. Behind her rises a bed hung with red curtains; through a window at the back lies a walled garden. Lilies stand in a metal jug at lower right.

met-437630.caption: A bearded man in a loose pink garment, a dark red cloth behind his shoulder, writes with a quill beside a small oil lamp and turns to look up at a winged angel in blue-violet behind him. Through openings at the edges, a moonlit building with small figures shows at the left and three figures gathered round a fire at the right.

met-437749.caption: Music, drinking and laughter fill a crowded terrace. At the centre a woman extends an empty glass, while a child plays beside a dog below; overhead, an owl perches next to a hanging cage, adding another small incident to Steen’s unruly gathering.

met-437824.caption: A young mother in a red dress and blue mantle, a pale veil over her red-gold hair, bends her head towards the naked baby lying across her lap, one hand under his foot. Faint rings of halo circle both heads. A green cloth hangs behind them; to the right, two tree trunks stand against a landscape with water and distant towers.

met-437825.caption: A man with shoulder-length auburn hair and a full reddish beard turns his head to look back over his shoulder at the viewer. A white collar with a soft, frayed edge sits above a black garment with a woven pattern. At lower right his fingers grip something soft and grey, against a dark background.

met-437869.caption: Juan de Pareja, held in slavery in Velázquez's studio, is shown half-length, his shoulders turned to the left and his eyes meeting ours. He has thick dark hair, a moustache and a short beard, and wears a dark olive-grey doublet and cloak with a broad white collar whose lace edge falls in ragged points. His right arm crosses his waist, the hand resting against his body, before a plain grey background.

met-437870.caption: María Teresa's formal wig spreads wide around her solemn young face, its rows of silver butterfly ribbons flickering against the dark ground. Velázquez's compact likeness was made as a model for assistants producing official portraits of the infanta.

met-437874.caption: A man with thick, dark hair falling to his collar, an upturned moustache and a small beard turns his head to look back at us over his shoulder. He wears a black doublet with a stiff white collar against a plain grey-brown background. He may be Velázquez himself, though this is uncertain.

met-437881.caption: A young woman in a white hood and broad white collar, a dark blue skirt and a dark bodice trimmed in gold, rests one hand on an open leaded window and the other on the handle of a gleaming metal pitcher. The pitcher stands in a wide basin on a table covered with a red patterned carpet, beside a small box. A blue cloth lies heaped on the chair behind, and a map hangs on the pale wall at upper right.

met-437891.caption: A cupid binds Mars and Venus together while another attends the warhorse at the right. The horse stands quietly beside the lovers, its cool grey coat contrasting with gleaming armour, pink drapery and the deep blue cloth around Venus.

met-438014.caption: The daughters of Catulle Mendès gather around a piano: one sits at the keyboard, another holds a violin and bow, and the third leans beside them. Blue and violet strokes enliven their pale dresses, linking the figures to the curtains behind.

met-438144.caption: The Union warship Kearsarge lies off Boulogne, its long dark hull set against a turquoise sea and the brown sail of a nearer boat. Manet painted it after its victory over the Confederate Alabama off the French coast in 1864.

met-438822.caption: A lion feeds on spotted prey beneath an immense screen of leaves and flowers. The small, bloody encounter is almost engulfed by Rousseau’s carefully layered foliage, whose repeated shapes turn the imagined jungle into a dense ornamental world.

met-44918.caption: Pale waves curl into clawlike tips across a two-panel screen, their long ink contours crossing a gold-leaf ground. Kōrin gives the swelling water both weight and rhythm, repeating its restless curves from one edge to the other.

met-45636.caption: Five tall trees with leafy crowns stand together on a rocky bank dotted with dark moss, pale water stretching behind them. Across the water a large mountain rises at upper left, with lower peaks to its right. Two blocks of writing and a few red seals sit in the sky, and more seals are stamped down both edges and in the bottom corners.

met-458971.caption: At the upper left, a haloed, bearded God in blue, carried by a crowd of blue-winged heads, reaches down and points at a great disc of blue, white and grey rings with one red band, a brown-and-green land at its centre. At the right, a naked angel with gold wings and halo pushes a naked Adam and Eve out of a garden of flowers and fruit trees. Below them, four dark streams flow down from a long dark band to the bottom edge.

met-458978.caption: Christ, in a pale pink robe and dark mantle, sits beside the Virgin on one throne upholstered in red and gold brocade and reaches across to set a crown on her head. She wears a white mantle patterned in gold, hands at her breast. Haloed angels crowd behind the throne; two more sit on the marbled floor in front, one playing a small organ, the other a harp.

met-459052.caption: A goldsmith in red sits at his counter holding up a small balance, while a richly dressed couple stands at his side. Shelves behind him hold tall lidded pitchers, a string of beads, brooches, a branch of coral and a box of rings. A round mirror propped up at the right shows a street and two passers-by.

met-459112.caption: Two girls study the music at a piano, one seated at the keyboard and the other leaning over her shoulder. Their inclined heads and reaching arms draw the figures together, while pink clothing, green curtains and a blue-patterned vase soften the room into colour.

met-547951.caption: A boy with short dark hair and large brown eyes looks out calmly, his head turned slightly. He wears a white tunic with a narrow purple stripe at one shoulder, and a few lines of dark Greek letters are painted below its neckline.

met-78193.caption: A painted mandala hangs in its fabric mounting, with a cloth cover gathered up at the top. A square palace inside a large circle holds the red Raktayamari and his consort at the centre, ringed by eight smaller figures in petal-shaped panels, with another figure in each of the four gates. Rows of small seated and standing figures run along the top and bottom.

met-78195.caption: A black, three-eyed Mahakala with bared fangs and a crown of skulls stands with bent knees on a corpse, before a red, patterned aureole. A bar rests across his forearms and a skull cup sits just below it. Small seated figures, most in red and orange robes, and dark fierce deities in arched niches frame him along the top and sides; more fierce figures fill the band at the bottom.

met-853194.caption: Fei Zhangfang hovers above the landscape as the staff he cast away arcs down toward a pond, where it transforms into a blue dragon. Sesson tells the Daoist legend with a few charged sweeps of ink.

met-901617.caption: Two lines of slender trees with thin, light foliage stand on a grassy bank beside the Seine, under a blue sky full of white clouds. A woman stands and a child sits on the grass in the middle distance, and a sandy path leads left towards buildings with a red roof. At right the river opens out, with a boat and its tall mast in the distance and a bank of trees on the far side.

nga-1147.caption: Cattle graze beside the lake on Francis Slater Rebow’s Essex estate, with his red-brick house visible between the trees. Constable gives almost half the picture to clouds, whose shifting shadows cross the lawns and water.

nga-1164.caption: Saint Martin sits high on a white horse, lowering part of his green cloak toward the nearly nude beggar. Gold-edged armor and monumental figures rise above a distant view of Toledo.

nga-1181.caption: Judith, in a white gown and a blue mantle, stands at the opening of a pink tent and looks away to the right. With one hand she lowers a severed head into a sack held open by a turbaned servant; in the other she holds a sword, point down. Behind her, a bare foot sticks up from a bed.

nga-1185.caption: The younger woman's frank, dimpled smile as she leans on the sill plays against her companion's half-hidden amusement behind a white shawl, all framed by warm, worn wood.

nga-1196.caption: Mary, in a red dress with a blue mantle across her lap, sits before a low wall with the naked Christ Child standing in her lap. He hooks an arm round her neck, lays a hand on her chest and looks out, while she looks down to one side, his foot resting in her hand. Behind them lies open country, with trees, water and a road at the left and a domed church on a hill at the right.

nga-12131.caption: A young man with long fair hair and a black cap turns to look back over his shoulder, straight out of the picture. His blue garment is cut low enough to leave his shoulder bare, and one hand rests on the cloth at his chest above a dark sleeve. The background is a plain deep green.

nga-12198.caption: Joanna Hiffernan stands in a white dress against a white curtain, holding a lily at her side. Her red hair, the blue patterned carpet and scattered flowers interrupt the pale surfaces; an animal pelt confronts us with glassy eyes and bared teeth.

nga-21.caption: A youth in a flat-topped crimson cap, his wavy dark blond hair falling to his shoulders, tilts his head and looks out from a black background. His right hand rests on the chest of his brown tunic, whose collar and front seam are edged in white, above a narrow grey stone ledge.

nga-26.caption: Mary sits on the grass beside a tree stump, in a blue mantle over a pink dress, a book in one hand. The naked Christ Child stands against her with one knee bent up on her lap, leaning out toward the kneeling young John the Baptist, who wears an animal skin; both boys grip the same thin cross, and Mary looks across toward it. Behind them pale turquoise water, buildings and blue hills stretch under a pale blue sky with a few small clouds, all inside a circle.

nga-27.caption: Mary, in a rose dress with a green lower sleeve and a blue mantle, looks down at the naked child on her lap. He smiles out at us and grips the gold-trimmed neckline of her dress. Thin gold halos and a sheer veil stand out against a clear blue sky.

nga-28.caption: Saint George drives his lance into the dragon as his white horse rears and turns its head toward us. The long diagonal of the weapon cuts across the horse’s body, while the princess kneels in prayer beyond its raised tail.

nga-32696.caption: Ingres records the light-absorbing black lace and velvet of Madame Moitessier's gown with minute precision, setting its dense textures against her cool gaze and flower-crowned hair.

nga-35080.caption: A woman reclines along a gray sofa, wrapped in ivory cloth and a shimmering silver-gray skirt. Sargent's loose strokes turn her languid pose into an image of calm, private luxury.

nga-37003.caption: Judith Leyster turns in her chair to look at us with parted lips, a brush in her right hand held towards the canvas on her easel, where a laughing violin player in a blue cap is painted. She wears a white cap, a wide lace-edged white collar and a black bodice with shimmering mauve sleeves. In her other hand she holds a palette, a white cloth and a fistful of brushes.

nga-39729.caption: William Grant glides toward us with folded arms, his head turned to the side and one skate trailing behind. Painted after a skating outing in London’s Hyde Park, the portrait sets his dark clothes against pale ice and a winter sky.

nga-41.caption: Venus sits half-wrapped in a fur-lined deep red velvet mantle edged with gold embroidery, one hand pressed to her breast and the other gathering the fur at her lap. A winged cupid, seen from behind, holds up a black-framed mirror in which part of her face is reflected, while a second, fair-haired cupid peers round it and a leafy wreath is held up at the top of the picture. Pearls are threaded through her braided blonde hair.

nga-41581.caption: A crowded Adoration fills a round panel. The Virgin sits with the Child outside a thatched stable, where an old man with a gold band round his head kneels to hold the Child's foot to his face. A peacock perches on the roof, and at its other end a tangle of two pheasants plunges head down. At left, beyond the kneeling figures, saddled horses wait below ruined walls where five near-naked youths stand and clamber. At upper right a long procession with camels winds down the hill past a walled town.

nga-41598.caption: The Virgin, in a deep blue mantle, holds the naked Child, who stands on a green cushion with a small fruit in one hand. A red cloth hangs behind her. At the left a window opens onto wooded hills, a winding path and a castle tower, and a coat of arms sits in each lower corner.

nga-41638.caption: Bembo's crimson biretta and cardinal's cape blaze against a brown ground as he turns and extends one hand. The alert face and open gesture suggest rhetoric and debate.

nga-41651.caption: Henrietta Maria’s blue satin catches the light beside Sir Jeffrey Hudson’s red suit. She reaches toward the monkey he holds; a crown partly tucked into the gold curtain and the massive column frame this intimate gesture with royal display.

nga-41671.caption: Giuliano de' Medici, in a red garment with grey-trimmed edges and a thin white collar, turns his head to the right, almost in profile, with his eyes cast down. He is framed by a grey window. Behind him one wooden shutter of a second window stands open on pale sky. At lower left a turtledove perches on a bare branch at the sill.

nga-41673.caption: A long boat carrying several figures glides beneath towering foreground trees. Carracci uses their deep shadow to frame a river, sunlit fields, and hazy mountains beyond.

nga-432.caption: At the dark mouth of a cave on the right, Mary in a blue mantle kneels with joined hands and white-bearded Joseph in a golden-orange cloak leans on a rock; both look down at the naked Child lying on a white cloth on the ground. Two shepherds in worn clothes come from the left, one kneeling, the other stooping behind him with a staff. The heads of an ox and another animal show in the shadows of the cave. On the left a landscape opens onto a river, a tower and distant blue mountains, and a small winged angel in white hovers among the treetops at the upper left.

nga-46.caption: Gabriel and Mary meet in a soaring church interior. Rainbow wings, a jeweled red-and-gold robe, Mary's deep blue dress, and the patterned floor reward close looking.

nga-46303.caption: A young woman in a goldenrod-yellow gown absorbs herself in a small book. Fragonard's rapid, lively strokes keep the dress, ribbons, cushion, and blushing face in motion.

nga-46437.caption: A seated writer turns to meet our gaze, her quill resting on the paper and pearl earrings catching the light. Vermeer sets the yellow, fur-trimmed jacket against a deep blue tablecloth and quiet gray wall.

nga-46538.caption: A doll-like boy in striped stockings sits atop jagged rocks, his square-on pose and oversized features set against a pale blue sky. Rousseau's flattened space gives the small portrait an uncanny presence.

nga-46569.caption: A boatman’s dark back fills the foreground opposite a woman holding a baby. The curved yellow-green hull, pale sail and high strip of distant shore turn the boat into an arrangement of bold, interlocking shapes.

nga-46572.caption: A girl in a voluminous ice-blue chemise arranges her long braid while looking toward a mirror just outside the frame. Pink patterned wallpaper and a washbasin turn the private moment into a carefully observed interior.

nga-46624.caption: One woman steps into the water while another loosens her patterned wrap, with a man holding a spear farther out. Gauguin’s dark, winding tree divides the figures from a shore painted in broad swirls of pink, purple and orange.

nga-46637.caption: Five people in tattered clothes gather around an old violinist, their varied poses spread across a bare patch of ground. Manet gives the displaced figures the scale and gravity of a public statement.

nga-46681.caption: The girl holds a green watering can upright and a few daisies at her side. Small strokes of pale colour pick out the lace on her dark blue dress and scatter across the path, echoing the flowers that surround her.

nga-47.caption: The Virgin, in dark blue, kneels over the naked Christ Child, who lies on the hem of her robe on the bare earth floor of a ruined stable. Four winged angels kneel around him; Joseph stands at right with a staff, holding his hat, and men look in through the windows and over the broken wall. A carved stone arch frames the scene, with nude statues of Adam and Eve on its columns.

nga-50299.caption: Dense tropical foliage opens onto a river disappearing into luminous mist. Look closely at the two red-breasted birds on a curving stem at the left: their tiny, sharply coloured forms contrast with the hazy sun and distant canoe.

nga-51.caption: A woman lowers her eyes beneath a sheer white veil that falls in crisp, wide planes, her hands folded at the lower edge. Rogier distills her presence into austere geometry against a deep blue-green ground.

nga-53034.caption: A woman alone at a café table rests her cheek on one hand beside a glass of plum brandy, gazing into the distance. Manet's pink dress, burgundy banquette, and gray-streaked marble sustain the pensive pause.

nga-53130.caption: A nude woman stands amid jewel-toned green, pink, and purple while a masked kneeling figure watches from beneath a tree. A red-and-green serpent at upper right sharpens Gauguin's elusive image of temptation and evil.

nga-56662.caption: A baby's face and one small hand emerge at the crest of a mountain of frilled white cloth and mosaic-like patchwork. Klimt lets shifting patterns and vivid color fill almost the entire square canvas.

nga-60.caption: A broad scarlet-red hat and sumptuous blue robe concentrate the color in Vermeer's tiny panel. Bright glints on pearl earrings, lips, nose, and chair finials sharpen its otherwise soft, hazy light.

nga-61368.caption: A child slumps deep in a vivid blue armchair while a small dog curls asleep in the matching chair opposite. Cassatt's cropped field of upholstered furniture makes the girl's informal pose feel all the more unguarded.

nga-66405.caption: Cézanne’s son Paul poses as Harlequin, holding a white wooden sword across his red-and-black costume. The diamond pattern gives the slender figure a strong rhythm against a mottled blue wall, with a draped curtain overhead.

nga-83.caption: Lucretia holds a dagger toward her chest and looks down with red-rimmed eyes, suspended in the instant before her suicide. Rembrandt builds the tragedy from warm light, tawny fabric, gold, and pearls.

nga-85.caption: A man with a sweeping moustache and a pearl drop in his ear looks out at us from under a tall dark fur hat banded with gold. A heavy gold chain with a pendant and a dark tassel hangs over the wide fur collar of his cloak, and his left hand grips a gold-topped staff.

nga-88.caption: A needlewoman bends over the cloth in her hands, her absorbed downward gaze carrying the intimacy of the scene. Velazquez leaves the sewing and parts of the costume in economical, unfinished strokes.

nga-92.caption: Layers of lace, white ribbon, and pink roses ornament the marquesa's silvery gown. Goya sets its elaborate shepherdess fashion against a small bell-collared pug and a pale green park landscape.

nga-93045.caption: At the left, a seated dancer rests her head on one hand beside a cello lying on the floor. Farther into the long room, another dancer adjusts her green sash; the broad stretch of worn floor separates these quiet pauses in rehearsal.

nga-95.caption: A pale, direct face emerges from an almost black ground. Goya's vibrant, economical brushwork suggests the white lace mantilla and the broad orange-and-black shawl wrapped around the sitter's shoulders.

nga-99.caption: Wind lifts Elizabeth Sheridan's loose curls and translucent scarf as she sits in a rose-pink gown beneath an arching tree. Gainsborough's swirling, fluttering strokes let sitter and landscape share the same restless air.

rijks-200106038.caption: Under a dark, heavy sky, sunlight falls on a clump of trees and on an arched stone bridge over a river. Two small boats carry figures, one passing beneath the arch and one in the foreground where a man pushes with a long pole. Houses and a cart stand at the left, and a church spire rises in the distance at right.

rijks-200107810.caption: A foundered three-master lies in violent surf beneath sheer cliffs and a storm-darkened sky pierced by sunlight. Tiny figures search the beach for survivors, sharpening Nuijen's Romantic vision of human fragility before nature.

rijks-200107876.caption: An older man with long grey hair under a black cap, in a dark robe with a white collar, is shown at bust length, turned to the right. Behind him a landscape of hills, trees and buildings lies under a blue sky. A quill pen and a pair of compasses lie crossed on a red ledge in front.
rijks-200107876.title: Portrait of Giuliano da Sangallo
rijks-200107876.collection: Mauritshuis, The Hague (on loan to the Rijksmuseum)

rijks-200107929.caption: Five wardens and their bareheaded servant look up from a table covered with a rich red carpet. Their varied poses make the meeting seem interrupted, while white collars and the open book punctuate the broad areas of black clothing.

rijks-200107941.caption: Rembrandt at about twenty-two peers out from deep shadow as light glances along one cheek. Scratches made with the butt of his brush pick out the curls of his tousled hair in the wet paint.

rijks-200107947.caption: Light from behind the reader falls on the open book and the single hand resting across its page, leaving her face in shadow. The bright paper and wrinkled skin draw attention to the act of reading rather than to her uncertain identity.

rijks-200107988.caption: Rugged rocky mountains enclose a broad valley where a river winds past scattered trees, houses and a small tower under a grey-blue sky. On the dark slope at lower left a man in dark clothes walks with a bundle on his back, and two tiny figures stand on a path at right.

rijks-200108123.caption: At the right of a crowded brothel, a young man performs an egg dance to a bagpiper's music. He must roll an egg within a chalk circle and cover it with a wooden bowl without breaking it, a comic game turned moral warning.

rijks-200108146.caption: A white swan rears up beside its nest with wings spread wide and beak open, its head turned towards a dog whose head breaks the water at lower left. Eggs lie in the nest at right, and loose feathers drift through the air against a blue and orange sky. Painted words label the dog, the swan and one of the eggs.

rijks-200108163.caption: Crowds of skaters, walkers and a horse-drawn red sledge fill a frozen waterway that runs between snowy houses and bare trees into a misty distance. A church with a blue-grey roof and tower stands at the left, and in the left foreground a dog and crows pick at a dead horse.

rijks-200108271.caption: Three-year-old Helena van der Schalcke stands alone in a silk dress adorned with bows and carries a small straw purse. Her adult-like finery contrasts with the walking reins still visible at her back.

rijks-200108277.caption: The standing woman’s silver satin catches the light as an officer gestures toward her and a seated woman drinks from a glass. A bed, dressing table and watchful dog furnish the room, but the purpose of this encounter remains uncertain.

rijks-200108359.caption: A seventy-gun British warship pitches on a high wave after a squall has broken its mast and torn one sail loose. Van de Velde sets the dark, churning sea against a bright opening near the horizon.

rijks-200108369.caption: A maidservant pours milk with monumental stillness in a bright, bare room. Hundreds of colorful dots carry light across the bread, basket, and other surfaces while only the thin stream of milk seems to move.

rijks-200108431.caption: Grapes, lemons, pomegranate, plums, cherries, blackberries, chestnuts, and roses cascade from a ring before a dark niche. De Heem's minute detail extends to the beetles, butterflies, and snails feeding among them.

rijks-200108444.caption: Flowers spill from an earthenware vase decorated with playing putti, with a nest of eggs on the ledge beside it. The towering crown imperial and curling tulip petals stand against a pale garden setting, where a statue of Flora appears at the left.

rijks-200108883.caption: A narrow red mountain track curves through dense green scrub above the Mediterranean near Monaco. Red, green, and blue strokes shimmer in high sunlight, while a lone walker's short shadow marks the hour.

rijks-200108932.caption: Prince Diponegoro, promised safe conduct and then arrested during peace talks, is escorted from the veranda as his followers sit below. Commissioned by De Kock, the work recasts the Dutch betrayal as the prince's submission.

rijks-200109183.caption: A large turkey pie presides over a table crowded with oysters, Chinese porcelain, a Pacific nautilus shell, Indian pepper, and a pewter pitcher. Claesz turns imported luxuries from several continents into a single opulent display.

rijks-200109196.caption: Adam and Eve accept the forbidden fruit from a serpent with a human torso while God warns them from a cloud in the distance. A monkey, cat, dog, hedgehog, frog, fox, owl, and slugs crowd their richly imagined Paradise.

rijks-200109201.caption: Christ hangs on a tall dark cross in the centre while four angels, three in the air and one kneeling beside the cross level with his feet, hold out chalices toward him. Mourners stand and kneel at lower left, horsemen and soldiers crowd the right, and at lower right a richly dressed woman kneels holding up a cloth bearing Christ's face. Smaller scenes fill the green hills behind, with a walled city at upper right.

rijks-200109296.caption: Before a thatched stable set in ruined stone arches, the Virgin holds the naked Child, who reaches into a gold cup offered by a kneeling, bald-headed king. Two more kings stand at the left, one bearded and one Black, with Joseph at the right. Behind them, riders with banners, and one on a camel, come through hills and rocks.

rijks-200109334.caption: Seventy-six-year-old Goya gives the judge Don Ramon Satue an unusually informal portrait: he stands with hands in his pockets, black coat open at a red-lined collar. The sparse setting makes his relaxed pose carry the image.

rijks-200109390.caption: A woman squeezes lemon into her glass as a man leans toward her across the table. Behind them, one servant brings a drink while another scrubs a copper kettle over a wooden barrel; sunlit brickwork sets their shaded gathering in relief.

rijks-200109391.caption: A maidservant shows a small child the contents of her lidded jug on a checkered pantry floor. Doorways open toward the cellar and a front room where daylight streams in pure white.

rijks-200109415.caption: Bright reflections pick out the silver jug’s curling ornament beside a blue-and-white porcelain bowl of citrus fruit. A glass rises behind them in an elaborate gold mount, while an open watch sits near the dark table edge at the lower right.

rijks-200109429.caption: Israelites dance around the golden calf in the central panel while families feast in the foreground and Moses appears on Mount Sinai beyond. The wings extend the same continuous landscape and its warning against faithlessness and debauchery.

rijks-200109480.caption: A mother comforts her pale, listless child in a pose that recalls the Virgin mourning Christ. The Crucifixion painting on the wall reinforces that echo, while a small pot and spoon keep the scene rooted in domestic care.

rijks-2001282.caption: A young man in a black cap with a round gold medallion is shown half-length, turned to the right, against a dark background. A red-and-gold patterned collar with a hanging golden fleece lies over his white pleated shirt. His patterned gold gown is lined with dark fur. At lower right one hand gestures, while the fingertips of the other rest at the edge.

rijks-20013048.caption: Berckheyde records the newly built mansions of Amsterdam's most expensive canal stretch with mathematical precision. By omitting the young trees that actually lined the quay, he gives the Golden Bend an unusually clear, monumental frontage.

rijks-20013287.caption: Narcissi and columbines crowd a small glass of water while a butterfly, ladybird, and other insects occupy the flowers and tabletop. The costly profusion would have appeared exceptionally lavish to a seventeenth-century viewer.

rijks-20015947.caption: Hands folded and eyes closed, an old woman gives thanks over bread, cheese, fish, and a bowl. A cat tugs at the tablecloth, adding a small test of self-control to this image of piety.

rijks-20026156.caption: Rembrandt concentrates the light on the face of Ephraim Bueno, a Jewish physician, poet, and translator. This small painted study for an etched portrait leaves the clothing and hands comparatively coarse.

rijks-20026546.caption: Five Dutch warships struggle through a storm near Gibraltar while wreckage churns in the foreground. The fleet had been sent to protect merchant vessels; several ships sank or were damaged, including the Hollandia shown at the right.

rijks-20026821.caption: A family walks along a country road while a son leads a dog beside them. A carriage approaches in the distance and a shepherd tends livestock farther back, extending the portrait into a broad pastoral landscape.

rijks-20027043.caption: A Van der Borcht nobleman gestures toward a sea battle connected with Dunkirk below. Van Dyck painted the head and hands, while his studio completed much of the costume and setting.

rijks-20027070.caption: Tulips, roses, poppies, anemones, narcissi, and irises fill a stone vase as snails, a caterpillar, a bee, and a dragonfly move among them. An open gold watch on a blue ribbon turns the profusion into a reminder of transience.

rijks-20027537.caption: More than ten flower species, including iris, poppy, rose, and carnation, share a bouquet that could never have existed in nature because they bloom at different times. Rachel Ruysch assembled it from extensive studies of living and preserved flowers.

rijks-20027803.caption: A young man smokes a pipe beside an open illustrated book as a green curtain hangs from a copper rod above him. Dou's illusionistic niche makes the curtain seem ready to slide across the painting.
rijks-20027803.title: Man Smoking a Pipe

rijks-20027805.caption: The reader holds her book close, its printed words and small illustration rendered with remarkable clarity. Fur, folded fabric and wrinkled skin surround the pale pages, where the heading identifies a passage from the Gospel of Luke.

rijks-20027868.caption: Abraham de Potter, an Amsterdam silk merchant, stands soberly dressed in black with an unfashionably stiff pleated ruff. Fabritius sets the conventional pose against a weathered plaster wall and adds a painted nail above his signature as a small illusionistic surprise.

rijks-20028104.caption: A mother searches her child’s hair for lice beside the curtained bed. At the left, a dog faces the sunlit room beyond the open doorway; repeating tiles and doorframes lead the eye from this domestic task toward the garden outside.

rijks-20028351.caption: Oysters with lemon, bread, wine, pomegranate, grapes, chestnuts, quinces, gourds, plums, and peaches crowd a marble tabletop. A goblet, glass, watch, snails, butterflies, spider, and dragonfly extend Mignon's display of foods and costly imports.

rijks-20029039.caption: The ten regents of Amsterdam's Aalmoezeniersweeshuis sit and stand around a carpeted table while an orphan boy waits at the right. Troost identifies the orphanage's governors as an imposing civic body within a monumental interior.

rijks-2003051.title: Interior with Women beside a Linen Cupboard
rijks-2003051.caption: Two women stack freshly pressed linen in a cupboard while a girl plays kolf on the tiled floor. Beyond the darker interior, sunlight falls on the canal houses outside; the cupboard and its key also signal the mistress's authority over the household.

rijks-2004259.caption: Pharaoh and his wife mourn over the body of their firstborn son in a shadowed Egyptian temple. Moses and Aaron appear at the upper right, having returned after the final plague to secure the Israelites' release.

rijks-200639587.caption: Twenty-year-old Marten Soolmans stands full-length in an expensive black costume with lace collar, bows, cuffs, garters, and shoe rosettes, holding a glove in his left hand. Painted with Oopjen Coppit a year after their marriage, the pair are Rembrandt's only life-size, standing, full-length couple.

rijks-2006398.caption: A girl in the foreground displays a bucket of treats from St Nicholas while the wailing boy at left finds only a switch in his shoe. Steen builds the December feast from gifts, sweets, songs, and the children's sharply different reactions.

rijks-200642954.caption: Oopjen Coppit holds a black feather fan in her bare hand, its gold chain catching the light. Rembrandt sets her white lace collar and cuffs against a patterned black dress, with pearls, a silver bow and a glimpse of an embroidered shoe marking her wealth.

wikidata-Q1016012.title: Ludovic Lepic and His Daughters
wikidata-Q1016012.caption: Ludovic Lepic sits between his two daughters, their white dresses and red accents set against a green shutter. Degas lets the three figures overlap and crowd the narrow bench, making this family portrait feel unusually immediate.

wikidata-Q1025704.title: Terrace of a Café at Night (Place du Forum)

wikidata-Q1028282.caption: Apollo, still running, clasps Daphne round the waist as she turns into a laurel: her arms have become two great leafy trees and one leg sinks into the ground. A white scarf streams out behind him, and a river winds through the wide valley beyond.

wikidata-Q10296499.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
wikidata-Q10296499.caption: Henchmen press the crown of thorns onto Christ's head with long sticks as he endures the abuse amid a sombre crowd. In this major late work, Titian dissolves contours into rough, expressive paint to intensify the torture scene.

wikidata-Q10322900.title: La Japonaise (Camille Monet in Japanese Costume)
wikidata-Q10322900.caption: Camille Monet turns in a red kimono whose embroidered warrior appears to move with its folds. Her blond wig stresses her Western identity, while a fan in French colours and a wall of Japanese fans make the picture a witty response to Paris's fashion for Japanese art.

wikidata-Q104120179.caption: A woman turns to look back over her shoulder, her pale back prominent against green water. Other nude figures, flowing hair and a large goldfish fill Klimt's shimmering underwater scene.

wikidata-Q1044742.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
wikidata-Q1044742.caption: Parisians stroll, lounge, sail, and fish on a sunny bank of the Seine at La Grande Jatte. Seurat constructs the large scene from tiny dabs of different colours, intended to blend in the viewer's eye into more luminous hues.

wikidata-Q10466368.title: The Lady with the Veil. The Artist's Wife Marie Suzanne Giroust
wikidata-Q10466368.caption: Marie Suzanne Giroust, an accomplished artist and Roslin's wife, appears dressed for a masquerade in the Bolognese style. She holds a closed fan to her cheek and half-hides her smiling face behind a black silk veil, balancing intimacy with disguise.

wikidata-Q10467459.caption: A nude woman sits on the ground at the edge of a wood, crossing her arms and bending one leg toward her body. Her white stockings and red shoes punctuate the dark earth, foliage, and water around the isolated figure.

wikidata-Q10468599.caption: A pale, androgynous dandy lies with one hand at the heart and takes a final look in a small mirror. Women gather against the blue-purple background while the other man performs the role of a professional mourner, turning the death into an ambiguous, staged ritual.

wikidata-Q104875925.title: St. Catherine of Alexandria
wikidata-Q104875925.caption: Saint Catherine meets the viewer with a steady gaze, holding the book and palm frond that identify her as a learned martyr. Her purple silk dress signals royal birth, and the light lifting her figure from the landscape suggests divine inspiration.

wikidata-Q1054459.caption: Christ hangs on a cross against a gold ground, a dark, worn bush growing from its top. Mary, in a blue mantle, stands at left with her hands clasped; John, in a pink-red cloak over blue, stands at right with his hands raised to his face. Between them, at the foot of the cross, Mary Magdalene kneels with her back to us in a red cloak, both arms flung upward.

wikidata-Q1055117.caption: The three Magi kneel before the Holy Family with precious gifts while a richly dressed, multi-ethnic procession and exotic animals fill the main panel. Three episodes of their journey cross the background, and embossed metal leaf gives spurs, weapons, garments, and the elaborate frame physical relief.

wikidata-Q1056043.caption: A winged angel with a wreath of flowers in his curls kneels at the left, holding up a tall stem of white lilies. Mary, in a blue mantle over rose sleeves, stands on a raised step beside a lectern with an open book, eyes lowered. Two men look on from behind a ledge at the right, and two pale figures appear in a doorway behind them. A central arch opens on trees under a blue sky.

wikidata-Q1059211.caption: John the Baptist, at right, pours water from a small bowl over the bowed head of Christ, who stands ankle-deep in a stream with his hands pressed together. Two angels kneel at lower left. The far-left one, with a pale pink cloth over his arm, is generally credited to the young Leonardo. Above, two hands and a white dove send down golden rays, and a river valley winds into the distance.
wikidata-Q1059211.artist: Andrea del Verrocchio and Leonardo da Vinci

wikidata-Q106522623.caption: A dark-haired woman with red lips, her body in profile, turns her face towards us over a bare shoulder as a patterned robe slips down her arm. She holds an open fan against her chest. Behind her a bright yellow ground is scattered with pink and blue lotus blossoms, leaves and large long-tailed phoenixes.

wikidata-Q1065493.caption: Ophelia floats with her mouth open and arms spread at the moment in Shakespeare's Hamlet when she sings before drowning. Millais surrounds her with closely observed plants and symbolic flowers: poppy for death, daisies for innocence, and pansies for love in vain.

wikidata-Q107486133.title: Fallen Angel
wikidata-Q107486133.caption: The defeated Satan shields his face beneath folded dark wings while looking outward with wounded pride. Above him, a legion of radiant angels rises toward God, sharpening Cabanel's contrast between despairing rebellion and heavenly joy.

wikidata-Q1087226.caption: A young woman works at a mortar beside fish, eggs and garlic while an older woman gestures behind her. At upper right, Christ visits Martha and Mary in a scene whose relation to the kitchen remains deliberately ambiguous.

wikidata-Q1087244.caption: Christ bends to write in the dust before the woman condemned to stoning: 'He who is without sin, let him cast the first stone.' Bruegel's subdued grisaille and sparse white highlights turn the surrounding crowd into a quiet plea for tolerance.

wikidata-Q1090371.title: Philip IV of Spain in Brown and Silver

wikidata-Q1090837.caption: Men and boys relax in bright, hazy sunlight beside the Seine at the industrial suburb of Asnières. Their still profiles contrast with the river's sailboats and the railway bridge, road bridge, gasworks, and factory chimneys on the far bank.

wikidata-Q1092638.caption: Mary, in a rose-red dress and dark blue mantle, holds the Child in a white cloth; he raises one hand in blessing and holds a white rose, a red coral necklace at his neck. Two angels, one in pale blue and one in pink, stand behind. Through a doorway at upper left, sunlight from a window falls across a back room.

wikidata-Q109442292.caption: Two women in lace veils lean towards one another behind a balcony railing, their bright gowns set against two men wrapped in dark capes. Their faces are visible; the veils soften their outlines while the men recede into shadow.

wikidata-Q1103170.caption: Lucretia looks down as she brings a dagger towards her exposed breast, her pearl-adorned hair, gold bracelets and deep green drapery contrasting with the violence of the act.

wikidata-Q1103801.caption: A young woman in a gold dress stands at the centre with a small organ tipped downward in her hands, her eyes raised to a band of angels in the clouds, some holding open books. Beside her stand a bearded man in red and green leaning on a sword, a young man, an older bearded man with a crozier, and a woman who looks straight out, a silver jar at her side. Broken musical instruments lie scattered at their feet.

wikidata-Q110714599.caption: Christ looks straight out, a wreath of thorny branches on his head and his hands crossed over a red robe. Grey ropes are tied round his wrists and upper arms. Small grey-white angels circle his head against a black ground, carrying a cross, a ladder, a lance and other objects.

wikidata-Q11091298.caption: Christ blesses the bread at a table surrounded by richly dressed adults and children. Two girls play with a dog in the foreground, while columns frame a distant landscape.

wikidata-Q1109340.caption: Fortitude sits on an ornate marble seat, wearing armour over her dress and red drapery across her knees. A sceptre rests across her lap, giving this personification of perseverance the attributes of a ruler.

wikidata-Q1109475.caption: Mary and Elizabeth meet face to face, their hands resting on each other as two attendants look towards the viewer. Pink, blue, green and orange draperies fill almost the entire panel, dwarfing the street behind them.

wikidata-Q1111394.caption: Rembrandt raises a tall glass as Saskia sits on his lap, both turning towards the viewer. His feathered hat, smiling face and richly coloured costume give the double portrait a mood of exuberance.

wikidata-Q11129389.caption: Saint Bernard, in a white habit, sits at a lectern with an open book and raises both hands as the Virgin, in red and blue, stands before him with two angels behind her. Two more haloed figures stand at his back. Between the two groups, a stone arcade opens onto hills, slender trees and distant buildings.

wikidata-Q1113749.caption: A knight of Malta turns his gaze to the side, his illuminated face and large white cross standing out against dark clothing and a brown background.

wikidata-Q1113763.caption: Pablo de Valladolid stands with his feet apart and one arm extended, his black clothes outlined against an empty, earth-toned background. A shadow beneath his shoes gives the figure a foothold without defining a room.

wikidata-Q1113824.caption: Olivares turns towards the viewer from a rearing horse, his armour catching the light and a command baton raised in his hand. Troops and drifting smoke spread across the distant landscape below.

wikidata-Q1114220.caption: Red poppies spread across the foreground in loose strokes, surrounding figures whose clothes merge with the field. Beyond them, trees and village roofs gather around a church tower beneath a broad, cloudy sky.

wikidata-Q1114361.caption: The court entertainer known as Don Juan de Austria poses in pink and black with a command baton and a feathered hat. Armour and ammunition lie at his feet, while a naval battle fills the opening behind him.

wikidata-Q1114571.caption: Blue umbrellas crowd a Parisian street. Renoir's changing style is visible across the canvas: the softly painted mother and children at right contrast with the firmer outlines of the woman carrying a bandbox at left.

wikidata-Q1114718.caption: A smiling woman in a red bonnet and flower-patterned dress faces the viewer as her partner holds her at the waist. Foliage fills the background, with a table beside the couple and a straw hat on the ground.

wikidata-Q1114806.caption: Golden rays cross an arched interior towards Mary, who bends at the right as Gabriel approaches from the left. Receding columns frame a distant lake and trees beyond the angel.

wikidata-Q1114913.caption: The infant lies on a bright white cloth amid figures in red, blue, green and yellow drapery. Above the worshippers, winged angels hold a long curling banner against the dark background.

wikidata-Q1115413.caption: A crowd fills a broad classical hall. At centre a man sits enthroned on a stepped platform under a vaulted apse, surrounded by onlookers, while armoured riders mill below. Groups of women cluster at both ends, and stone reliefs of fighting men fill the upper corners above the doorways, beside dark pilasters with gold scrolls.

wikidata-Q1115423.caption: Before a dark tomb opening, the fainting Virgin, supported by John in red, has Christ's body across her lap. A woman at right supports Christ's head, another at lower left presses his cloth-wrapped feet to her cheek, and a third at left hides her face in her mantle. At the top Joseph of Arimathea, in yellow, raises the crown of thorns and the nails and looks upward.
wikidata-Q1115423.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

wikidata-Q1115514.caption: In a broad square framed by classical buildings, a woman lies dead on a bier while armed men crowd round, some hiding their faces. Above her a soldier in a red cloak holds out a sword, beneath a white statue on a tall column. At a doorway on the left a soldier seizes a woman; under an arch on the right a woman collapses into men's arms.

wikidata-Q1115613.caption: Mary sits in a meadow in a blue mantle, her fingertips pressed together, looking down at the naked child asleep across her lap. At the left a dark bird perches in a bare tree, and in the field a white bird raises its wings at a snake on the ground in front of it. Behind her are fenced fields with oxen and herdsmen, and a walled castle with towers below a cloudy blue sky.
wikidata-Q1115613.title: Madonna of the Meadow

wikidata-Q111578201.caption: Strawberries rise in a cone above a shallow woven basket. A glass of water and two white carnations sit at the left; a peach and smaller red fruits balance the arrangement at the right.

wikidata-Q1117094.caption: Christ bends his head beneath the crown of thorns as two men wield long staffs above him. Light catches his exposed torso and the polished armour of an observer whose back faces the viewer.

wikidata-Q1117805.caption: Joseph Roulin sits facing the viewer in a blue postal uniform with yellow buttons and cuff decorations. His long beard spreads over his chest, and both hands rest low in the composition against a pale blue background.

wikidata-Q1118295.caption: A yellow wooden chair with a woven seat holds a pipe and tobacco pouch. It stands on reddish tiles beside a blue door, with a signed box of sprouting bulbs partly visible at the left.

wikidata-Q1118465.caption: Mary stands at right in a red patterned wrap, carrying the haloed Christ child on her shoulder. Two women join their hands in devotion nearby, while a partly hidden angel and piled fruit frame Gauguin's Tahitian reimagining of a Christian subject.

wikidata-Q1122842.caption: A magpie perches on the crossbeam of a gallows beside dancing villagers. Beyond the wooded foreground, a winding river leads past settlements and rocky heights into a pale blue distance.

wikidata-Q1123378.caption: Charles V rides a dark horse through a wooded landscape, wearing gleaming armour and a red sash. His long weapon angles upward across the sky, while red plumes decorate his helmet and the horse’s head.

wikidata-Q1131110.caption: Christ kneels in prayer on a tall rock, looking up towards a small winged child who holds out a gold cup in the sky. Three disciples sleep on the bare ground below. Beyond a river, soldiers with spears and shields walk along a road through a wide landscape, under clouds lit pink and peach low in the sky.

wikidata-Q1131476.caption: Christ’s pale body stretches across the lower part of the painting, supported by figures in blue, pink and orange robes. Winged children fill the arched sky above, carrying a cross and other objects.

wikidata-Q1132479.caption: Two large gravediggers bend over Lucy’s body, with mourners gathered behind them and a bishop at the right. A towering brown wall and a dark arched recess occupy much of the space above the burial.

wikidata-Q1132486.caption: Ursula lowers her head towards the arrow in her chest, her hands gathered around the wound. The bowman faces her from the left, while witnesses emerge from the dark background.

wikidata-Q1132723.caption: Prisoners walk in a circle within a courtyard enclosed by high brick walls. Green, blue and ochre strokes cover the masonry, while three men stand apart at the right.

wikidata-Q1133103.caption: Two Vendramin brothers gather with seven sons of the family before a relic of the True Cross. Fur-trimmed robes give the elders ceremonial weight, while the children shift their attention between the altar, the viewer and a small dog.

wikidata-Q1133114.caption: Venus sleeps on blue drapery with one arm above her head, while Cupid rests beside her. At the left, a satyr lifts the cloth against a background of dark trees.

wikidata-Q1133420.caption: At the centre, Justinus van Nassau offers a key to Ambrosio Spínola, who places a hand on his shoulder. Soldiers and horses gather on either side, with a dense row of upright pikes at the right and smoke rising over the distant landscape.
wikidata-Q1133420.title: The Surrender of Breda

wikidata-Q1133457.caption: Francisco Lezcano sits beneath a dark rocky overhang, holding what appears to be a pack of cards. One shoe sole faces the viewer, while a distant mountain landscape opens at the right.

wikidata-Q1133821.caption: Sardanapalus reclines on a red bed above a crowded scene of killing, with a richly harnessed horse at the lower left. Pale bodies, bright textiles and gold vessels fill the foreground beneath the dark palace interior.

wikidata-Q1133844.caption: Tall dark cypresses rise behind a balustraded terrace, over which a white sheet hangs, above a pale wall whose arched opening is boarded up with planks. Two men in hats stand in front of it between clipped hedges, and a statue stands in a niche in the wall at right.

wikidata-Q1133875.caption: Mars sits with his chin resting on one hand, wearing an ornate helmet and a blue cloth around his waist. Pink drapery covers the seat, while armour and a sword lie at his feet.

wikidata-Q1133881.caption: The young prince rides a rearing horse, holding a baton beneath a cloudy sky. His pink sash trails to the right above a broad landscape of hills and snowy mountains.

wikidata-Q1134060.caption: Susanna sits beside the water, turning her face upward while two elders lean towards her from behind. White cloth gathers around her body, and one elder raises a finger to his lips beneath the dark foliage.

wikidata-Q1134250.caption: Mounted soldiers and armed men fill a snow-covered village, confronting inhabitants among houses and bare trees. A dense group of horsemen gathers in the centre, while figures force their way into a building at the right.

wikidata-Q1134281.caption: God the Father raises his arms above a winged eagle, lion and ox, with angels gathered around him. Golden light opens between the clouds, high above a distant landscape.

wikidata-Q1140358.caption: Three shepherds and a woman gather around a stone tomb. Two men point toward its inscription, “Et in Arcadia ego,” bringing a reminder of mortality into the wooded Arcadian landscape.

wikidata-Q1142058.caption: Mary smiles down at the child on her lap, holding out a tiny sprig of pale flowers. He grips her hand and studies the flower. Both wear thin gold haloes. Behind them, in a dark room, a bright arched window opens at the upper right.

wikidata-Q1150402.caption: Mary holds the infant Jesus before a crowded ring of winged angel heads. Red wings and pale clouds fill the blue background around her dark mantle.
