wikidata-Q1150782.caption: A man in a green headdress with long hanging folds and a red robe trimmed with fur gazes off to the left, behind a cracked stone ledge. His right hand holds a small rolled paper with writing on its outside. Large capitals on the ledge read LEAL SOVVENIR, with a short line of small white letters above them and a line of white script below.
wikidata-Q1150782.title: Portrait of a Man ('Léal Souvenir')

wikidata-Q1150997.caption: Saturn grips a mutilated body in both hands and bites into it, his eyes wide open. Pale flesh and red blood stand out against the surrounding darkness in this work from Goya’s Black Paintings.

wikidata-Q11531476.caption: Pine trees rise out of pale mist across a six-panel folding screen, one of a pair. Some are painted in dense, rough black strokes, others in washes so faint they almost dissolve into the paper. Wide stretches of the paper are left bare, and the far right panel holds only the faint outline of a peak near its top. Two small seals sit on the far left panel.
wikidata-Q11531476.title: Pine Forest

wikidata-Q115801348.caption: Pale water-lily blossoms rise above blue and violet pads, while long green reflections descend through the pond. The open water at the lower right reflects a patch of blue sky.

wikidata-Q1167178.caption: Courbet paints a landscape at the centre of a crowded studio, beside a standing nude woman, a boy and a white cat. The assembled figures turn the studio into an allegory of his artistic and social world.

wikidata-Q1167796.caption: A white cockatoo is enclosed in the glass vessel of an air pump as an audience watches the demonstration. Candlelight illuminates their differing reactions, from a girl covering her face to a couple looking at each other.

wikidata-Q1167907.caption: Friends gather beneath a striped awning on a riverside terrace, talking around a table crowded with bottles, glasses and fruit. At the lower left, a woman holds a small dog close to her face.

wikidata-Q1167932.caption: Belshazzar turns toward a mysterious hand writing Hebrew letters on the wall. His raised arm and the spilling vessel beside him carry the sudden shock through the richly dressed banquet guests.

wikidata-Q11690349.caption: A candle between Christ and the seated priest lights their faces and an open book. The priest raises a finger while Christ stands with his hands together; other figures remain in shadow.

wikidata-Q1169199.caption: Nine panels open into a single scene. At the top centre Christ in red sits on a rainbow against a gold sky, with a lily on one side of his head and a sword on the other. Under him an angel in white holds a pair of scales, and four angels in rose-crimson blow long trumpets. Rows of seated figures, most with haloes, fill the panels to either side. Naked people climb out of the ground along the bottom: at far left an angel meets a few at a golden Gothic gateway, at far right others tumble into flames.

wikidata-Q1169395.caption: In a room with a black-and-white tiled floor, a young woman in a yellow bodice and white satin skirt plays a harpsichord whose open lid is painted with a landscape. A man with long dark hair sits with his back to us on a red-backed chair, and a standing woman in a grey fur-trimmed jacket sings from a sheet of paper. A rug-draped table and a viola da gamba fill the left foreground, and two large paintings hang on the wall behind.

wikidata-Q11694421.caption: The young Christ sits beside a sheep, resting one hand on its back and holding a shepherd’s staff across his lap. Broken classical stonework and a distant flock place the devotional image in a pastoral landscape.

wikidata-Q11695670.caption: A young woman in a broad black hat rests her hands over the lower edge of a painted frame. Her fingers appear to cross the boundary of the picture, bringing Rembrandt's figure unusually close to the viewer.

wikidata-Q1170194.caption: The Virgin, in blue, sits enthroned before a green canopy, and two small angels hold a jewelled crown above her head. On her lap the Child lifts a rose garland toward a kneeling old man in a gold cope at left, while she sets another on the head of a kneeling man in red at right. Crowds press in on both sides, and at her feet an angel sits playing a lute.

wikidata-Q1171740.caption: A brilliant light radiates through the blue sky above a white house with green shutters and an orange-red roof. Short, restless strokes animate the walls, trees and pale road, where a dark-clad figure passes in front of the garden.

wikidata-Q11740522.caption: A seated woman bends over her joined hands beside a candle resting on an empty chair. Warm light falls across her exposed chest and legs, leaving her face and clothing partly in shadow.

wikidata-Q1175910.caption: A helmeted fireman carries children through a burning room as a woman reaches up toward them. Firelight colours their faces and clothing red, while flames remain visible behind his legs.

wikidata-Q11765896.caption: Mary turns toward Christ above a crowded town square. Below, richly dressed women pray among people receiving help, a musician plays beside a seated man, and a dog rests in the foreground.

wikidata-Q11770877.caption: Mary joins her hands and looks upward, wearing a white robe and a billowing blue mantle. A crescent moon curves beside her feet, while angels among the clouds carry flowers and branches.

wikidata-Q11786749.caption: A woman turns her eyes upward to the side, wearing gold-coloured hoop earrings and a necklace. White cloth falls below one exposed shoulder and breast, with green fabric and a partly visible fan at the bottom of the portrait.
wikidata-Q11786749.title: Study of a Woman

wikidata-Q11787907.caption: Andrew's bound body cuts diagonally through the surrounding darkness, its aged skin sharply illuminated. Above him, a man holds up a small statue of Jupiter, urging the apostle to abandon his faith even as his execution proceeds.

wikidata-Q11787908.caption: Sebastian stands bound to a tree, with arrows piercing his exposed body and clothing. Two archers handle their bows at right, while a winding path, a walled town and water extend into the distance behind them.

wikidata-Q11787973.caption: Daylight from the open window illuminates a mother with her needlework and a serving girl beside the wicker cradle. Gleaming vessels, folded cloth and baskets make this tall, shadowy room a study in carefully distinguished textures.

wikidata-Q11789741.caption: Mary kneels beside the newborn Christ, whose radiance lights her face and open hands. Behind her, Joseph points out the child to shepherds at the doorway; an ox and donkey lean towards the manger.

wikidata-Q11791202.caption: A returning exile stands inside an open doorway, holding his hat. A woman rises from an upholstered chair toward him, while children at a table and a woman beside the piano turn to look.

wikidata-Q11821612.caption: Pale diagonal strokes veil a ploughed field and distant hills with rain. Van Gogh painted this view from his room at Saint-Rémy, setting the falling streaks against the field's sweeping furrows and enclosing wall.

wikidata-Q11824907.caption: Diego de Covarrubias wears a black cap and a white ecclesiastical garment over a dark collar. A gold-and-green pectoral cross hangs from a pale ribbon against the gathered fabric, beneath his grey beard.

wikidata-Q11918682.caption: A pale horse, tinted green, lowers its head to drink from a dark stream. Two bareback riders recede among trees behind it, while twisting branches and pale flowers frame the foreground.

wikidata-Q1192090.caption: A man in a tall black hat and a brown cloak leans against a plain wall. A glass of pale green drink stands on the ledge beside him, and a dark bottle lies on the ground near his feet.

wikidata-Q1192570.caption: Six blind men form a line across a village landscape, linked by hands and staffs. At right, the leader has fallen into a ditch and the next man tumbles after him, beneath trees near a church.

wikidata-Q1193312.caption: A player at left reaches behind his back for a concealed ace of diamonds. A woman points toward him while a servant holds wine, and the richly dressed young man at right studies his cards.

wikidata-Q11935346.caption: Within a rocky grotto, Mary rests a hand around the kneeling infant John while holding her other hand above Christ. Christ raises his hand in blessing, and the angel beside him points toward John and turns toward the viewer.

wikidata-Q1857132.caption: Snow covers sloping roofs and curved dormer tops in a view across closely packed buildings. Red chimney pots and tall dark flues rise above the pale surfaces. Bare trees and grey walls recede toward a hazy sky, while the nearest roof fills much of the foreground.

wikidata-Q24046967.caption: Red poppies spread across a green field beneath a blue sky crossed by broad pale strokes. Slender trees punctuate the far edge of the flowers, with a darker belt of vegetation beyond. Curved foreground strokes alternate with scattered dots of red.

wikidata-Q2405395.caption: Two Magi kneel before Mary and the Christ Child at a rocky cave, while the central king advances with a golden vessel. Joseph stands at right. A procession with riders and animals descends the narrow path at left, and angels gather above Mary.

wikidata-Q24055777.caption: Venus holds an apple and an arrow amid roses and honeysuckle. Yellow butterflies settle on the fruit, the arrow and her golden halo, while her steady gaze and pale skin stand out against the dense red flowers and dark foliage.

wikidata-Q24090.caption: Men crowd around Christ on stone steps, raising and crossing wooden staffs above his thorn-crowned head. His red mantle falls open across his shoulders. A crouching armored figure fills the foreground, while a pale bust and the inscription TIBERIVS CAESAR stand above the dark doorway.

wikidata-Q2409245.caption: A pale young woman in a tall black bonnet, edged with gold and tiny pearls, turns her face toward the viewer, her eyes glancing a little to the viewer's right. Three strands of black and gold beads hung with small pale drops circle her neck, and white fur trims her blue dress. Behind her are a grey-brown wall and brown wooden panelling.
wikidata-Q2409245.title: Portrait of a Young Lady

wikidata-Q24118.caption: A smiling boy stands barefoot beneath a broad, cloud-filled sky, carrying a wooden crutch across his shoulder. He holds a written appeal for alms in one hand and a black hat against his hip with the other. Low hills lie beyond his worn brown clothes.

wikidata-Q2413468.caption: A giant rises above the hills with his back turned and a fist raised. Far below, people, carts and animals scatter across the dark foreground; the difference in scale makes their panic seem almost impossible to escape.

wikidata-Q2413789.caption: Minerva, in a plumed helmet and yellow robes, runs in from the left with spear and shield. Ahead of her a mixed crowd, some misshapen and a few part animal, flees into a pond, while winged children scatter overhead. Arches of clipped hedge open onto distant hills, and three women float in a cloud at upper right.
wikidata-Q2413789.title: Minerva Expelling the Vices from the Garden of Virtue

wikidata-Q241455.caption: Dense ranks of riders, foot soldiers, spears and banners fill the battlefield beneath a sweeping view of mountains, towns and water. A crescent moon hangs at upper left, while orange sunlight breaks through clouds at right. A suspended inscribed tablet dominates the sky.

wikidata-Q2419166.caption: Christ guides Thomas’s hand toward the wound in his side as two other disciples lean close to watch. Light from the left catches Christ’s bare chest, the joined hands and the men’s furrowed brows against a dark background. Thomas bends forward in a worn brown garment.

wikidata-Q2420918.caption: The infant John reaches upward with an inscribed strip as the Christ Child grasps it from Mary’s arms. Mary lowers her gaze toward their hands, while Joseph watches from the shadowed left side. A pink rose rests on the ledge beneath the child’s bare foot.

wikidata-Q2423345.caption: Philip IV faces the viewer in a dark doublet beneath a pale, sharply angled collar. His curled mustache and shoulder-length hair frame the illuminated face. Broad gray strokes describe the chest against a dark background with narrow vertical bands visible at right.

wikidata-Q24249.caption: Mary rests her hand on a white rabbit against the blue folds of her mantle as Saint Catherine holds the Christ Child beside her. A shepherd sits near a flock at right. Yellow bands of sky stretch above distant blue mountains, fields and a slender tower.

wikidata-Q2425901.caption: Mary sits on a white bed against the wall as Gabriel extends a stem of lilies toward her. White clothing and pale walls surround their golden halos, while a blue curtain and red embroidered hanging bring strong color into the narrow room. Flames surround Gabriel’s bare feet.

wikidata-Q2426058.caption: A young woman crowned with leafy sprigs takes a bearded centaur by the hair. She wears a white patterned dress under a dark green mantle and holds a tall gilded battle axe upright. The centaur, a bow in one hand and a quiver on his back, stands beside a rocky outcrop; a small ship sails on the water behind.

wikidata-Q2427320.caption: A haloed woman in a red dress and dark blue mantle holds up a see-through veil with one raised hand and pinches its other end near her chest. Below, a naked baby lies on a white sheet against a pillow, stretching both arms up toward the cloth. Behind her on the right, a bearded older man with a halo looks down, his hands folded. The background is a deep, dark green.

wikidata-Q2428778.caption: Dürer turns his face toward the viewer beneath a red tasseled cap, his long hair curling over his shoulders. He holds a spiny green plant near the lower edge. A finely pleated pale shirt and dark garment edged with red stand out against the almost black background, with a date and inscription above his head.

wikidata-Q2429754.caption: Cupid sleeps on his side, his head at the right and bent legs extending left. Light picks out his face, rounded torso and limbs against a dark background. One hand rests above his body, while the other lies near an arrow; a feathered wing spreads beneath his arm.

wikidata-Q2438357.caption: Two figures embrace on a crumpled white sheet surrounded by an angular brown landscape. The man wears a dark robe and holds the red-haired woman’s head and shoulder; her patterned red dress and pale legs extend across the folds. His face has wide, open eyes, rather than the exposed skull suggested by the title.

wikidata-Q2448065.caption: A long-haired young Christ in a blue-green robe is hemmed in by six older men, most of them bearded, set close against a dark ground. He holds one finger of his left hand with his right, while a pair of pale, bony hands reaches toward his from the right. Books crowd the front: a closed one at lower left with a slip of paper caught in its edge, and an open one with fanned pages at lower centre, held by the bald man at lower right.

wikidata-Q2450139.caption: Two barefoot boys sit eating fruit in a dark, sheltered corner. The boy at left lifts a bunch of grapes above his open mouth while holding a melon slice; the other looks toward him with a cut melon and knife across his lap. Torn clothes, a wicker basket and scattered rind fill the foreground.

wikidata-Q2452858.caption: Mary sits in a red dress and broad blue mantle, supporting the standing Christ Child as he takes the slender cross held by the kneeling young John. wikidata-Q2453980.caption: John the Baptist lies on a grassy ledge in a pinkish-red robe, his head propped on one hand while the other points downward. Beside him rises a fantastical plant with a large pale globe, thorny tendrils and birds. At lower right a white lamb lies at the foot of the grey rock below his hand. Behind them spreads a wide green landscape of trees, small animals and pale rock formations.

wikidata-Q2456003.caption: Mary looks upward with her hands crossed over her chest, wearing a white dress and deep blue mantle. A crescent moon curves beneath the hem amid clouds and numerous child angels. Golden light surrounds her head, while darker clouds and overlapping figures gather along the right side.

wikidata-Q24569472.caption: Mary stands with her palms joined in prayer, a white dress beneath a dark blue mantle, against a golden clouded background. Winged heads surround her upper body, while child angels gather beneath the crescent moon at her feet, carrying branches and flowers.

wikidata-Q2459266.caption: The man turns his eyes to the side, away from our gaze. A loosely tied white cravat interrupts his dark coat, while uneven light picks out his forehead, cheek and greying beard against the muted background.

wikidata-Q2459887.caption: Christ turns toward a bearded man who leans in from the right, holding a coin between them. Christ’s face is shown at a three-quarter angle, while the other man appears in profile. Their hands meet near the lower edge, beneath a bright red tunic, dark mantle and pale sleeve against a dark background.

wikidata-Q2466780.caption: Venus stands in blue-green water, gathering her long reddish-gold hair between both hands. Her body turns left while her head looks to the right. A small scallop shell floats beside her at lower left, beneath a pale pink horizon and cloudy blue sky.

wikidata-Q2467141.caption: Mary bends towards the Christ Child as he climbs from his cradle into her arms. At the left, Elizabeth supports the young John the Baptist; above them, an angel holds a wreath of flowers over Mary, while Joseph leans forward in the shadows.

wikidata-Q2471800.caption: An older woman holds a wooden spoon above two eggs cooking in a red earthenware pot, with another egg in her other hand. wikidata-Q247282.caption: Apollo, crowned with leaves and surrounded by rays, raises a finger as he addresses Vulcan and four workers in the forge. wikidata-Q2478403.caption: A young woman faces left in strict profile, her golden-brown hair bound with white ribbons. She wears a pale pleated bodice with red sleeves and patterned trim. Flowers and butterflies surround her against dark foliage and a blue sky.

wikidata-Q2479220.caption: A richly dressed woman sits beside a table with an open book, one hand across her chest and the other resting near the pages. A young attendant seen from behind offers her a shell-shaped goblet. An older woman is barely visible in the dark background.

wikidata-Q2480921.caption: Mary sits with the Christ Child beneath a patterned canopy, flanked by Saint Donatian in a blue cope and Saint George in shining armor. wikidata-Q24860753.caption: Eugenia Primavesi faces forward in a loose gown covered with red, violet and green floral shapes. Her hands hang beside the patterned fabric. A rounded green field of flowers frames her head against the yellow background, with a separate dark bird motif at upper right.

wikidata-Q2500226.caption: Two men carry the dead Christ in a white cloth, his head and one arm hanging, toward a dark opening in the rock at left. A woman with loose fair hair holds his hand. wikidata-Q2502068.caption: Solomon sits on an elevated throne between dark columns, extending both hands toward the disputants below. wikidata-Q2503581.caption: Mary sits between two arched openings onto a green landscape, the Christ Child on her lap. Mary looks down, one arm around John, her other hand holding a fold of blue cloth beside Christ.

wikidata-Q2504917.caption: A green sculpted group of mourners supports the dead Christ beneath a cross. Gauguin brings the stone monument and everyday life into the same sharply coloured landscape.

wikidata-Q2513438.caption: Four dancers join hands in a circle as the winged figure of Time plays a stringed instrument at right. A child blows bubbles at lower left, and another holds an hourglass beside Time. Above them, Apollo’s horse-drawn chariot crosses the clouds behind Aurora, who scatters flowers.

wikidata-Q2515309.caption: A long-haired young man in a black cap and a black tunic with wide red sleeves looks straight out. wikidata-Q2516599.caption: Gabriel and Mary face one another across two panels, painted in pale gray as if they were stone statuettes. Gabriel raises a hand, Mary holds an open book, and a dove hovers above her. Their bases project across the painted red-marble surrounds of the dark niches.

wikidata-Q2517970.caption: Snow covers a low, dilapidated shelter beneath the twisted trunks and bare shoots of pollarded willows. A dark wooden door leans across the open entrance. Dead grass and fallen branches break through the snow in the foreground, and no people or animals appear.

wikidata-Q2520343.caption: A young man in white briefs stands with his hands on his hips and his gaze lowered. One foot steps forward across the blue-gray ground. Short patches of pink, green and blue shape both his body and the bare landscape behind him.

A woman lies across the foreground beside a small child, while an older man is carried away at the right.

wikidata-Q2528177.caption: Actaeon raises his hands beside a red curtain as he discovers Diana and her attendants bathing among stone ruins. Each foot is nailed separately to a wooden support, and thin streams of blood run down the cross beneath his hands and feet.

wikidata-Q2529703.title: Portrait of Émile Zola
wikidata-Q2529703.caption: Émile Zola sits in a patterned armchair, holding an open illustrated book while looking to the right. A Japanese screen stands behind him, and three reproductions hang above his crowded desk. His black coat contrasts with the pale pages, papers and inkwell beside him.

wikidata-Q2529918.caption: A knight in dark armour and a plumed helmet, on a rearing white horse, swings a curved sword over his head. At the right a woman in a pink dress runs off up a green slope.

wikidata-Q2529962.caption: Perseus stands beside Andromeda, loosening her bonds with the help of two small winged figures. At the left, others clamber around Pegasus; the defeated sea monster lies below the rocky ledge, its open mouth still visible in the surf.

wikidata-Q2535486.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle over a pink dress, holds the naked Christ Child against her, her cheek pressed to his. Her eyes are lowered, while the child's gaze goes out of the picture. Behind them, low on each side, lie water, hills and pale buildings under a clear blue sky.

wikidata-Q2535563.caption: The cardinal turns towards us in a red cap and shimmering red cape, its fine patterns traced by the light. His white sleeve cuts across the bottom of the portrait, balancing the pale face against a dark green background.

wikidata-Q2537138.caption: A young man holds a green parasol above a seated woman in a blue bodice and bright yellow skirt. She turns toward the viewer with a folded fan in her outstretched hand. wikidata-Q3207251.caption: A dark nude figure holds a flute horizontally among rising snakes; a pale moon lights the sky above water, a pink bird and dense layers of foliage.

wikidata-Q3208041.caption: Christ sits at the centre of a crowded supper table beneath a dark hanging curtain; Judas, seen from behind, twists on a pale stool in the foreground.

wikidata-Q3208135.title: The Dance of Life
wikidata-Q3208135.caption: A couple in red and black embraces on a green shoreline lawn, flanked by solitary women in white and black; other pairs dance beneath the moon and its reflection.

wikidata-Q3208312.caption: Napoleon extends his arm from a raised platform as soldiers lift their hands and eagle-topped standards toward him; red curtains frame the court at the left.

wikidata-Q3208973.title: Arii Matamoe (The Royal End)
wikidata-Q3208973.collection: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles
wikidata-Q3208973.caption: A severed head rests on a pale cushion beside red flowers; a seated woman holds her head in her hands behind it, amid painted wall patterns and carved figures.

wikidata-Q3210257.title: Bardi Altarpiece
wikidata-Q3210257.caption: Mary holds the Child on a carved throne between John the Baptist and John the Evangelist; tall white lilies rise above a dense enclosure of leaves and flowers.

wikidata-Q3210258.caption: The Child leans out from his mother's hold, one arm reaching round to her shoulder, and smiles straight at us. Mary looks down under a sheer veil. She holds one of his feet in her hand; the other stands on the ledge in front. Behind them a low landscape runs under a grey, clouded sky, with a single hill at the right.

wikidata-Q3210764.title: La Monomane de l’envie
wikidata-Q3210764.caption: A woman in a pale ruffled bonnet looks to the side, her face brightly lit against dark clothing and background; a red scarf opens below her chin.

wikidata-Q3210778.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire
wikidata-Q3210778.caption: Mont Sainte-Victoire rises above a patchwork of green fields, trees and pale buildings; pink and ochre rock faces are divided by dark blue contours.

wikidata-Q3211055.caption: Mary kneels before the Child lying on her blue mantle, while five angels sing and play lutes beside a stone shed; Joseph and two shepherds occupy the right.

wikidata-Q3211900.caption: A young woman in a ribboned bonnet leans forward in a theatre box, holding flowers; her companion’s face is partly hidden, and tiers of spectators fill the left background.

wikidata-Q3212142.caption: A gutted ray hangs above a kitchen ledge holding fish, oysters and utensils; a cat steps among the shells at the left, opposite dark pots and a draped white cloth.

wikidata-Q3212193.title: Queen Mariana of Austria
wikidata-Q3212193.caption: Mariana stands in a wide black gown traced with silver trim, one hand on a chair and the other holding a white cloth; a red curtain hangs above her.

wikidata-Q3212195.caption: Queen Margarita of Austria rides a chestnut horse in an elaborate dark dress and a high lace ruff. The dense patterns of her clothing and the horse's covering contrast with the softly painted garden, fountain and distant hills at the left.

wikidata-Q3212360.caption: Thérèse des Hours sits with her back turned on a stone terrace, wearing a pink striped dress and black apron; pale village buildings appear between dark trees beyond her.

wikidata-Q3212522.title: The Rue Montorgueil in Paris, Celebration of 30 June 1878
wikidata-Q3212522.caption: Red, white and blue flags project from both sides of a Paris street; viewed from above, the crowd forms a dense trail of small coloured strokes between the buildings.

wikidata-Q3212684.title: The Holy Family under an Oak Tree
wikidata-Q3212684.caption: The two children, Mary's inclined head and Joseph's leaning figure form a rising diagonal beneath the oak; a lettered scroll links their hands above the cloth-lined cradle.

wikidata-Q321303.caption: Eden at the left opens into a crowded landscape of naked figures, oversized fruit and fantastic structures at the centre. At the right, the brightness gives way to a dark Hell where musical instruments become implements of torment; familiar objects turn strange as the eye moves across the triptych.

wikidata-Q3213777.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child within a ring of bare branches hung with golden letters A. Her deep red mantle stands out against the darkness, while the tree's interlacing twigs draw a delicate, thorny enclosure around the pair.

wikidata-Q3220204.caption: A kiss at the left doorway interrupts the woman's reach toward a striped cloth; her brightly folded dress stands out against dark curtains, while other women occupy the adjoining room.

wikidata-Q3220733.title: Café-Concert at Les Ambassadeurs
wikidata-Q3220733.caption: A singer in red extends her arm above a foreground crowded with hats, heads and an instrument neck; bright columns and round lights separate the stage from dark foliage.

wikidata-Q3220982.title: Field with Irises near Arles
wikidata-Q3220982.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
wikidata-Q3220982.caption: Dark-outlined irises spread their pointed leaves across the foreground; beyond the yellow-green meadow, a row of trees partly conceals red roofs and pale towers beneath a textured blue-green sky.

wikidata-Q3221348.caption: Christ displays his wounded palms while two brightly winged angels attend him on a carved stone sarcophagus; empty crosses rise above the small figures in the landscape at the right.

wikidata-Q3221859.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
wikidata-Q3221859.caption: Christ and the Father hold a floral crown above Mary's lowered eyes; the dove spreads its wings in radiant light, while winged children and small heads gather beneath her blue cloak.

wikidata-Q3221991.caption: Saint Andrew hangs from a vertical cross as a man reaches towards the ropes binding his wrist. Light picks out their bodies against the dark background, while the faces below turn upwards towards the saint.

wikidata-Q32234.caption: Diana, with a small gold crescent moon in her hair, sits on a rock in a yellow dress while a kneeling woman in a purple skirt washes her bare foot beside a metal basin and a white cloth. A companion in a red top and blue skirt sits next to her holding one of her own feet; another in black stands behind with her head bowed, and a fourth, seen from behind and wrapped in orange drapery, sits at the left. A brown and white dog sits at lower left beside a spiky plant.

wikidata-Q3223625.title: Young Saint John the Baptist with a Ram
wikidata-Q3223625.caption: The smiling youth turns toward the viewer while embracing the ram's horned head; bright flesh, white cloth and red-orange drapery stand out against a dark setting with visible leaves and branches.

wikidata-Q3223929.title: Laundry (Le Linge)
wikidata-Q3223929.caption: A woman squeezes wet cloth above a wooden pail while a child holds its handle; hanging white laundry, dense flowers and her blue dress fill the garden scene.

wikidata-Q3224308.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
wikidata-Q3224308.caption: Joseph, at left in blue and yellow, and Mary, at right in pink and blue, bring their hands together in front of a bearded high priest in a tall cap. Men crowd behind Joseph, where a youth in red hose bends a stick; women stand behind Mary. Beyond a wide pale square, a many-sided temple with small domes and arched side porches rises on steps, its central door open to a distant landscape.

wikidata-Q3225258.title: Mars and Venus, called Parnassus
wikidata-Q3225258.caption: On top of a natural rock arch, a man in armour with a spear stands beside a naked woman, with a bed and a screen of fruit trees behind them. Below, women in red, blue, yellow and white dance on the grass. A youth plays a lyre at the far left; at the far right a young man in a red hat stands beside a spotted winged horse.

wikidata-Q3226847.caption: Abraham turns towards the angel, his knife lowered beside Isaac’s leg. The boy remains bound on the wood as the ram appears at the left; the concentrated light makes the pause in the threatened sacrifice unusually clear.

wikidata-Q3227448.title: The Suicide (Le Suicidé)
wikidata-Q3227448.collection: Emil Bührle Collection, on long-term loan at Kunsthaus Zürich
wikidata-Q3227448.caption: A man lies across a bed with his head tipped back and a pistol hanging from one hand; a red stain marks his pale shirt, while blue-grey walls and red bedding surround him.

wikidata-Q3227830.caption: Venus sits above a crowded company of water nymphs and tritons; winged children circle a looping striped cloth overhead, while fanciful fish and curling waves fill the foreground.

wikidata-Q3228069.caption: A man reaches up to slide the bolt while holding a woman close beside the bedroom door. Her raised hand and turned head make the encounter difficult to read; a strong diagonal of light connects their gestures to the rumpled bedding and heavy red curtain.

wikidata-Q3228387.title: Portrait of Susanna Lunden (?) ('Le Chapeau de Paille')
wikidata-Q3228387.caption: A broad feathered hat shades the woman's face above her brightly lit neck; crossed arms, red sleeves and a dark wrap fill the lower half against blue sky and grey clouds.

wikidata-Q3231193.caption: A boy blows through a slender straw, watching a soap bubble swell at its tip. He holds a blue-and-white bowl in his other hand; broad strokes describe his pale jacket, while a few small highlights give the bubble its fragile roundness.

wikidata-Q3231771.title: Poppy Field
wikidata-Q3231771.caption: Red poppies spread across the left-hand slope as two pairs of walkers appear near and far; a blue parasol marks the foreground group beneath an open, cloud-filled sky.

wikidata-Q3234845.title: Models (Poseuses)
wikidata-Q3234845.caption: Three nude models show back, frontal and side views in Seurat's studio; La Grande Jatte hangs at left, while the seated figure at right handles a green stocking.

wikidata-Q3235403.caption: One woman holds a shallow dish across her body while her companion carries pink flowers at the right. Their blue clothing and warm skin stand out against broad patches of green and yellow, with dark contours giving the figures a still, solid presence.

wikidata-Q3235872.title: The Three Graces
wikidata-Q3235872.caption: Cranach’s three Graces turn through back and frontal views against black; gold chains, sheer veils and a red feathered hat sharpen the contrast with their pale bodies.

wikidata-Q323753.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
wikidata-Q323753.caption: A huge oval heaven, tier on tier of seated saints and angels on gold, rises to Christ and the kneeling Virgin at its top. Below, apostles crowd round an open tomb full of white lilies on a dark ledge, a man in red kneels at the left and a woman in black at the right, and a river valley runs back to a domed city.

wikidata-Q3246755.title: The Snowstorm or Winter
wikidata-Q3246755.caption: Cloaked travellers huddle through falling snow beside a pack animal laden with a slaughtered pig; a black-and-white dog stands below them and a bare tree bends across the grey sky.

wikidata-Q32496.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath Holding King David’s Letter
wikidata-Q32496.caption: Bathsheba lowers her head while holding David’s letter beside her knee; an attendant tends her extended foot below the glow of skin, white cloth and golden-brown fabric.

wikidata-Q325267.title: Moses with the Tablets of the Law
wikidata-Q325267.caption: Moses lifts dark tablets inscribed in Hebrew above his head; pale sleeves frame his lit face, while a brown cloak and ochre-grey background surround the solitary figure.

wikidata-Q325981.title: Réunion de famille (Family Reunion)
wikidata-Q325981.caption: Bazille’s family poses on a shaded terrace, with the artist at far left; pale patterned dresses and a vivid blue skirt stand against dark jackets and the bright countryside beyond.

wikidata-Q326887.caption: A woman in a gleaming white satin dress holds the door handle as a soldier in black leans towards her. His outstretched arm braces against the door, and a small dog waits at their feet; the contrasting fabrics give this farewell much of its tension.

wikidata-Q3275305.title: The Madonna and Child with Saints John the Baptist and Jerome
wikidata-Q3275305.caption: John the Baptist points up toward the Virgin and the Child’s projecting foot; below their burst of light, Jerome sleeps in red drapery among dark leaves.

wikidata-Q3276176.caption: Mary nurses the Christ Child beneath a canopy opened by two angels. Peter and John the Baptist stand at the left, with the doctor-saints Cosmas and Damian at the right; a gold jug of flowers marks the centre of the carefully arranged gathering.

wikidata-Q3276180.caption: Within a painted roundel, Mary supports the red-clothed Christ Child as he turns his smiling face toward her and reaches across her blue cloak.
wikidata-Q3276180.title: Madonna and Child

wikidata-Q327780.caption: Mary sits in a green landscape with the naked Christ Child on her lap, her arm around him. He rests one hand on her blue mantle at the shoulder and hooks the other into the neckline of her red dress, while turning his face out toward us. She looks down at him, a small open book raised in her other hand.

wikidata-Q328079.caption: Mary carries the Christ Child forward on clouds between Saints Sixtus and Barbara, framed by parted green curtains; two winged children lean on the ledge below.

wikidata-Q328523.caption: An orange sun and its broken reflection punctuate the misty harbour at Le Havre, with dark ferrymen’s boats in the foreground and cranes, chimneys and masts behind.

wikidata-Q3291664.title: Two Old People Eating (Dos viejos comiendo)
wikidata-Q3291664.caption: Two aged figures emerge from a nearly black background: the one at the left holds a spoon over a bowl, while the other bends forward with a deeply shadowed face.

wikidata-Q3292681.title: Portrait of Madame de Senonnes
wikidata-Q3292681.caption: Madame de Senonnes sits on a yellow satin sofa in a red velvet dress, surrounded by jewellery and pale fabric, with the back of her head reflected in a dark mirror.

wikidata-Q3292964.caption: Maria Anna's auburn curls rise above a wide grey ruff, framing her pale face between two distinct textures. Gold-patterned clothing fills the lower part of the portrait, while the plain brown background keeps attention on her steady gaze.

wikidata-Q3296800.title: Venus with Cupid
wikidata-Q3296800.artist: Venus Painter (workshop of Hans Holbein the Younger)
wikidata-Q3296800.caption: Venus faces the viewer before a green curtain, extending an open hand over a pale parapet while Cupid leans forward beside her with a long arrow.

wikidata-Q3312011.caption: Eleven nude women stand, sit and recline among diagonal tree trunks, their bodies outlined in blue beneath a dense blue sky; a small dog and fruit occupy the foreground.

wikidata-Q3319184.title: Myself: Portrait – Landscape
wikidata-Q3319184.caption: Rousseau stands on a Paris riverbank in a black suit and beret, holding a palette and brush; a flag-covered ship, iron bridge and distant Eiffel Tower surround his monumental figure.

wikidata-Q3320114.title: The Monarch of the Glen
wikidata-Q3320114.caption: A stag stands on a grassy Highland slope, its broad antlers outlined against a cloudy sky and its sharply modelled coat set against misty mountains.

wikidata-Q3333210.caption: Menippus turns his bearded face toward the viewer above a dark cloak, standing beside books, a rolled paper and an earthenware jug in a spare interior.

wikidata-Q3335976.title: Napoleon on the Battlefield of Eylau (9 February 1807)
wikidata-Q3335976.caption: Napoleon extends an arm from horseback amid wounded soldiers on a snowy battlefield, while bodies fill the foreground and distant formations recede beneath a dark, smoky sky.

wikidata-Q334360.caption: Bare oaks surround a ruined Gothic church in a dark cemetery, where a small funeral procession approaches the doorway beneath a pale evening sky and a thin crescent moon.

wikidata-Q334604.title: Heart of the Andes
wikidata-Q334604.caption: Dense trees frame a river and bright waterfall beneath a broad mountain range, with a distant snow-covered summit rising beyond the sunlit valley.

wikidata-Q3348220.caption: Dead gladiators are dragged into a dim chamber beneath the arena, their bodies catching the strongest light. Spectators cluster at the left while a woman crouches apart at the right; Luna gives the aftermath of public spectacle a weight and scale of its own.

wikidata-Q3349704.caption: The officer twists in his saddle as his grey horse rears, his curved sabre pointing down beside its flank. A spotted saddlecloth and flashes of gold braid stand out amid the smoke, giving the turning bodies a sharp, restless energy.

wikidata-Q3356655.title: Orpheus (Orphée)
wikidata-Q3356655.caption: A young woman looks down at Orpheus’s head resting on his lyre, her richly patterned clothing set against dark rocks and a pale, distant landscape.

wikidata-Q3380051.caption: Philip IV stands in a rose-red costume covered with silver embroidery, holding a baton and a broad-brimmed black hat. At a distance the decoration looks precise; closer up, quick touches of pale paint break into a lively surface around the still face.

wikidata-Q3387944.title: Pierrot (formerly known as Gilles)
wikidata-Q3387944.caption: Pierrot stands frontally in a loose white costume, his arms hanging at his sides; four other figures and a donkey appear lower down among the surrounding trees.

wikidata-Q3399375.caption: Ambroise Vollard sits with his legs crossed and a book resting in his lap. Cézanne builds the face, brown suit and surrounding room from related patches of colour, making the figure seem both solidly present and inseparable from the painted surface.

wikidata-Q3399385.title: Eugène Boch (The Poet)
wikidata-Q3399385.caption: Eugène Boch’s narrow face and yellow jacket stand out against a deep blue ground dotted with stars, the contours and brushstrokes keeping his head sharply defined.

wikidata-Q3399411.title: Portrait of a Young Woman with a White Headdress
wikidata-Q3399411.caption: A young woman in a large white linen headdress, pinned and folded into wide wings, looks out at the viewer against a black background. She wears a grey-brown gown with a dark neckline, and her ringed hands rest one over the other at the lower edge.

wikidata-Q3399413.caption: A man in a tall, wide-brimmed fur hat turns his head towards the left. He wears a dark purple robe patterned in gold, with reddish fur at the neck and cuffs and a gold chain collar from which a small pendant hangs. His right hand, a ring on its little finger, grips a pale wooden staff.

wikidata-Q3399420.caption: Charles VII is shown half-length between white curtains drawn back beneath a red fringed valance, against green cloth. He wears a dark blue hat embroidered with gold zigzags and a fur-trimmed red robe, and his hands rest together on a patterned gold cloth.

wikidata-Q3399438.caption: Giuliano de' Medici turns his head to the right, almost in profile, with his eyes lowered. He wears a dark red garment with a thin white collar. Behind him a pale blue opening, edged at the sides by light strips, sits within a broad greyish-brown surround.

wikidata-Q3399440.caption: Louis XIV stands beneath red drapery in blue fleur-de-lis robes lined with ermine, extending one stockinged leg beside a cushion bearing royal regalia.

wikidata-Q3399447.title: Napoleon in Imperial Costume (sketch)
wikidata-Q3399447.caption: In David’s sketch, Napoleon stands before a gilded throne in red coronation robes and a gold laurel wreath, holding an eagle-topped sceptre and the hand of justice.

wikidata-Q3399451.caption: Gris breaks Picasso’s face and jacket into intersecting blue, grey and brown planes, preserving the painter’s palette and a dedication at the lower right.

wikidata-Q3399452.caption: Margareta van Eyck, her face turned slightly to our left, meets our eyes from beneath a white veil with crinkled, pleated edges. She wears a red gown lined with grey fur and gathered by a broad green belt; at the bottom edge a gold ring shows on her right hand.

wikidata-Q3399483.caption: Don Carlos stands in black court dress, holding a broad-brimmed hat in one hand and a loose glove in the other. A gold chain crosses his chest, while the pale collar, bare hand and shifting patterns in the fabric keep the dark costume from becoming a single flat shape.

wikidata-Q3399485.caption: Henriette de Verninac sits sideways on a decorated wooden chair, turning her face towards the viewer above a white dress and a gold-coloured shawl.

wikidata-Q3399492.caption: Cardinal Bibbiena turns towards the viewer in a red cap and patterned red cape, holding a folded letter above the broad white sleeve of his official dress.

wikidata-Q3399498.title: Portrait of a Man, possibly Cardinal Niccolò Albergati
wikidata-Q3399498.caption: An older man, possibly Cardinal Niccolò Albergati, turns to the left in a red robe, his lined face and short grey hair set against a dark blue background.

wikidata-Q3399514.caption: Pius VII sits in a gilded chair against a plain dark background, wearing red robes and a gold-embroidered stole while holding a folded paper.

wikidata-Q3402890.caption: A goat with red cloth wound around its horns stands on a pale, salt-crusted shore. Bones lie nearby, and the still water meets a long ridge of purple mountains; the clear detail makes the animal's isolation feel especially stark.

wikidata-Q3412132.caption: Moonlight breaks through clouds above two small fishing boats, illuminating rough waves while a lantern glows warmly in the nearer boat.

wikidata-Q34191856.caption: Andromeda is chained to a rock at the left while Perseus dives headfirst towards a sea monster, his red drapery looping across the sky above the dark water.

wikidata-Q3425144.caption: Two boxers lean into a close struggle above the ring ropes, their brightly painted bodies surrounded by spectators emerging from a dark room.

wikidata-Q3428040.title: Madonna in Glory with Saints (Trivulzio Altarpiece)
wikidata-Q3428040.caption: The Virgin sits with the naked Child on her lap inside a glowing oval of clouds and small child heads, between two trees hung with fruit. Two saints stand at each side of her. At the bottom, three young angels sing from a sheet of paper next to a small organ.

wikidata-Q3428050.title: God the Father with Singing Angels (central panel)
wikidata-Q3428050.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
wikidata-Q3428050.caption: A long-haired, bearded figure in a jewelled tiara and red cope rises from banks of cloud against a gold ground. He raises his right hand and rests his left on a large crystal globe, gripping a tall staff topped with a jewelled cross. Three winged angels on each side sing from open books.

wikidata-Q3432673.caption: A girl sits facing the viewer on the edge of a pale bed, her hands crossed low over her knees, beside a large dark shadow rising across the wall.

wikidata-Q3439636.caption: Ruggiero leans from a winged hippogriff to drive his lance into a sea monster, while Angelica stands chained to a rock above the foaming water.

wikidata-Q3449722.title: The Skiff (La Yole)
wikidata-Q3449722.caption: Two women sit in a long orange skiff on blue water, an oar extending towards the foreground as a white sail and a railway bridge appear across the river.

wikidata-Q3454959.title: Regattas at Argenteuil
wikidata-Q3454959.caption: Pale triangular sails gather beside Argenteuil’s green riverbank, their reflections broken into broad strokes across the blue Seine beneath red-roofed houses.

wikidata-Q3463869.title: Saint John the Baptist (Corsini)
wikidata-Q3463869.caption: Saint John turns his shadowed face to the right, his bare torso lit above red drapery as one hand rests on the reed cross running across the foreground.

wikidata-Q3463877.collection: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City
wikidata-Q3463877.caption: Saint John sits beneath dark trees with his head lowered, holding a reed cross beside a scarlet cloak and fur-edged clothing as light falls across his arms and knees.

wikidata-Q3463920.title: Saint Jerome Penitent in the Desert
wikidata-Q3463920.caption: A white-bearded Jerome with a halo sits on a rock at the mouth of a cave, holding prayer beads and a closed red book. A broad red hat and two wooden sandals lie on the ledge below him. Books rest on a rock shelf, a lion's head looks out from the shadow beneath it, an owl perches on the summit, and a landscape with trees opens at the right.

wikidata-Q3464088.collection: Wadsworth Atheneum Museum of Art, Hartford
wikidata-Q3464088.caption: Saint Serapion hangs with wrists bound and head bowed to the left, his closed eyes and pale face emerging above broad folds of white cloth against darkness.

wikidata-Q3476580.collection: Neue Galerie New York and Private Collection
wikidata-Q3476580.caption: Two women in red and blue gowns and tall feathered hats stand amid blue-coated men, their pointed outlines set against a tilted pink street and vivid green buildings.

wikidata-Q3505997.caption: Suzanne Manet sits in profile at the piano with both hands on the keys, her black dress and pale sleeves set against a panelled wall beneath a mantel clock and mirror.

wikidata-Q3535914.caption: Christ opens his hands and looks up towards an angel at the left, his white robe and blue mantle brightly lit within the dark garden where the apostles sleep.

wikidata-Q3541051.caption: Lemminkäinen's mother kneels beside his pale, motionless body, one hand resting on his chest as she looks upwards. Skulls and small flowers lie on the stony bank, while a swan floats on the black water beyond the red rocks.

wikidata-Q3543882.title: The Fates (Atropos)
wikidata-Q3543882.caption: Four dark figures float above a tree-lined landscape: one holds a small doll-like form, another raises a circular object, and the figure at the right lifts scissors beside a raised hand.

wikidata-Q3543898.caption: Christ raises his face beneath a crown of thorns, his pale body stretched across a wooden cross against a dark background, with both feet resting on a small ledge.

wikidata-Q354396.caption: Adele Bloch-Bauer’s pale face and folded hands emerge from a gold field of spirals, rectangles and eye-shaped motifs, with a broad patterned gown spreading across the lower canvas.

wikidata-Q3549784.caption: Two figures in pale carnival costumes stand beneath a full moon among bare trees, beside a dark hut with a small face at its edge and a lamp rising behind its roof.

wikidata-Q3553389.caption: A man in a bright blue chaperon with jagged, hanging ends turns his face towards the left. He wears a dark garment with reddish-brown fur and holds up a small gold ring between thumb and finger, while his other hand rests along the bottom edge. A faint AD monogram sits in the upper left corner.

wikidata-Q3555076.caption: Four nymphs surround a dark-haired satyr at a woodland pool, grasping his head and arms while a pale figure seen from behind draws him towards the water.

wikidata-Q3556817.caption: Diana sits on blue and white drapery beside a crouching companion, with a quiver and two dogs to the left and a heap of dead game beneath her bow at the right.

wikidata-Q3558043.caption: Across a wide bay, a young man in a winged helmet stands on the back of a huge tusked sea monster, his sword drawn back over his head. At left, a half-draped young woman is bound to a stump by the rocks, and below her a group hide their faces or lie on the ground. At right, a crowd gathers beside two players with oddly shaped instruments, and high in the sky an armoured figure flies in on winged feet.

wikidata-Q3591505.caption: Aesop stands in a loose brown robe with a book at his side, his grey-haired face turned towards the viewer above worn shoes and scattered objects on the floor.

wikidata-Q3604080.collection: Centre Pompidou, Musée national d’art moderne, Paris
wikidata-Q3604080.caption: A large pink circle edged in red overlaps an ochre quadrilateral against a dark blue-violet ground, with smaller coloured circles clustered around a central grey square.

wikidata-Q3605057.title: Adam and Eve (after Titian)
wikidata-Q3605057.caption: Eve raises her hand to an apple offered by a child-headed serpent in the tree, while seated Adam reaches towards her beneath a red parrot and above a fox at her feet.

wikidata-Q3605532.caption: Mary sits at the centre with the Christ Child on her lap, under a rough roof of poles and straw slung between a bare tree and broken stone walls. Kings and their followers in red, gold, blue and black robes crowd in from both sides, some kneeling; at the left a youth sets a crown on a man in red. Horsemen ride over the hills behind, and a star shines at the top.

wikidata-Q3605536.caption: Mary, in dark blue beside a pink open-sided shed, holds out the child to three haloed kings: an old man kneeling, a man standing in green, and a young man kneeling in red. Two crowns lie on the ground. A crowd of travellers in turbans and tall hats, with a white horse, a camel and a hound, fills the right; shepherds rest on pale rocks above, and prophets and an Annunciation fill the gold spaces at the top.

wikidata-Q3605551.caption: Mary kneels before the child lying on cloth in front of an inscribed sarcophagus, with shepherds at the right and a long mounted procession winding through the landscape.

wikidata-Q3606261.caption: Two simplified figures in long garments stand amid broad areas of white, blue, yellow, green and red, their heads and clothing bounded by dark contours.

wikidata-Q3607539.caption: Five women sit among curved red sofas in a brothel salon, while a sixth stands cropped at the right; a foreground woman’s dark stockinged leg cuts across the broad empty seat.

wikidata-Q3607621.caption: The young halberdier grips his weapon upright and rests his other hand on his hip. A gold badge and pale feather decorate his red cap; the full cream sleeves, fine chain and bright red clothing below give his military pose an unexpectedly delicate finish.

wikidata-Q3609042.caption: A large black disc overlaps a larger blue circle with a pale glowing edge, surrounded by smaller coloured circles that overlap or stand apart against an uneven dark ground.

In the centre, the Virgin in a white veil and blue mantle joins her hands over the naked Child, asleep on a cushion, while small angels carry a red crown above her. wikidata-Q3842580.caption: Mary steadies the Christ Child, seated on a cushion above a wooden chest, between an aged Saint Jerome holding a crucifix and Saint Nicholas of Tolentino, a tall lily rising between them against a green curtain and a deep landscape.

wikidata-Q3842596.caption: Red cherub heads float in the clouds around the Madonna and Child, who turn inward toward each other above a low parapet with a landscape opening at either side.

wikidata-Q3842597.caption: The naked Christ Child stands on a green-marbled parapet before the Madonna, who holds him in her blue mantle, two tall poplars rising symmetrically beyond the green hanging behind them.

wikidata-Q3842604.caption: Mary sits on a high throne with the child on her lap, under a dark green canopy whose curtains two flying angels hold open. Two saints stand on each side; the one in a bishop's mitre, front right, looks out at us. At the foot of the throne two small winged boys sing from a scroll.

wikidata-Q3842605.caption: The Virgin, hands joined in prayer, has the Christ Child on her lap while St Anne holds up his raised arm; he reaches towards the kneeling infant John and his reed cross, and a bearded, haloed man stands apart beyond a wall.

wikidata-Q3842613.caption: The Virgin faces the viewer almost frontally, long hair falling over her red gown, while the Christ Child holds a small apple and a red carnation against a dark green ground streaked with fine light.

wikidata-Q3842620.caption: An angel crowned with roses holds up the Christ Child, who pinches the little finger of the hand Mary raises to her breast, while a second angel behind him looks straight out. Mary looks down. Her blue cloak has jewelled gold borders. Above a wall with mottled red panels, dark trees and a fan-leaved palm stand against the sky.
wikidata-Q3842620.title: The Virgin and Child with Two Angels

wikidata-Q3842637.caption: The Virgin sits in a flowering garden with the Child on her lap, a rose trellis behind her and a gold sky above. Angels fly overhead, read from a book, fill a basket with roses and gather round a tall golden fountain at upper left. Below right sits a crowned saint holding a wreath, with a wheel and a sword at the bottom edge.

wikidata-Q3842644.caption: The Virgin sits with the Child on a rocky seat between the gaunt Saint Jerome and Saint Louis of Toulouse in bishop's robes, a tall orange tree rising behind them over an open landscape.

wikidata-Q3842703.caption: The Virgin holds the sleeping Christ Child before an open blue sky, a vine with two grape clusters overhead and a golden band of zodiac signs curving above her shoulders.

wikidata-Q3842705.caption: The Virgin holds the Christ Child before a cloth of gold, a single pear resting on the parapet below and a wide landscape opening at either side.

wikidata-Q3842710.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress with a white veil under her hood, looks down at the naked Child she holds. He looks up at her, gripping her fingers with one hand and holding a sprig of small red berries in the other. At the right, an arched opening shows a brick wall.

wikidata-Q3842715.caption: The Virgin holds the Christ Child against a gold ground, his hand raised to her cheek, two angels leaning in from the upper corners.

wikidata-Q3842732.caption: The Virgin sits high on a throne with the Child on her lap and reaches a hand down toward a kneeling friar at left; a second friar holding a lily and a book stands behind him. At right a woman rests her foot on a wheel beside a bearded man in a red cloak who points. Columns frame the scene, with children's heads in a cloud above and two winged children flying at either side.

wikidata-Q3842748.caption: Against a dark ground the Virgin clasps the Christ Child, whose feet rest on the sill below and who looks out sadly with a small fruit in one hand; the red Greek letters naming the Mother of God stand at the upper corners.

wikidata-Q3842778.caption: The Virgin, in a red gown and white veil, steadies the Christ Child as he stands on a sill at the right before a green striped hanging, with open country and buildings visible at the left.

wikidata-Q3853758.caption: Lucretia, her chemise slipping from one shoulder, grasps a dagger and turns her face upward, a bearded man close behind her in the shadow.

wikidata-Q3853901.caption: Isabella d'Este wears a pearl-set, turban-like headdress and a dark gown with gold-embroidered, fur-trimmed sleeves, her hands resting low against a dark ground.

wikidata-Q3858720.caption: A procession crowds a brick bridge over a green Venetian canal while, below, the confraternity's leader, in white, rises from the water holding up the golden reliquary, watched by richly dressed women on the left bank and five kneeling men on the right.

wikidata-Q386034.caption: The Virgin, in blue before a red cloth, holds the Christ Child on a red cushion while a small yellow-green bird leans in at his shoulder, children crowd in at the lower right with a sprig of lilies of the valley, and two cherubs hold a wreath above her head.

wikidata-Q3860679.title: Claude Monet Reading
wikidata-Q3860679.caption: Monet, in a dark bowler hat, sits in profile smoking a long pipe and reading a folded newspaper, his warm face lit against a dark, softly brushed ground.

wikidata-Q3869871.caption: Two Tahitian women sit in a field of dry yellow grass, the nearer one cross-legged in a white top and a red-and-yellow patterned skirt with a flower in her hair, the other in a pale violet dress behind her, blue mountains rising beyond.

wikidata-Q3873324.caption: On a wooden table below a grey-green wall, onions with pale green shoots are heaped with a white cloth beside a dark bottle, a small glass and a knife.

wikidata-Q3873326.caption: Apples and oranges spill across white drapery between a shallow plate, a raised bowl and a flower-painted jug. The folds and patterned fabrics tilt and turn around the fruit, making the tabletop feel carefully constructed yet oddly unstable.

wikidata-Q3874247.caption: Lit by a candle that a maidservant shields with her hand, Peter in a white cloak denies knowing Christ while soldiers look on, and in the shadows at the right Christ is led away.

wikidata-Q3874360.caption: Across a field of muted greys, curved and angular shapes in red, blue, pink and white overlap with heavy black lines, a black bow-like arc at the upper left and a dark diagonal band through the centre.

wikidata-Q3874439.caption: A dog helps itself from the table while a pig noses through the disorder on the floor. Drinking, music and scattered possessions fill the room; Steen turns household chaos into a comic warning about excess.

wikidata-Q3877556.caption: A nude woman lies on her back across the full width of the canvas, one arm stretched above her head, against deep red patterned drapery and a blue-grey cloth.

wikidata-Q3877895.caption: Christ, a white cloth about his waist and a hoe in one hand, steps back from the kneeling Mary Magdalene, who reaches up toward him in a green landscape with a walled town on the hill behind.

wikidata-Q3877896.caption: Correggio's risen Christ, a blue mantle over his body and one arm raised, stands beneath a great tree while the kneeling Mary Magdalene, in a gold-brocade gown, looks up at him, a hoe leaning against the trunk behind.

wikidata-Q3879263.caption: A nude woman lies on her side on rumpled white sheets with her back to us, turning her head over her shoulder to look out; one knee is drawn up and the other leg stretched along the bed, against a dark green background.

wikidata-Q3879280.caption: A nude woman leans her head against her own shoulder with closed eyes, her body turned toward the viewer, a dark red chair beside her against a teal-green wall.

wikidata-Q3884945.caption: Christ kneels in prayer on a rocky ledge as cherubs carrying the instruments of the Passion hover on a cloud, three disciples lie asleep in the foreground, and Judas leads a band of soldiers down from the walled city.

wikidata-Q3885854.title: The Birth of the Milky Way
wikidata-Q3885854.caption: Juno, seated on clouds beside her gilded chariot, presses her breast as the infant Hercules reaches for it, a jet of milk streaming off into stars; Jupiter broods at the left with his eagle and thunderbolts, and her peacocks wait at the right.

wikidata-Q3888850.caption: A dark hill with a slender tower at its left rises against a deep blue sky, crossed in front by broad bands of red, yellow and violet, with a large white form and three pale round shapes above.

wikidata-Q3889223.caption: Three haloed saints stand on a marble floor before a balustrade and a wide landscape: the deacon Vincent in red velvet at left, James the Great at centre with a tall pilgrim's staff and his hat at his feet, and Eustace at right in a dark fur-trimmed tunic and red hose.
wikidata-Q3889223.title: Saints Vincent, James the Great and Eustace

wikidata-Q3889254.caption: Under a shell-topped throne with a red canopy held back by angels, the Virgin and Child sit enthroned, flanked by Saint Catherine, Saint Augustine and Saint Barnabas on the left and Saint John the Baptist, Saint Ignatius and the archangel Michael in armour on the right.

wikidata-Q3892842.caption: A still, lily-covered pool lies among tall oaks and beeches, a great withered tree leaning over the water at the right and a felled trunk lying in the foreground, with a small figure far off between the trunks.

wikidata-Q3897210.caption: Charon ferries a small soul across the broad blue river between Paradise on the left and Hell on the right. Green islands and clear water give way to a dark gate and distant fires, turning the landscape into a choice between two destinations.

wikidata-Q3898507.artist: Jan Brueghel the Elder and Peter Paul Rubens
wikidata-Q3898507.caption: In a dense green paradise Eve, one arm raised into the apple tree where the serpent coils, hands an apple to the seated Adam, while horses, deer, big cats, a peacock, an ostrich and countless birds fill the garden around them.

wikidata-Q3900760.caption: In a colonnaded city street under a blue, clouded sky, a crowd recoils from the plague-struck dead and dying — a woman lies dead at the centre with a child at her breast — while two men carry a body down the steps behind.

wikidata-Q3902309.caption: The Piazza San Marco opens in sharp perspective, the Campanile rising above the domes of the basilica, the colonnades of the Procuratie running down either side and small figures crossing the sunlit pavement.

wikidata-Q3904404.caption: The Virgin, in a white veil and a dark blue mantle, sits on the ground holding the dead Christ across her lap, one hand under his head. He wears a crown of thorns and a white loincloth; one arm hangs down onto bright blue drapery beside a rock. Behind them lie a walled town with towers and a dome, hills crossed by winding paths, and pale mountains under a blue sky.

wikidata-Q3905873.caption: A painter stands back from his easel in a sparsely furnished room, holding his brushes and palette. We see the back of the painting, so its subject remains hidden; the large panel and the space before it make the act of looking feel as important as painting.

wikidata-Q390713.caption: A man in black sits beside an oversized open book, with more volumes, loose papers and an inkwell below. His face and the pale pages stand out against the subdued rocky landscape, giving the portrait a concentrated, still presence.

wikidata-Q3907473.caption: Five panels. In the tall centre, Christ rises on a cloud holding a banner, one arm flung wide, above two soldiers: one looks up, the other, in armour, crouches with a hand on the ground. A tower and buildings stand against a glowing sky behind them. At top left an angel holds up a scroll lettered GRATIA PLENA; at top right the Virgin, in a green mantle, lowers her eyes with a hand at her breast. Lower left, a young man in armour and a red cloak stands beside a bearded man and a man with his hands joined in prayer. Lower right, Saint Sebastian, nearly naked with an arrow in his side, is tied up by the arms, one foot raised on a stone drum.

wikidata-Q3908058.title: The Bridge at Courbevoie
wikidata-Q3908058.caption: A sunlit grassy bank slopes down to the Seine, where two figures stand by the water and a sailboat and moored masts rise before the bridge at Courbevoie, a factory chimney smoking in the haze beyond; a dark bare tree stands at the right.

wikidata-Q3909309.caption: In a sunlit classical harbour, Ursula, in yellow and carrying a flag with a red cross, watches her companions embark with their bows and arrows, a great round temple rising at the left and ships receding toward a hazy horizon.

wikidata-Q3910087.caption: In a wide square closed by a domed basilica, Saint Mark stands on a raised platform preaching, while a dense crowd of turbaned townsfolk and kneeling white-veiled women fills the foreground and camels and a giraffe move behind.

wikidata-Q3918079.caption: In a dim church an elderly official with a star on his coat holds a candle beside a very young bride in white lace and a flower wreath, her eyes cast down, as the priest reaches for her outstretched hand; a young man with folded arms watches from the right.

wikidata-Q3918296.caption: The Virgin, seated on a stone bench, holds the standing Christ Child against her, their cheeks touching, a long rosary hanging between them as they look out at the viewer.
wikidata-Q3918296.title: The Virgin of the Rosary

wikidata-Q3918344.caption: Esther lifts both arms to gather up her fair hair while two attendants bring a gilded vessel and a box of pearls, readying her to be presented to King Ahasuerus.

wikidata-Q3922376.caption: White-robed brothers of a Venetian confraternity carry their gold reliquary of the True Cross across Piazza San Marco, with the basilica's glittering mosaic facade filling the background.

wikidata-Q39226.caption: A street singer steps out of a Paris café, guitar under one arm and cherries wrapped in paper, raising a few of them to her lips as she meets our gaze.

wikidata-Q3924416.title: Ballet Rehearsal on Stage
wikidata-Q3924416.caption: Dancers yawn, stretch and wait their turn on a half-lit stage while a man in a top hat sprawls on a chair, all in Degas's near-monochrome browns and creams.

wikidata-Q3925598.caption: Laurel-crowned Apollo flays the satyr Marsyas as he hangs head-down from a tree, watched by a musician, a brooding King Midas and a boy with a dog, while a little dog laps the blood.

wikidata-Q3926028.caption: A small red-haired angel rests his cheek on a lute nearly as big as himself and plucks its strings with absorbed care, his red-and-white wings spread against a dark ground.

wikidata-Q3926626.caption: A whirl of colour patches and black and white lines, said to hold a troika and a lance-bearing St George, is cradled by a soft white border that swells up from the bottom edge.

wikidata-Q3929306.title: Girl at the Piano (Overture to Tannhäuser)
wikidata-Q3929306.caption: A young woman in white plays an upright piano while another sews on a red sofa behind her, in a dim family interior that Cézanne linked to Wagner's Tannhäuser.

wikidata-Q3930497.caption: A huge eagle hoists a bawling toddler into a stormy sky by his shirt, the boy still clutching his cherries and wetting himself in fright — Rembrandt's irreverent take on Ganymede.

wikidata-Q3930498.caption: Rubens's Ganymede twists skyward in the grip of Jupiter's eagle, arm flung up toward a flash of lightning as his red cloak streams out behind him.

wikidata-Q3933572.caption: Christ emerges from the tomb with a white banner as the guards recoil below him. John the Baptist and Saint Martina occupy the side panels, their still poses framing the sudden movement at the centre.

wikidata-Q3933578.caption: Christ points to the gaunt Lazarus, still in his grave cloths, as Mary kneels in awe and Martha turns away, in the vast altarpiece Sebastiano painted with Michelangelo's help to rival Raphael.

wikidata-Q3937397.caption: A young man in a red cap looks straight out of the darkness, his face modelled by a single strong light in the Netherlandish manner Antonello brought to Venetian portraiture.

wikidata-Q3937404.caption: A red cap and robe frame the sitter’s lined face, set off by a broad black scarf. Behind this close view, tiny figures move among ancient buildings, opening a second, much more distant world on either side of his head.

A gilt jug and a basket of fruit stand on a red-covered table at upper right, and a green curtain hangs behind the children at upper left, with trees and sky beyond.

wikidata-Q3937421.caption: The Duke and Duchess of Osuna gather their four small children around them, two in green suits beside a toy carriage and two in grey dresses holding fans, in Goya's silvery family portrait.

wikidata-Q3937422.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

wikidata-Q3937426.caption: The Count-Duke of Olivares looks out from a plain dark ground, his broad face framed by black hair, upturned moustaches and a pointed beard above a white collar and black coat.

wikidata-Q3937427.caption: Cardinal Guido Bentivoglio sits in crimson silk over a white lace-trimmed tunic, a letter in his hand, turning to look up and away, with a crimson curtain behind him and a draped table at his side.

wikidata-Q3937450.caption: Agatha Bas stands inside a painted ebony frame, one thumb curled over its edge and an open fan in her other hand.

wikidata-Q3937472.caption: Bia de' Medici sits on a curved wooden chair in a white dress, pearls at her throat and a gold medal with her father's profile on a long chain, against a deep blue ground that lightens around her head.

wikidata-Q3937473.caption: Bartolomeo Panciatichi leans on a stone balustrade in a long black jacket over slashed red satin sleeves, his red beard combed into two points, while a black puppy peers up from the lower right.

wikidata-Q3937666.caption: Holbein's courtier, in a black cap with a cameo badge and a dark gown, looks off to the right against a mottled green ground, between Latin inscriptions giving the date and his age.

wikidata-Q3948693.title: The Emperor Theodosius Is Forbidden by Saint Ambrose to Enter Milan Cathedral
wikidata-Q3948693.caption: In a gold brocade cope and mitre, Saint Ambrose blocks the cathedral steps to the emperor Theodosius, in red cape and laurel wreath, with soldiers crowding behind the emperor and a boy in white beside the bishop.

wikidata-Q39537.caption: Circe sits on a throne with snarling lion heads, holding out a cup in one hand and raising a wand in the other; in the round mirror behind her a bearded man appears, and a pig lies at her feet.

wikidata-Q3955717.caption: A crowd of staring, mask-like faces under top hats and wide straw hats presses towards us down an evening street, while a lone dark figure stands in the empty road to the right.

wikidata-Q3976754.caption: A vast army of pikemen fills the mountainside, with a river valley and a distant city under red smoke beyond, while at the left King Saul lies fallen on his sword on a rocky ledge.

wikidata-Q3978274.caption: On a stone ledge, the naked Susanna twists away from two elders leaning over the wall behind her, one with a finger raised to his lips, her hands raised to fend them off.

wikidata-Q3978277.caption: Susanna sits beside the water with her mirror and jewellery, while two men peer around opposite ends of the rose-covered screen. The bright, open view of her body contrasts with their half-hidden positions, making us aware of an intrusion she has not yet noticed.

wikidata-Q398126.caption: Under a dark storm sky, a rainbow arcs down to the right of Salisbury Cathedral's spire as a horse-drawn cart fords the river and a dog stands on the bank.

wikidata-Q3983802.caption: An old man with a long white beard lies on his back in a blue cloak while monsters set on him: one drags him by the hair, others raise sticks, and a huge grey bird-headed creature looms at right. Horned, fanged beasts crowd behind, and at lower left sits a bloated figure covered in sores. Beyond lie a wrecked timber hut, bare trees and pale crags; high in the sky a figure glows in a burst of light.

wikidata-Q3985203.caption: Moses reads to the gathered people at the right, while smaller episodes of his final days unfold across the hillside behind them. The crowded foreground and distant scenes let several moments in the story occupy one continuous landscape.

wikidata-Q398973.caption: Framed by an arch of trees, Salisbury Cathedral's spire rises against a cloudy sky; cattle graze and drink at a pond in the meadow, and at the left a man raises his stick towards the view beside a woman at a gate.

wikidata-Q39926338.caption: A nude woman with long red-gold hair stands in a dark forest, a great snake coiled around her body and legs, its head on her shoulder as she lowers her face towards it.

wikidata-Q3993020.caption: The Virgin, seated on a throne with a scrolled arm, holds the Christ Child and a split pomegranate on her lap, while behind her the birth of the Virgin and the meeting of Anne and Joachim unfold in a palace.

wikidata-Q3997723.caption: Christ in white robes stands on a grassy height between Moses and Elijah, each holding a scroll, while three men below look up in alarm, one gesturing, one kneeling, one drawing his cloak up beside his head, with farms and towns behind.

wikidata-Q3998957.caption: Bacchus and Ariadne ride in separate chariots amid a procession of dancers, musicians and revellers. Flying cupids fill the sky above them, while the overlapping bodies below turn the long ceiling panel into a dense, rhythmic celebration.

wikidata-Q3998985.caption: Charles I appears three times against a cloudy blue sky, in profile at left, full face in the centre and three-quarter view at right, each in different clothes and a differently patterned lace collar.

wikidata-Q4008950.title: Irises
wikidata-Q4008950.caption: A great bunch of blue irises with long green leaves bursts from an ochre vase against a bright yellow wall, some stems spilling onto the table at the right.

wikidata-Q4009226.caption: On a bright autumn morning, a couple set off on a farm cart past the manor of Het Steen at left, while a hunter crouches in the foreground and a wide, misty landscape stretches to the horizon.

wikidata-Q4009571.caption: Venus, seen from behind, throws her arms around Adonis as he turns to leave with his spears and straining hounds; Cupid sleeps under a tree at left, and a small goddess appears among bright clouds above.

wikidata-Q4009608.caption: The white domes of Santa Maria della Salute rise at the left, a tall bell tower and palace fronts beyond, while laden boats and gondolas crowd the brownish water in front.

wikidata-Q40432.caption: Massive draft horses, grey, black and chestnut, wheel and rear along a dusty tree-lined boulevard as their handlers struggle to lead them, a domed building rising at the far left.

wikidata-Q405814.caption: A nun with a lute and a monk gape at a round morsel dangling on a string between them, amid a drunken crowd in a small boat whose mast is a leafy tree; naked swimmers in the water hold up a bowl, and a fool sits drinking in the branches.

wikidata-Q4062416.caption: A girl with long dark hair and a white ribbon, in a pale blue dress with a small gold cross, sits facing us with her hands folded; 'ALICE' is painted at the top left.

wikidata-Q4063783.caption: A barefoot girl with loose red-brown hair sits hunched on a stone by a dark forest pool, her head resting on her hands on her knees, among young fir and birch trees with fallen leaves on the water.

wikidata-Q4067988.caption: In a sunlit garden, a man in a straw hat reads in the shade of orange trees growing in tubs, while a girl leans on a tub beyond and a dog sleeps on the bright path at right.

wikidata-Q4068125.caption: A great pyramid of bleached human skulls rises from a parched desert plain, crows perching on it and wheeling overhead, with dead trees and a ruined town in the distance.

wikidata-Q4095553.caption: Morozova holds two fingers aloft as her sledge passes through a snowbound crowd. A seated man at the lower right echoes the gesture; the surrounding faces range from laughter to anxious attention, giving her raised hand a different answer at every turn.

wikidata-Q4097113.caption: On a red-covered bed, a woman in a dark dress towels a naked girl who turns away to look in a hand mirror, a pink bow in her hair; a doll with a matching bow lies abandoned on the rug.

wikidata-Q4110167.caption: The white walls of thatched cottages catch the last pink light on a dark hillside, under a rose and yellow evening sky, with black trees massed around them.

wikidata-Q4110204.caption: On a cape where a river bends, a white monastery with green onion domes catches the low evening sun among trees, its walls mirrored in the still water; a boat full of people is out on the river, and two more lie by the near bank.

wikidata-Q4110459.caption: A rider on a dark horse bursts through a wall of snow as snow flies around him, a crowd in fur hats and shawls cheering on either side and sledges drawn up at left and right.

wikidata-Q4110588.caption: In an autumn meadow, a fair-haired boy in a white shirt stands with hands clasped before a hooded, haloed monk under an oak, with a wooden church and a wide valley behind.

wikidata-Q4113083.caption: A pale dirt road runs towards the horizon beneath a broad grey sky. A solitary figure stands near the roadside shrine, small against the open land; the converging tracks make the distance feel both inviting and immense.

wikidata-Q4127698.title: Saint Erasmus and Saint Maurice
wikidata-Q4127698.caption: A bishop in a jewelled mitre and gold brocade cope, holding a windlass, faces a Black saint in shining plate armour with a jewelled wreath, while an old cleric in red and soldiers crowd behind.

wikidata-Q4156438.caption: A dark-haired girl in a pink blouse with a black bow sits at a white-covered table, holding a peach, with more peaches and maple leaves before her and a sunlit window behind.
