wikidata-Q4161055.collection: National Gallery and National Galleries of Scotland
wikidata-Q4161055.caption: Diana, seated at right among her attendants, points accusingly as nymphs at left pull the clothes from Callisto, while water trickles from a cherub's urn on a stone fountain into the stream between them.

wikidata-Q4164272.caption: A smiling young street seller looks up and away, a broad basket balanced on her dark hat, her face and cloak dashed in with quick, loose strokes.

wikidata-Q4167947.caption: A colossal smiling archaic statue of a girl, a blue bird in her hand, stands before a vast bird's-eye view of a coast torn apart, as lightning strikes and the sea floods over cities and ruins.

wikidata-Q4179482.caption: A Tahitian woman in a high-necked blue-grey dress with a white collar sits before a red chair and a yellow wall patterned with flowers, a white flower in her hair and a yellow flower in her hand; 'Vahine no te Tiare' is written at the top.

wikidata-Q4188993.caption: Under flowering hawthorn, Nimue in a clinging blue-grey robe, snakes in her hair and a book held open in her hands, looks back at the enchanted Merlin, who slumps helplessly against a tree.

wikidata-Q4193277.caption: Slender birches blaze yellow and orange on a sunny slope at left, and a dark, still stream winds through brown meadows towards distant fields and a few farm buildings under a blue sky with white cloud.

wikidata-Q4195595.caption: On a red-patterned carpet in a dim room, the wild-eyed old tsar clutches his dying son, pressing a hand to the bleeding wound on his head; the staff lies on the floor in front.

wikidata-Q4198276.caption: A dark-haired woman in a sheer white gown leans her head and arms around a large patterned pot of basil on an inlaid stand draped with embroidered cloth, a small skull worked into the pot's side.

wikidata-Q4231515.caption: Stanisław Małachowski is carried above the crowd, holding the newly adopted constitution aloft. At the left, the king approaches the church steps; banners, raised arms and tightly packed figures turn the procession into a sweeping public celebration.

wikidata-Q4233325.caption: Twisting blue tree trunks and roots crowd a long canvas of ochre earth, with green leaves and dashes of red, yellow and white.

wikidata-Q427390.title: The Holy Family, or 'The Pearl'
wikidata-Q427390.caption: The Virgin holds the Child between her knees, one of his feet on a wicker cradle, beside an old woman in a headscarf, Saint Anne, who leans her chin on her hand; the young John brings an offering from the left, and ruins and a river open up at right.

wikidata-Q4281369.caption: A woman in deep blue velvet stretches her back, hands pressed to the small of it, as she rises from her embroidery by a stained-glass window; autumn leaves lie on the cloth and the floor, and a mouse creeps across the boards.

wikidata-Q4282465.caption: In bright March sun, a horse harnessed to a sledge waits by the porch of a yellow wooden house, while snow lies heaped and thawing on the track and bare birches and dark pines stand against a deep blue sky.

wikidata-Q428274.caption: The scholar and papal librarian Tommaso Inghirami looks upward, his pen poised beside the inkwell. Red clothing fills most of the picture, while the open book, paper and hands gather the act of writing into its lower edge.

wikidata-Q429753.caption: Four racehorses, each with a jockey in coloured silks, fly across the green turf with legs stretched out front and back, under a dark, stormy sky; a white post stands at the right.

wikidata-Q43081847.caption: Berthe Morisot rests on a dark red sofa, her outstretched arms opening the composition around her white dress. Above her, a turbulent Japanese print contrasts with the still pose, while broad strokes of pale paint give the fabric a lively surface.

wikidata-Q4314748.caption: In a golden temple hung with lamps, a boy in a striped violet robe stands barefoot while a woman embraces him and a bearded man bends over them both; to the left, bearded elders in turbans and prayer shawls sit holding scrolls.

wikidata-Q432253.caption: Two flags fly over a seaside terrace bright with red flowers; a man in a straw hat sits in a wicker chair beside a woman under a white parasol, while a couple stand talking at the railing above a sea crowded with sailing ships and steamers.

wikidata-Q4358442.caption: The young guitarist looks away from her instrument as her hands continue their separate tasks on strings and frets. Her yellow jacket and pale skirt brighten the room, while a framed landscape and stacked books fill the space behind her.

wikidata-Q4373334.caption: A sixteen-year-old widow in mourning stands full-length against a blue-green wall, her black satin gown open over a fur lining, white ruffles at her neck and wrists, hands clasped around a pair of pale gloves.

wikidata-Q4373348.caption: A woman in a huge black feathered hat and a long fur wrap over a white gown sits sideways in a pale panelled room, one hand at the pearls on her chest, a large gilt-framed painting on the wall above her.

wikidata-Q4373352.collection: National Galleries of Scotland (Scottish National Gallery)
wikidata-Q4373352.caption: A young woman in a tall feathered hat and a shimmering pale satin gown over a rose-pink and red skirt rests one arm on the base of a great stone column, a feather fan in her other hand, trees and a stormy sky behind.

wikidata-Q4373363.caption: A young woman in strict profile faces right against a black ground. Her red-gold hair is part braided, part loose and wavy, wound with red ribbon and strings of pearls, with a spray of white feathers rising from a red jewel at the crown. Two long pearl-studded braids fall over her white dress, and a dark cameo hangs from fine gold chains at her throat.
wikidata-Q4373363.title: Idealised Portrait of a Lady (Portrait of Simonetta Vespucci as Nymph)

wikidata-Q4375073.caption: A winged young man carries a woman in his arms up into a pale sky above rocky peaks; her eyes are closed, her arms crossed over her chest and her head resting against his neck, while violet drapery swirls around them.

wikidata-Q4385510.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
wikidata-Q4385510.caption: Under a streaked yellow and blue sky, the Virgin in a blue hood and cloak spreads her arms wide behind the slumped body of the dead Christ, whose red-haired head lolls against her; a dark rock rises at the right.

wikidata-Q4396378.caption: A dirt track winds into a field of ripe golden rye that stretches to the horizon, where tall pines stand singly and in groups, one of them dead and bare, under a pale summer sky with a few birds.

wikidata-Q4404599.caption: On the sea floor, among fish, shells and weed, a bearded merchant in a fur-trimmed coat stands gazing upward while a glowing procession of richly dressed young women passes him, a mermaid in front of them; a plainly dressed girl stands apart at the upper left.

wikidata-Q44124.caption: A dancer stands on bare boards in a white lace mantilla and shawl, a full black skirt patterned with red and yellow flowers and edged with red pompoms, a half-open fan in her hand and pink slippers on her feet; behind her are the backs of stage flats, and through a gap at right, tiers of theatre boxes.

wikidata-Q4429116.caption: A magpie perches on a gate at the left of this snowy landscape. Blue and violet shadows cross the foreground, while sunlit snow softens the fence, roofs and bare branches.

wikidata-Q444078.collection: Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister, Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden
wikidata-Q444078.caption: A young man with arrows in his body stands almost naked against a tree trunk, hands behind his back, looking upward. Behind him a square paved in red and white leads to arches and a terrace where onlookers lean over hanging carpets; a man lies asleep at the left and a fallen column lies at the right.

wikidata-Q4448822.caption: Mary Magdalene, her long hair loose over a white shift and a striped shawl, gazes up with tear-filled eyes, one hand pressed to her breast; an open book rests on a skull beside her, a glass jar stands at left, and a dark rock and a landscape under a blue sky lie behind.

wikidata-Q4451145.caption: A man in a straw hat and dark blue suit sweeps a young woman in a pink ruffled dress and red bonnet round in a dance, their faces close, while people drink at a café table under the trees behind them; a small bunch of purple flowers lies on the ground.

wikidata-Q445627.collection: Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister, Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden
wikidata-Q445627.caption: A young maid in a pink cap, a golden-brown bodice, a grey skirt and a long white apron walks to the right in profile, carefully carrying a black tray with a glass of water and a porcelain cup of chocolate on a saucer.

wikidata-Q4458429.title: Quiet Abode
wikidata-Q4458429.caption: A long, rickety wooden footbridge crosses a still river toward a wooded bank, beyond which rise the white walls, tall bell tower and green onion domes of a monastery, all mirrored in the water under a pale sky with pink-gold clouds.

wikidata-Q4462828.title: The Ages of Woman and Death
wikidata-Q4462828.caption: Under a dead tree hung with moss, Death, a rotting corpse holding an hourglass and a broken lance, grips an old woman, who in turn tugs at a young nude woman draped in a veil; a dead infant lies at their feet and an owl stares out at lower left.

wikidata-Q4464287.caption: On a sunny street, navvies dig a trench while all kinds of people crowd around them: a ragged flower seller and ladies with parasols at left, riders on horseback behind, a girl in a red dress minding small children in front, and two gentlemen watching from the right.

wikidata-Q4497499.title: Cottages
wikidata-Q4497499.caption: A row of low cottages with green and golden thatched roofs and smoking chimneys runs along a sloping meadow below a grassy hill, with a red-roofed house at right, under a blue sky streaked with white cloud.

wikidata-Q4503153.caption: A pale young woman in a towering jewelled headdress and a gauzy veil looks back over her shoulder as her body dissolves into great white swan's wings on dark water; behind her, at upper left, a dusky island with a glowing castle.

wikidata-Q45130.caption: A long-haired young man in a blue robe leans over a table spread with a map and a heavy patterned rug, a pair of dividers in his hand, and looks out of a leaded window; a globe stands on the cupboard behind him and a framed map hangs on the wall.

wikidata-Q4531523.title: Sunset (Brothers)
wikidata-Q4531523.caption: Two figures in long dark coats and wide hats stand side by side on a grassy rise, seen from behind as silhouettes, looking out over a low landscape of water and hills toward a band of orange sunset glow.

wikidata-Q455319.title: Madonna of Mayor Jacob Meyer zum Hasen (Darmstadt Madonna)
wikidata-Q455319.caption: The crowned Virgin stands in a great scallop-shell niche holding the Christ Child, a dark cloak falling behind her; on the left a man kneels in prayer behind a youth holding a naked toddler, and on the right two women in white headdresses and a girl with a rosary kneel on an oriental carpet.

wikidata-Q4556666.collection: Museu de Arte de São Paulo (MASP)
wikidata-Q4556666.caption: A heavy-set man with an upturned moustache and a stiff white collar stands full-length in black satin, one hand on a table draped in red velvet; a gold chain crosses his chest, a large gold key and a pair of gold spurs hang at his waist, and a red cross marks his doublet.

wikidata-Q45585.collection: Museum of Modern Art, New York
wikidata-Q45585.caption: A dark, flame-shaped cypress rises at left into a night sky of swirling blue and white currents, glowing stars and a yellow crescent moon, above a small village with a pointed church steeple among blue hills.

wikidata-Q464782.caption: A bald farmer in round glasses and overalls stares straight out, holding a three-pronged pitchfork upright, beside a woman in a dark dress, white collar and cameo brooch who looks off to the side, in front of a white wooden house with a pointed Gothic window.

wikidata-Q4660880.title: Young Woman Seated at a Virginal
wikidata-Q4660880.caption: A young woman in a white satin skirt and a large yellow shawl sits at a virginal, hands on the keys, and turns to look out at us; red ribbons and a strand of small beads are in her curled hair, an open music stand rests on the instrument, and a bare wall rises behind.

wikidata-Q467359.caption: A woman in white satin and blue sits with one foot on a globe and a hand on her heart, gazing up at a glass sphere hanging from a ribbon; beside her a table holds a chalice, a crucifix and an open book, a large Crucifixion painting hangs behind, and a crushed snake and an apple lie on the chequered floor below a tapestry curtain.

wikidata-Q467376.caption: An officer in a huge black hat and red coat sits with his back half to us, one arm on his hip, facing a smiling young woman in a white headscarf who holds a wine glass; light pours in through an open leaded window at left onto a large map of Holland on the wall.

wikidata-Q4680634.caption: The kings present their gifts in a cramped stable, surrounded by soldiers and curious onlookers. The pale-robed king stands at the right while another kneels close to the child; faces, weapons and rich fabrics press together around Mary’s blue cloak.

wikidata-Q4681871.caption: A woman stands full-length and square to us in a huge dark hat, a high lace collar and a long white dress with a dark blue sash and a fur-trimmed wrap, against bands of red with small Asian-style figures, green strewn with flowers, pink, and a patterned violet floor.

wikidata-Q4693305.caption: A young horned sheep lies on a grey ledge against a black background, its feet tied together with cord, its head resting on the stone and its eyes half closed, every curl of its fleece caught in a hard, directed light.

wikidata-Q471289.collection: Finnish National Gallery / Ateneum Art Museum
wikidata-Q471289.caption: Two boys carry a fair-haired angel in white on a wooden stretcher along a dirt path by the water; the angel sits hunched with a bandage over her eyes and a few white flowers in her hand, a red mark on one wing, while the boy behind stares out at us.

wikidata-Q472037.caption: A woman sits in a wicker chair with a folded fan in her hands, her dark dress edged with pale lace. Beyond her, the sea and cliffs dissolve into looser strokes; Renoir probably assembled this seaside setting in his studio from coastal studies.

wikidata-Q474024.title: Cupid as Victor
wikidata-Q474024.caption: A smiling, naked boy with large brown-feathered wings and a fistful of arrows stands with one foot on the floor and the other knee raised onto a white-draped ledge; around him lie a violin, a lute, sheet music, a set square and compass, a written page under a sprig of laurel, black armour, and a crown and sceptre.

wikidata-Q474198.caption: A laughing woman in a white cap and ruffled collar grips the handle of a big pewter jug with its lid flipped open, while an owl perches on her shoulder.

wikidata-Q474338.caption: A young woman in a red and blue dress with a long black bead necklace and a thin black band across her forehead looks off to one side, resting her hand on a white ermine held against her chest, against a black background with faint lettering at the top left.

wikidata-Q476458.caption: In a hall of three arches, three helmeted young men stretch out their arms toward three swords raised high by an older man in a red cloak; at right, women sit slumped together, one with her head in her hand, while another woman shelters two small children behind them.

wikidata-Q477764.caption: Two girls rest together beside a field after rain, their hands clasped beneath a shared shawl. The younger turns towards the double rainbow behind them, while a butterfly has settled on the older girl’s shoulder: small details that reward looking beyond the central faces.

wikidata-Q47818848.caption: Mary sits on a tall carved marble throne with her hands pressed together in prayer, looking down at the naked Christ Child asleep across her knees with one arm hanging loose; blue sky and white clouds show on either side of the throne.

wikidata-Q478271.caption: A crowd of Cossacks in fur hats and bright coats bursts out laughing around a rough wooden table where a clerk in black writes with a quill; a bald, bare-backed man leans over the table, a stout man in a red coat and white fur hat clutches his belly, and lances and flags rise against a pale sky.

wikidata-Q4808020.caption: A young woman in a yellow cloche hat and a fur-trimmed green coat sits alone at a round white table, holding a small cup with one bare hand while the other is still gloved; behind her a large black window holds two trailing rows of ceiling lights, and a bowl of fruit stands on the sill.

wikidata-Q481454.caption: The Guillemets sit and lean on opposite sides of a garden bench, their hands close but their gazes directed apart. Dense leaves surround the couple, while the woman’s pale yellow gloves and parasol interrupt the cool blues and greys of her dress.

wikidata-Q4822496.caption: Curtains of pale green and red light fill a dark night sky above a great dark cliff; far below, a small two-masted ship sits locked in the pack ice, and a tiny dog sled crosses the ice beside it.

wikidata-Q4827756.caption: Against a black background, an old woman with long grey hair, her lips parted over a few teeth, holds a white cloth purse heaped with gold coins in both hands; a red cloth slips off one shoulder, leaving a breast bare.

wikidata-Q48383869.caption: Christ, nearly naked, a white cloth streaming from his hips and a white banner with a red cross in his hand, rises into a sky streaked with pink cloud; below, beside a dark open tomb cut into the rock, one soldier sleeps, another sits holding his head and two more stand, while a dark bird perches in a bare tree at upper left and a walled town climbs a hill at right.

wikidata-Q48387967.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ with the Virgin, Joseph of Arimathea, Mary Magdalene, Martha and possibly Philip Benizi
wikidata-Q48387967.caption: The dead Christ rests across Mary’s lap beneath a tall, empty cross. The clustered mourners fill the foreground, while a stretch of water, rocky slopes and distant buildings open the scene behind them.

wikidata-Q48389324.caption: The pale thunder god and green wind god face across a wide expanse of gold. A ring of drums surrounds one, while the other grips a billowing wind bag; their coloured bodies and twisting ribbons stand out against dark clouds.

wikidata-Q488825.caption: The Virgin sits with the Child on her lap under a timber roof set against broken stone walls, Joseph leaning behind; an old grey-haired man in a dark gold-patterned robe kneels holding the Child's foot in a white cloth, a man in a red cape and another in white kneel in front, and richly dressed men crowd in from both sides, among them a young man with a sword at far left and a young man in an orange-brown cloak at right who looks straight out.

wikidata-Q4892475.caption: A young woman sits on a cushion inside a curved colonnade of veined columns, one breast bare, a loose wrap over her thighs and her lower legs bare with knees apart, looking up as a shower of gold drops falls from the ceiling into the cloth in her lap; through the columns rise the towers and domes of a city, and a Latin signature is cut into the step below.

wikidata-Q4892867.title: The Harvest
wikidata-Q4892867.caption: A flat plain of yellow and green fields runs back to a line of hills on the horizon: in front, a picket fence and a small figure among green bushes; behind them, a tall stack with ladders against it, an empty blue cart with its shafts on the ground and a red wheeled implement, then more carts, farmhouses with orange roofs and a tall white house at right, under a blue-green sky.

wikidata-Q4896868.caption: Angélique Satre appears in Breton dress within a large circular outline, set beside a small seated figure. The blue floral background and sharply bounded shapes make the portrait feel assembled from separate images, rather than placed in one continuous room.

wikidata-Q490312.caption: Christ hangs high at the top centre against a burst of pale light; below him, men haul a second cross upright with ropes at left, a third man lies stretched on a cross on the ground at right, mourners gather round a fainting woman at the foot of the cross, and horsemen fill both ends of the long canvas.

wikidata-Q4924524.caption: Two walls of tall autumn poplars, painted in yellow, line a straight avenue and leave only a narrow strip of sky between them; a man in a hat and, further right, a woman walk on the path with smaller figures behind, low stone blocks run along the left side, and a dark conifer stands at right.

wikidata-Q4931530.title: The Canoe on the Epte
wikidata-Q4931530.caption: Two young women in pale dresses and hats sit in a long, narrow pinkish-red boat that runs off the right edge of the canvas. An oar trails out across dark water marked with long wavy strokes, under a bank of green foliage.

wikidata-Q4936154.caption: A woman with long red hair, a white rose tucked into it, rests her folded arms on a ledge and holds a sprig with a single orange flower. She wears gold earrings, a gold ornament in her hair and a gold necklace over a dark robe. An apple sits on the ledge at right, and orange marigolds bloom in dark foliage behind her.

wikidata-Q493792.caption: A man with a long grey beard and thinning dark hair stands naked to the hips, looking off to the right. His right hand holds a tall trident, and the pale sail behind him is drawn across his hips, held by his left hand. A wooden mast with a coil of rope rises behind his shoulder; the name A. DORIA is lettered at top left.

wikidata-Q4949655.caption: A dense crowd fills a long Paris boulevard, seen from above, between rows of tall buildings and bare, budding trees. Left of centre a band of figures in red, green and yellow runs up the street, and a few dark-coated, top-hatted figures stand or walk on the open roadway in the foreground.

wikidata-Q4949676.caption: Seen from high above, a pale, crowded Paris boulevard runs off into haze beneath rows of bare trees. Tall buildings line the left, carriages wait under the trees, a figure at right carries a bunch of pink balloons, and a dark top-hatted figure leans in at the right edge.

wikidata-Q500812.caption: A nude woman lies asleep on a deep red cushion and a white sheet spread over the grass, one arm folded behind her head, in a rolling landscape with a dark bank and a leafy sapling at left, farm buildings on a hill at right, blue mountains far off and a cloudy sky.

wikidata-Q500936.title: The Drowning Dog
wikidata-Q500936.caption: Near the bottom of a tall canvas, the dark head of a dog, muzzle tilted upward, shows just above the edge of a dark brown slope that rises toward the right; most of the canvas above is a vast, mottled expanse of pale ochre and grey.

wikidata-Q500951.caption: A yellow Christ hangs on a brown cross set left of centre in a hilly autumn landscape of orange-red trees, yellow fields and a village with a church spire; three women in white caps gather around the foot of the cross, and farther back a man climbs over a stone wall beside two small figures.

wikidata-Q500985.caption: Three hunters with spears and a pack of dogs trudge through deep snow past bare trees on a hilltop, while at left people tend a fire outside a house with a hanging sign; below, a snowy valley holds a village, a church, skaters on frozen ponds and, far off, jagged mountain peaks under a grey-green sky.

wikidata-Q50119136.caption: A tall, sunlit Gothic cathedral, one of its two front towers unfinished, rises from woods on a hill under a dark storm sky crossed by a rainbow; a castle stands at upper left, a crowded procession of riders and walkers climbs the slope in the foreground toward a balustraded bridge between the castle and the cathedral, and a city on a bridged river stretches away at right.

wikidata-Q50474718.title: Allegory of Happiness
wikidata-Q50474718.caption: A woman in a pink tunic and blue drapery sits enthroned at the centre, raising a staff twined with snakes and holding a horn of fruit, with a small boy holding an arrow beside her. Nude and draped figures crowd around her with a globe, a wheel, a sword and scales. Above, two winged figures hold out a laurel wreath and blow a trumpet; below, bodies sprawl on the ground.

wikidata-Q507120.caption: A small man in a red jacket and white trousers leans against a large boulder on a grassy rise, a staff in his hand, below a dark, steep mountain; a faint, pale rainbow arcs across the heavy clouded sky almost from one edge of the canvas to the other.

wikidata-Q50772913.caption: Seen from inside a dim room, through a pair of glazed doors hung with sheer white curtains, a woman in a bright red hood and a dark coat stands outside in the snow, her face turned toward the glass, with snow-covered green bushes behind her.

wikidata-Q5104805.caption: In a restaurant beside a large window, a woman in a green dress and dark cloche hat faces a woman in a blue hat and grey coat, seen from behind, across a white table with a small teapot; behind them a man in a dark suit sits at another table with a woman in a red hat just visible at the left edge, a coat hangs on the wall, and outside the window a red sign shows the letters SUEY.

wikidata-Q510799.caption: An old, balding, grey-bearded man, bare to the waist with a red cloak over his lap, leans over a plain wooden table writing in a book with a pen, a small ink pot in his other hand; at the table's end lie a stone, a skull and a crucifix beside an unlit candle, all set against a dark background, with a red hat hanging on the wall at upper left and a small coat of arms at lower right.

wikidata-Q5108945.caption: Christ, in a crown of thorns with a rope knotted around his neck, turns his face upward with lips parted, tears and small red drops running down his skin; a pale column rises behind him at the left.

wikidata-Q5121363.caption: A bare-shouldered, barefoot woman in a dark green patterned robe stands above green-blue water, holding out a wide shallow bowl from which a thin bright green stream falls straight into the sea; brown rocks and dark tree trunks rise behind her, and a dark finned shape lies in the water at her feet.

wikidata-Q512755.caption: In a dark interior, an old bearded man in a red cloak bends over a young man with a shaved head and ragged clothes who kneels with his back to us, one foot bare; the old man rests both hands on the young man's shoulders while several figures watch from the right and from the shadows behind.

wikidata-Q5136665.caption: Trees, rocks and buildings emerge through layers of mist as the mountain rises towards the top of the scroll. Painted in ink on silk, the view moves between steep heights, winding depths and an open river valley at the left.

wikidata-Q5177084.caption: The countess sits with her hands together, her pale gown spreading across the chair into the dark surrounding space. Blue ribbons and ears of wheat decorate her hair, while small touches of gold pick out the chair and jewellery.

wikidata-Q5189814.title: The Crucifixion, with the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist Mourning
wikidata-Q5189814.caption: Two tall panels side by side: at left Saint John, in a white robe, holds up the kneeling Virgin in a pale blue mantle, her hands clasped; at right Christ hangs on the cross beneath an INRI sign, his loincloth fluttering; a red cloth hangs on the grey stone wall behind each panel's figures, and a skull and a bone lie on the green ground.

wikidata-Q523974.caption: Across a still stretch of water, a walled town of red and blue roofs, towers and a gate with two pointed turrets lies under a wide sky of white and dark grey clouds; boats are moored along the quay, and a few small figures stand on the sandy bank in the foreground.

wikidata-Q5296650.title: Sir Thomas More
wikidata-Q5296650.caption: A man in a black cap and a dark, fur-collared coat with crumpled red velvet sleeves sits holding a folded slip of paper; a gold chain of S-shaped links with a rose pendant lies across his shoulders, and behind him hangs a green curtain with a red cord.

wikidata-Q531329.caption: Elegantly dressed couples gather on a grassy slope under tall trees, and more crowd around a gilded boat at the water's edge on the left, where winged children fly up into the sky; at right a stone statue hung with roses stands among the trees, and misty water and pale mountains fill the distance.

wikidata-Q5316837.caption: The Virgin, in a red robe and white headdress, sits in a grey stone niche with the Christ Child on her lap; he turns the pages of a book, and above them, under carved tracery, an angel holds out a gold crown.

wikidata-Q532486.caption: Two women stand close together and look sharply off to the right: one, her braided hair pinned with a jewel, holds a sword on her shoulder; the other, seen from behind in a white headwrap and yellow dress, carries a basket holding a severed head.

wikidata-Q5332757.caption: A young man lies face down on a rock at the edge of a pool, wearing a leaf wreath and a red cloth, and stares at his reflection; at left a woman in pink drapery, bare to the waist, sits by a tree trunk and looks toward him, with yellow irises growing at the water's edge.

wikidata-Q533619.caption: A crowded village runs down to a river and the sea, full of people acting out sayings: a woman in red drapes a blue-green cloak over a stooped figure with a stick, a man shovels earth into a pit where a calf lies, and a globe with its cross pointing down sits on a bracket on a house wall.

wikidata-Q5351449.caption: A dancer in a long white skirt sweeps across a dim stage, one arm stretched out to the right at shoulder height, lit from below; along the grey wall behind sit men in dark hats, two of them playing guitars, while women at the far right raise their arms, and two more guitars hang on the wall.

wikidata-Q536024.caption: A woman in a pale blue corset pauses before her mirror and turns towards the viewer. Her white petticoat catches the light, while a seated man is cut off by the right edge, leaving her as the picture’s commanding presence.

wikidata-Q536203.caption: Jerome, in a red robe and a red broad-brimmed hat, rests his head on one hand as he reads a thick book on a slanted stand. Books, an astrolabe, a labelled jar and an hourglass crowd the shelf and table at right. A lion lies on the floor in front of the desk, head up, looking out.

wikidata-Q536395.title: Slave Market in Ancient Rome
wikidata-Q536395.caption: On a wooden platform before a red brick wall, a balding dealer in a yellow toga stretches a hand toward a crowd raising their arms below, beside a naked young woman in a leaf wreath who lifts an arm to her brow; another naked woman sits at right hugging her knees, near a figure in black holding a child.

wikidata-Q538243.title: The Holy Family, known as the Small Holy Family
wikidata-Q538243.caption: In a landscape of tall trees and distant blue hills, a young woman in a blue mantle and an older woman in a headscarf sit on the ground, both with thin gold haloes; between them two haloed infants touch, one reaching for the other's face while standing on a wooden cradle.

wikidata-Q540488.caption: A long line of mourners in black stands at the lip of a grave below pale limestone cliffs: a crucifix rises over the group at left, a priest reads with two men in red robes and hats just right of him, a man kneels by the turned earth, and a white dog stands at right.

wikidata-Q542066.caption: Two women, bare to the waist, sit side by side in a bath lined with white cloth, framed by heavy pink-red curtains. The one at left pinches the other's nipple between finger and thumb; the one at right holds a gold ring between finger and thumb at the edge of the bath. In the room behind, a woman in a red dress sews near a fireplace and a green-covered table.

wikidata-Q544315.caption: A long-haired man in a loose blue-green robe leans forward to touch a celestial globe by a leaded window, his other hand resting beside an open book on a table heaped with patterned blue and gold cloth. A chart hangs on the cupboard behind him, and a dark framed picture hangs on the wall at right.

wikidata-Q544488.caption: A tiger leaps onto a man riding a grey horse, amid a crush of hunters and animals: a turbaned horseman in red raises a spear at left, riders in armour and plumed helmets strike from the right, a bare-chested man wrenches at a lion's jaws at lower left, and a leopard lies bleeding on the ground at lower right.

wikidata-Q546297.caption: Christ's body lies on a reddish stone slab, seen from the feet, with the nail-pierced soles at the front edge. His chest and upturned face stay clearly visible. In the upper left corner, mourners press in at the edge: an old woman holds a white cloth to her eye beside a younger face, open-mouthed, with a tear on the cheek.

wikidata-Q546977.caption: A bearded man with blue eyes, shown half-length and turned three-quarters, wears a large soft black hat, a black doublet over a gathered white shirt, and a thick grey fur over-sleeve. His hands are clasped at the lower left, against a plain grey-beige background.

wikidata-Q548141.caption: A nude woman with long dark hair reclines on a red-brown sofa in the middle of a dense jungle, one arm stretched out. Around her, two big cats peer from the leaves, an elephant is half-hidden behind flowers, a dark figure in a striped skirt plays a pipe, and a full moon shines above orange fruit, birds and large pale blossoms.

wikidata-Q552040.caption: A young knight in armour lies on the ground with his eyes closed, beneath a slender tree. On the left a woman in blue with her hair covered holds an upright sword and holds out a book; on the right a woman with loose fair hair and a fluttering veil offers a sprig of white flowers. Behind them, a rocky crag with buildings, a river with a bridge and blue hills.

wikidata-Q5526647.caption: A line of soldiers with bandaged eyes, most with a hand on the man in front, walks past wounded men lying all over the ground, towards a walkway of wooden boards at right. A second, smaller line of men stands further off, ahead of them. Between their legs, far in the distance, men play football and white tents stand on the plain, under a hazy pinkish sky.

wikidata-Q55429769.caption: Artemisia portrays herself with Catherine’s crown, palm and broken spiked wheel. One hand rests on the wheel at the left while the other holds the palm across her chest; her turned head brings her gaze directly towards us.

wikidata-Q555821.caption: A young man with brown hair falling to just above his shoulders turns his head back over his shoulder to look out at us. He wears a soft black cap and a black robe, with a thin line of white shirt at the neck, against a brown background that darkens towards the right.

wikidata-Q5561848.caption: A bearded young man in a cream doublet with a small white ruff, full red breeches and a red belt stands at a table and looks straight out at us. His right hand grips a large pair of shears; his left rests on a piece of black cloth marked with faint white chalk lines.

wikidata-Q556553.caption: Three men lie sprawled on the grass around a tree whose trunk carries a round tabletop laden with dishes. At upper left a man in armour sits under a roof tiled with round tarts; an egg with a knife stuck in it walks on little legs, a roast pig with a knife in its back crosses at right, and a man pushes out of a great cloud-like mass in the distance.

wikidata-Q55822130.caption: A woman in a long black dress with a train stands with her hands clasped at her waist and a thin string of pearls at her high collar, looking off past the viewer; behind her, on a pale grey wall, hangs a large framed panel showing arches and a ceiling cornice.

wikidata-Q5598238.caption: A tree's long, dark, curving branches spread across the whole canvas, and short, blocky strokes of pale grey and white fill the sky between them and the ground below.

wikidata-Q560057.caption: A young woman in a red dress and dark blue mantle holds a naked baby on her lap and looks down at him, her left hand held open at her side; a lettered scroll curls across her lap toward a haloed boy at left in a brown tunic with a thin cross-staff, while a second haloed boy, half-clothed, looks on at right, all in front of a low wall and a landscape of towns, hills and rocky cliffs.

wikidata-Q563727.caption: An older woman in a dark headdress smiles down over a younger woman in a rose-pink bodice and blue robe seated in front of her, who reaches down and takes hold of a naked baby; he holds a lamb by the neck with one leg over its back. A ledge of layered rock runs along the bottom, with a tree at right and pale blue mountains behind.

wikidata-Q5651584.caption: A man in a white tunic stands bound to the mast of a galley under a red sail while seven winged creatures with women's heads and birds' bodies swoop around the ship, one perched on its side close to a rower; the oarsmen, most with their heads wrapped in cloth, pull at their oars between tall grey cliffs.

wikidata-Q5658259.title: The Adoration of the Name of Jesus
wikidata-Q5658259.caption: At the top, the letters IHS under a cross glow in a golden sky, ringed by winged figures kneeling on clouds. Below, a crowd gazes upward: at the front a man in black with a white ruff kneels beside a figure seen from behind in a yellow, ermine-trimmed mantle, and at right an enormous open mouth lined with teeth swallows a mass of naked bodies.

wikidata-Q5659824.caption: A barefoot boy sits in a patch of sunlight, picking at his clothing. An earthenware jug and scattered shrimp shells lie beside him; the dark room makes his absorbed gesture stand out.

wikidata-Q568100.caption: Under a dark sky, a man leaning over the crossbar lets down a long white sheet, and the pale body of Christ slides along it into the arms of the men below: one in blue clings to a ladder, a bald man reaches from the right, a youth looks up from underneath. At right a man in a turban and long robe stands apart with a staff, watching, and figures in shadow look on from the left.

wikidata-Q56879420.caption: Red clouds sweep across the sky above dark wooded hills and reflective water. A narrow band of yellow light marks the horizon, while bare branches at the edges make the foreground feel close beside the vast sunset.

wikidata-Q568847.caption: Inside a shallow gold box with painted tracery in its upper corners, Christ's pale body is lowered from the cross: a white-bearded man in a red cap holds him under the arms with a white cloth, a man in a gold brocade robe holds his legs, and a youth on a ladder stands behind. At left the Virgin, in blue, collapses in a faint, held by a man in red and a woman in green; at right a woman wrings her hands, and a skull lies on the ground.

wikidata-Q5712851.caption: An older man in a white cloth cap and a dark robe with a reddish collar stands half-turned towards us, his face lit against a brown background. Low at right he grips brushes, a palette and a long stick, and the dark edge of a canvas on an easel runs down the right side.

wikidata-Q571416.caption: A bearded man in a lace collar, patterned doublet and orange stockings sits with one leg crossed and one hand resting on a sword hilt. Beside him, lower down on the grass, a young woman in a tall hat, a wide lace ruff and an embroidered bodice lays her hand over his. Honeysuckle and dark leaves arch behind them, with sky and distant land at left.

wikidata-Q5731138.title: Still Life with Game, Vegetables and Fruit
wikidata-Q5731138.caption: In a shallow grey stone recess against a black background, a branch of lemons, a cluster of apples on strings, two small birds and a pair of partridges hang from above; a row of little birds is tied to a cane at left, carrots and radishes rest on the ledge, and a large thistle with thick pale stalks leans at right.

wikidata-Q574004.title: The Crucifixion; The Last Judgment
wikidata-Q574004.caption: Two tall, narrow panels. At left, Christ hangs on the cross between two crucified men, above a crowd of riders, soldiers and mourners, with a city and snowy mountains behind. At right, Christ appears in judgment with raised hands among saints and angels; below, an armoured winged figure stands on a huge winged skeleton, and naked bodies tumble into a dark hell crowded with beasts.

wikidata-Q5793788.caption: Two seated figures occupy the foreground beneath pink blossoms, one facing us and the other turned sideways. Behind them, a red-bearded figure props his chin on his hand; the three distinct poses sit within broad, sharply bounded areas of colour.

wikidata-Q579455.caption: A square of cool, faintly grey white, tilted and pushed toward the upper right, sits on a warmer, creamier white ground; brushmarks and an uneven paint surface show across both whites.

wikidata-Q5800462.title: David and Jonathan
wikidata-Q5800462.caption: In front of a distant city, a young man with long fair hair and a sword at his hip buries his face against the chest of an older man in a feathered turban and an embroidered robe, who holds him and looks down; a dark rock face rises at right, and a reddish bag and a tied bundle of shafts lie on the ground at lower right.

wikidata-Q5817081.caption: A young man lies stretched across the foreground with his eyes closed, small white flowers near his head; behind him a winged child holding a lit torch stands by a golden cloak, a long arrow leaning beside him, and at upper left a pale woman leans against a rock beneath the trees.

wikidata-Q5818528.caption: Inside a dark cave, a naked young man with two spears rests one foot on a boulder, his elbow on his knee, and points up at a winged creature with a woman's face perched on a ledge in the shadows. A skull, ribs and the sole of a human foot lie in the bottom left corner; at right, through an opening in the rock, a naked, bearded man, red cloak streaming, runs off toward a distant city.

wikidata-Q5824293.caption: Under dark storm clouds, with a rainbow arching down on the left, a stream rushes past a broken tree trunk through a graveyard of heavy stone tombs, one of them white and lit by the sun. Behind, the tall ruins of a church rise on a wooded hill, and a pale, half-dead tree stands at right.

wikidata-Q585437.caption: A youth with dark curls and a pale rose behind his ear jerks back, brow knotted and mouth open, as a small lizard hanging from his finger bites him. White drapery slips from his bare shoulder. In front of him lie cherries and other fruit, and a clear glass vase holds a pink rose, leaves and small white flowers.

wikidata-Q587514.caption: A huge red horse with a dark blue mane plunges forward across the canvas, its body breaking up into streaks of colour, while men lean back and strain against it; a pale grey horse charges at left. Behind, scaffolding poles and brick walls rise under a hazy sky.

wikidata-Q5884258.caption: The Grand Canal stretches away between rows of palaces toward a domed church and distant towers. Gondolas cross the green water; in the foreground, moored boats with masts and a loose white sail lie beside a quay at right, where people sit and stand under a tall house with a woman leaning from its balcony and a man up on a chimney.

wikidata-Q588695.caption: Seen from behind, a painter in a black beret and a black doublet slit open across the back sits at his easel, painting a few blue leaves; his model, in blue with a crown of leaves, holds a long trumpet and a yellow book in front of a large wall map under a chandelier, while a patterned cloth is drawn back at left and the floor is tiled in black and white.

wikidata-Q5901183.caption: A man displays coins in his open palm and places his other hand on the young woman’s shoulder. She continues sewing, looking down at her work; candlelight catches her white clothing and the offered money, holding the two actions close together.

wikidata-Q5914606.title: House in Provence
wikidata-Q5914606.caption: A pale two-storey farmhouse with an orange-pink roof stands among dark green trees, an ochre field with thin bare trees stretching away to its right, beneath a long blue-grey mountain ridge with steep rock faces and a pale cloudy sky.

wikidata-Q5916308.caption: Mary, in a white robe, blue mantle and golden-yellow veil, stands on a globe with her hands raised together, a crescent moon at her feet and a serpent with an apple in its jaws beneath her; winged children and cherub heads float around her in a golden sky, a white dove and small stars above, a palm and a gilt-framed mirror below.

wikidata-Q5930190.title: Country Road in Provence by Night
wikidata-Q5930190.caption: A very tall, dark cypress rises up the middle of the canvas, its top cut by the edge, against a blue sky of short circling strokes with one large yellow-green star at left, a smaller light below it and a thin orange crescent moon at upper right; a pale road curves past tall yellow grasses, with a yellow carriage drawn by a white horse and two walkers on it and a green-roofed house behind.

wikidata-Q594406.caption: Angels in pale, pink and yellow robes, some blowing long trumpets, drive a tangle of falling monsters down from a bright opening in the sky; at the centre a slim figure in gold armour swings a sword, a shield with a red cross on his arm, while below him fish, toads, shells, a helmeted creature and a head seen from behind with butterfly wings pile up in the dark.

wikidata-Q594470.caption: Michael pins the demon beneath one foot and raises his spear for the next blow. His bright wings and flowing drapery stretch across a rocky landscape, where small flames flicker below the distant sky.

wikidata-Q594477.caption: A woman in a broad yellow straw hat, a high-collared blue-violet blouse flecked with orange-red dots and a cream apron sits with her hands resting in her lap, in front of tall green and yellow stalks of wheat with a few round orange blooms among them.

wikidata-Q5949742.caption: Soldiers in classical dress and bright blue, yellow and red tunics stand talking and gesturing on rocky ground in front, with halberds and a big crimson banner behind them; on the left, in the middle distance, a crowd gathers round a kneeling naked man, while bodies and a severed head lie at the bottom-left edge; above, in bright clouds, angels play a lute and a large bowed instrument while others fly down holding wreaths and palm branches.

wikidata-Q5954551.caption: Three women in long robes of red and blue, green, and pale grey stand in a meadow before a young man in a blue tunic and red hose, who sits on a low stone wall under a tree and holds out a lettered golden ball to the woman in grey as she reaches for it; two dogs, an ox, sheep and goats stand or lie around him, and on the shore at the left a ship stands propped up on land below a domed city, with a towered city on the hills at the right.

wikidata-Q595707.caption: A young woman with centre-parted hair under a fine veil turns her head to the side; her red fur-lined coat lies open over one bare breast, and her right hand holds its fur edge. Behind her, dark laurel branches stand out against a black ground.

wikidata-Q5961888.caption: A torchlit night crowd presses in from the right toward Mary, who holds the Child on a manger at the left: a kneeling king in a gold brocade cloak offers a gold vessel, an old white-bearded king in red and a dark-skinned king in a white turban and blue cloak stand behind him, and pages, muscular half-naked porters, a man on horseback at the upper right, camels and a donkey with a gold disc over its eyes crowd the space under flying cherubs and a starry sky.

wikidata-Q5963059.caption: A white-haired, barefoot old man in a red cloak flies across the upper half of the picture, one arm stretched out ahead of him. Below and around him, birds fly, fish swim and animals run the same way: a white swan and dark ducks at upper left, fish in the sea below, and at the right a stag, an ox and a white horse-like head with a long straight horn.

wikidata-Q5963585.caption: Two bearded figures in blue sit on a bank of cloud with orbs and sceptres, a white dove in a blaze of light between them; a woman in a blue mantle stands below at left, people in white kneel at right beside a gold crown, and a crowd of half-naked men, with a woman in green silk among them and one man lifting a wooden box topped by a dove, surges up on clouds above a small green landscape, a large eagle at lower left.

wikidata-Q5965648.caption: Two winged angels stretch a long scroll lettered GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO across the top, with small winged children tumbling between them; below, under stone arches, a woman in red holds up the edges of a white cloth around a brightly lit baby lying on it while men and a blue-robed angel gather round, and a barefoot man in green kneels near a white lamb lying on its back.

wikidata-Q5965729.caption: An angel in green with great grey wings stands on a cloud at right, arms crossed on his chest, facing a young woman in a rose dress and blue mantle who raises one hand, a book on a stand behind her. A white dove flies in a burst of light between them, a bush tipped with white flames rises beside a basket heaped with cloth, and above, angels on clouds play a harp, a recorder, a large bowed instrument and a box-shaped instrument.

wikidata-Q5966108.caption: Dozens of naked men tumble head over heels out of a bright break in dark storm clouds into a heap below; in front, big muscular figures twist, sprawl and stare upward or out at us, one with wild hair and gaping mouth at the centre, a torch burns at left, a snarling dog's head shows at the far left, and butterflies and a winged insect cover the groins of the nearest bodies.

wikidata-Q5966352.caption: Three angels gather Christ’s blood in their outstretched hands beneath the dark sky. Mary and John stand on either side of the cross, while Mary Magdalene kneels at its foot; their long figures carry the eye upward towards Christ.

wikidata-Q5966403.caption: A young woman in a dark dress with a black ribbon at her throat sits beside a white cradle, her chin resting on one hand, watching a baby asleep under a sheer white net that hangs from above; her other hand holds the edge of the net at the cradle's rim.

wikidata-Q5967091.title: Virgin
wikidata-Q5967091.caption: Against a dark ground, a young woman sleeps with one arm thrown over her head, her body covered by a blanket of purple and blue spirals and flowers, while other women lie tangled around her, some with eyes closed and some open.

wikidata-Q597114.title: The Death of the Virgin
wikidata-Q597114.caption: Beneath a huge red drape hung from the ceiling beams, the Virgin in a red dress lies dead on a low bed, barefoot, one arm hanging over the edge, while bearded apostles crowd round, some hiding their faces, and a young woman sits bent double on a chair in front.

wikidata-Q5971284.caption: Four administrators sit around a dark table, with the home’s house mother standing behind them. White collars and cuffs give structure to the black clothing, while Hals’s broad strokes distinguish each face and pair of hands.

wikidata-Q598913.title: The Mond Crucifixion
wikidata-Q598913.caption: Christ hangs on the cross under a gold sun and a dark moon, each with a face, while two angels in green and gold hold up cups beneath his wounds; below, two standing figures with clasped hands and two kneeling figures, an old bearded man and a young woman in pink, frame a landscape of hills and water.

wikidata-Q6025697.caption: On a stone ledge with steps, a smiling fair-haired boy in a tall fur cap, light blue jacket and yellow breeches shoulders a gun with fixed bayonet; another child with a pack and gun stands behind him, a boy in a red headscarf beats a drum at right, and a boy lying at left holds a small toy bell tower.

wikidata-Q602813.caption: Mary, in a red dress and a blue-green mantle, holds up a small open book while the naked Child on her lap turns his head to look up toward it, a goldfinch on a fine string in his hands; behind them, low green hills with slender trees and a distant blue valley.

wikidata-Q603703.caption: A naked woman, seen from behind and seated on a draped rock, throws her arms around a young man in a short rose-coloured tunic who grips a spear and holds his hunting dogs on leashes; at left a child sleeps under a tree hung with a bow and quiver, and at upper right light breaks through dark clouds.

wikidata-Q603751.caption: Villagers crowd a long table in a barn: two men carry bowls of porridge on a door taken off its hinges, the front one in a long white apron; two bagpipers stand at left, the nearer in red; a man at lower left pours from one jug into another; a child in a big red cap sits on the floor eating from a plate; and the bride sits before a green hanging with a paper crown suspended above her.

wikidata-Q6038780.title: Still Life with Vessels
wikidata-Q6038780.caption: Four vessels stand in a row on a wooden ledge against a dark background: a gold cup on a pewter plate, a white two-handled jug with a frilled lip, a squat reddish vase with a tall ringed neck and small handles, and a white fluted jug on a second pewter plate.

wikidata-Q6046671.caption: In a lamplit bedroom with flowered wallpaper, a woman in a white slip sits hunched and turned away at left, while a bearded man in a dark jacket stands at right with a hand in his pocket, his shadow large on the wall; between them an open sewing box glows on a round table, a corset lies on the floor and a top hat rests on the dresser.

wikidata-Q604761.caption: A boy with long brown hair stands full-length in a shimmering blue satin suit with a lace collar, one hand on his hip and the other holding a black hat with a white plume, against brown hills, trees and a dark, cloudy sky.

wikidata-Q60497141.title: Senecio (Baldgreis)
wikidata-Q60497141.caption: A round head fills most of the picture, divided into flat patches of pink, yellow, white and orange. Its two almond-shaped eyes have red disc pupils, with a white triangle above one and an arched green brow above the other, and a small purple mark sits at its centre; the head rests on a narrow neck of coloured squares against an orange ground.

wikidata-Q6057313.caption: Under a dark storm sky, flood water pours over rocks and falls through a wooded valley, carrying broken trees and an animal caught in branches; a rainbow arcs at lower left over figures lying on the rocks, and at right, on a path, an old woman crouches and an old man stoops over his stick beside two half-naked men, one in a red cloak pointing across the valley.

wikidata-Q6057319.title: The Finding of Moses
wikidata-Q6057319.caption: In a tall landscape, women at the edge of a river lift a baby from the water as a woman wearing a small crown approaches with her companions; a shepherd sleeps on a rock in the foreground near a goat, and beyond stand a palm and other tall trees, a tower, small falls with an arched bridge behind them, and a walled city at right.

wikidata-Q6057322.title: The Archangel Raphael and Tobias
wikidata-Q6057322.caption: In the open lower centre, a winged angel in a pale top and blue skirt walks beside a youth in orange who kneels over a large dark fish; tall trees rise at right, a round tower stands on a rocky bank at left, and a river runs toward distant hills under a golden sky with birds.

wikidata-Q6057325.caption: An imaginary harbour of Ostia opens between tall classical buildings towards a hazy sun low on the horizon, with a distant lighthouse, a round tower and tall-masted ships at anchor. Boatmen load rowing boats at the water's edge on the left, while on the stepped quay to the right a crowd gathers to see Saint Paula off, among them a veiled woman in a long brown cloak, children and a seated man holding out his hand.

wikidata-Q605863.caption: A young man with dark hair, in a dark suit with full sleeves over a white shirt, looks out at us as he turns the pages of a large leather-bound account book on a table spread with green cloth. Pink rose petals, folded letters, a gold ring and chain, and a pale blue fringed shawl with a small lizard on it lie across the table, with a wooden box and an inkwell behind. A window at the far left opens onto blue sky and distant hills.

wikidata-Q6065609.title: Strolling along the Seashore
wikidata-Q6065609.caption: Sorolla’s wife, Clotilde, and their daughter María walk along the beach at Valencia. The breeze lifts their white dresses and veil; long blue and mauve strokes turn the water and wet sand into a moving backdrop.

wikidata-Q6071513.caption: A white dove sends rays of light down from the top of the arched canvas, and small flames hover over the heads of the crowd below. The Virgin Mary sits at the centre in a blue mantle and deep red robe, hands joined in prayer and face turned upward, with a woman in a grey veil beside her and the apostles crowded round; at the upper left a man raises an open hand. In the foreground two apostles, one in green and dark red seen from behind, the other in blue and gold, throw out their arms and look up.

wikidata-Q607598.caption: The Virgin, in a dark blue mantle with a jewelled border, holds the Child on a tall throne topped with pinnacles and set on lions, inside a vaulted Gothic church. Five councillors in red robes lined with white kneel with joined hands, three at left and two at right, each group beside a standing saint holding a cross.

wikidata-Q6082483.caption: Clouds of white and grey steam rise beneath the dark iron trelliswork of the Pont de l'Europe, which cuts diagonally across the right side of the picture. Pale buildings of the rue de Rome stand behind, a locomotive waits at the far left, and a railwayman and a red signal disc on a post are small details among the tracks.

wikidata-Q609572.caption: A young Tahitian girl, Teha'amana, lies naked on her stomach on a bed spread with a white sheet, her face turned sideways towards us. Behind her at the left is a dark hooded figure in profile, the tupapaú, a spirit of the dead in Polynesian belief, and pale feathery shapes float on the purple wall. The bed's deep blue cover is patterned with yellow-orange flowers.

wikidata-Q609576.caption: Christ sits stripped to the waist, his wrists bound with rope and his head sinking to one side, as a soldier in armour lowers the crown of thorns onto him. A kneeling man in a white headband presses a reed against his bound arms, a man in blue clenches his fist at the left, and onlookers peer in through a barred window behind. A long-haired black-and-white dog looks up at the lower left.

wikidata-Q6106746.caption: Anne of Cleves faces us against a deep blue background, her ringed hands folded at her waist. She wears a red velvet gown banded with gold and pearls, a jewelled gold headdress over a sheer veil, and layered necklaces with a dark cross pendant.

wikidata-Q6106762.caption: Lady Cockburn sits beneath heavy red curtains with her three small sons clambering over her: one on her lap at the left points upward as she turns to him, another peers over her shoulder towards us, and the baby lies across her lap. A red-and-blue macaw perches on the base of a stone column at the right, against a blue sky.

wikidata-Q6106764.caption: Mary Tudor, Queen of England, sits in a red velvet chair fringed with gold, wearing a dark velvet gown over a silver-grey patterned skirt and a black hood edged with pearls. She holds a small red flower in her right hand and a pair of gloves in her ringed left hand, and a large jewel with a hanging pearl is pinned at her breast.

wikidata-Q611583.caption: Pax, the nude woman at the centre, presses her breast as a small child reaches up to her, while behind her the helmeted Minerva pushes back the armoured Mars, with what is probably a Fury beside him. A kneeling satyr holds out a horn of fruit towards a group of children, a leopard rolls on the ground, and at the left two women carry a tambourine and a gold vessel.

wikidata-Q6116827.caption: Mary nurses the infant Christ as Anne leans towards his head and Joseph supports his foot. Hands and glances draw the family closely together, while vivid pink, blue and yellow folds stand against an open, cloud-filled sky.

wikidata-Q6116829.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress and dark blue mantle, holds the Christ Child on her lap, his eyes closed, while her mother, Saint Anne, in a white veil and yellow cloak, draws a white cloth back from him at the left. Saint Joseph in green looks out from behind at the right, and the naked infant John the Baptist stands at the lower right with a finger at his lips beside a glass bowl of fruit. Grey and blue clouds fill the sky.

wikidata-Q6118296.caption: Saint Andrew, a gaunt old man with white hair and beard, is shown half-length and stripped to the waist against a dark background, a white cloth at his hips. One hand grips a large wooden cross at the right, and the other holds a fish by a cord on a table at the lower left.

wikidata-Q6118863.caption: Saint Ildefonsus stands in gold-brocade vestments, a white pallium marked with black crosses and a tall gold mitre, looking down at an open book. In his white-gloved right hand he holds a gold crozier hung with a green cloth, and grey-blue clouds fill the sky behind him.

wikidata-Q6119715.caption: Sebastian lies on his back on the ground at night, an arrow lodged in his side. A kneeling maid in a red dress holds up a torch and grips his wrist, while Saint Irene, in a dark robe with a red belt and red headscarf, stands looking down at him. Behind them one veiled woman joins her hands and another, in a turban, weeps into a white cloth; a steel helmet lies on the ground at right.

wikidata-Q6122115.caption: Saturn, an old man with long grey hair and beard, naked but for a dark cloth about his hips, stands on clouds and bites into the chest of a screaming infant held against his arm, blood running from the wound. With his other hand he grips a tall scythe whose curved blade shows at top left. Three stars shine in the dark sky above.

wikidata-Q613390.caption: Two young Parisian women in dark dresses and broad dark hats are shown close together. The one at left faces us, her fingers raised to her lips and a white ruff at her neck, while her companion, with a pale blue bow at her throat, turns her face towards her and rests one arm on a table. The table holds a glass and an orange, and blurred figures fill the background behind them.

wikidata-Q613928.caption: Marie-Anne Lavoisier, in a white dress with a ruffled lace collar and a pale blue sash, her powdered hair falling in long curls down her back, stands leaning on her husband's shoulder and looks out at us. Antoine Lavoisier, seated in black with a white lace jabot, keeps his quill on the paper and looks up at her. The red-draped table carries papers, an inkwell and glass scientific apparatus, and a large glass flask lies on the floor at right, before a grey marble wall with fluted pilasters.

wikidata-Q615851.caption: In an open timber stable under a thatched roof, the Virgin kneels in white before the Child, who lies on the bare ground in a burst of gold rays. Joseph, in red, holds a small candle. Two richly dressed women, one standing and one kneeling, are at right, three shepherds look in through an opening behind, an ox lies behind a slatted partition at left, and angels holding banners hover over the roof. Beyond, a road winds past bare trees toward a walled town beside open water.

wikidata-Q6163991.caption: A young man presents a detailed plan beside the panoramic view of Toledo. Above the city, a heavenly group hovers in the clouds; the map and the shifting painted streets offer two very different ways to look at the same place.

wikidata-Q617629.caption: Christ rises with his feet together above a tangle of soldiers, naked but for a white loincloth, a crimson cloak flying behind him and a diamond-shaped halo round his head. He raises one hand and holds a white banner on a long staff. Below, a bearded soldier at left lifts a sword and a round shield over his head, a man in blue at right stretches an arm and turns his face upward, and another sprawls head-down in yellow in the foreground.

wikidata-Q61996527.caption: Two lovers in deep blue robes embrace amid crumbling ruins, seated close together at the right: the young man puts one arm round the red-haired woman and rests his cheek on her head, while she reaches up to his neck and looks outward. A small stringed instrument lies across his lap. At left, thorny briars with pink wild roses climb in front of a stone doorway topped by a frieze of carved infants, and a broken block of stone lies on the ground.

wikidata-Q6255949.caption: John Ruskin stands on layered rocks in front of a rushing waterfall at Glenfinlas in Scotland, one foot set on a higher ledge. He wears a long black coat and holds a brown hat and a pale walking stick in one hand, looking off to the left. White water pours down on both sides of him, with dark foliage and mossy rock above.

wikidata-Q63088833.caption: Lady Howe stands full-length in a landscape in a pale pink silk dress, a sheer patterned apron over the skirt and deep lace ruffles at her elbows, under a wide straw hat trimmed with white ribbon. A choker of pearls circles her neck, and one hand rests on her hip, a black bracelet round its wrist. A slender tree rises at right against a heavy, cloudy sky, with a wooden fence behind her.

wikidata-Q6314660.caption: A beardless Jupiter, crowned with a fan of red-gold rays, sits enthroned at the centre of a towering, densely ornamented palace under a deep blue sky, holding a lyre at his side. The pale, naked Semele lies struck down against his knee, one arm flung out. Below the throne a dark eagle spreads its wings beside the goat-footed Pan, and at the bottom Hecate, winged and with a crescent moon above her head, appears among a crowd of shadowy figures.

wikidata-Q634122.caption: A flock of black crows flies over a yellow wheatfield under a dark blue sky broken by two small pale clouds. A red-brown path edged with green grass curves into the wheat at the centre and ends there, while other paths run off at the left and along the lower right.

wikidata-Q636001.caption: Wreathed revellers sprawl, drink and embrace on draped couches in a hall of tall fluted columns, with a pale woman in white reclining at the centre below a marble statue of a standing nude youth. More statues look down from the sides, and at far right a man in a fluttering red cloak clambers up one of them. A boy sits apart on a plinth at the left, and at the right two bearded men in red and blue robes look on.

wikidata-Q636537.caption: Marat lies dead in his bath, his head in a white cloth turban slumped to one side and a bleeding wound on his chest. One arm hangs over the sheet-draped edge to the floor, still holding a quill, with a bloodstained knife lying nearby; the other hand rests on a green-covered board, gripping a letter. A plain wooden block at right, with an inkwell and papers on top, is lettered À MARAT, DAVID, and the wall behind is dark and bare.

wikidata-Q6368790.caption: A long, dense file of pilgrims trudges out of the distance along a path at the foot of a dark wooded hill and a great reddish-brown rock. At right, a close-packed group in black and white shawls and hoods comes towards us, among them a man in black with a white collar and a chain who has been identified as an inquisitor. On the left, pale cloudy sky opens over a bare brown plain.

wikidata-Q63692.caption: The woman in yellow opens her palm beneath a coin offered by the man behind her, while the older woman watches closely. A patterned carpet fills the foreground, its reds and golds echoed in the clothing, glass and blue-and-white jug above.

wikidata-Q6382435.caption: A suspension bridge on a massive stone pier crosses the Seine from the left towards a sunlit riverside village, its dark iron cables and railings set against blue sky and white clouds. On the far bank, cream houses with grey roofs and shutters stand above a green slope, with small boats drawn up at the water's edge. Near the pier, a man in black stands in a green rowing boat with two seated passengers in straw hats.

wikidata-Q63871952.caption: A crowded banquet in the house of Simon the Pharisee spreads beneath tall Corinthian columns, with guests pressing round a white-covered table. At right a bearded man in red with a blue mantle sits turned towards a woman in a green shawl, while a fair-haired woman in blue and orange-gold kneels at his feet, holding one of his bare feet and resting her other hand on a small pot on the floor. Left of the table a man in a yellow mantle sits pointing downwards beside a white and brown dog, and a second dog noses out from under the table. Above, onlookers lean over a balcony and a green parrot perches on its ledge.

wikidata-Q6402081.caption: A nobleman with short dark hair and a pointed beard, dressed in black, looks straight out at us above a white lace ruff. His right hand, in a matching lace cuff, lies spread across his chest, and the gilded hilt of a sword shows at the lower right. Behind him the background is plain and greyish brown.

wikidata-Q6411359.caption: King Cophetua, in dark armour, sits on the steps below with his ornate red-and-gold crown held in his lap, gazing up at the beggar maid. She sits above him on a cushioned ledge in a plain grey dress, barefoot, with her hands resting at her sides and her eyes turned towards us. On a gallery above, two youths lean together over a scroll, and a red-shafted spear and a shield stand at the right.

wikidata-Q641666.caption: A woman bends over her letter while her maid waits by the window with folded arms. Behind them hangs the biblical Finding of Moses, a large, dark scene that sets off the writer’s bright sleeves and the light falling across the floor.

wikidata-Q642198.caption: The Archangel Gabriel, with red, green and gold wings, kneels in a sunlit street holding a white lily, beside Saint Emidius in a jewelled mitre, who balances a model of a towered, walled town. At right the Virgin kneels with crossed hands in a room crowded with household things, as a golden ray from a burst of light in the sky brings a dove down to her. Above her doorway a patterned carpet hangs over a balcony where a peacock perches, while people in the street and on a bridge beyond carry on regardless. An apple and a long green gourd lie on the ledge in front.

wikidata-Q644106.caption: The four Boit sisters occupy separate parts of their family’s Paris apartment, from the light foreground to the shadowed doorway. Large Japanese vases stand beside them, making the children’s different heights and distances unusually noticeable.

wikidata-Q6456889.caption: Joan of Arc stands in silver armour over a pink skirt patterned with gold roundels, a thin gold halo behind her head and her eyes raised. Her right hand grips the red staff of a white banner, and her left rests on an altar crowded with gold candlesticks, vessels and a crown. At left a tonsured monk reads a small book, a boy in green clasps his hands and an armoured man stands behind them, while a helmet lies at her feet on blue cloth strewn with yellow fleurs-de-lis. The dark hanging behind her is dotted with gold fleurs-de-lis.

wikidata-Q646337.caption: Gold sparks hang in the smoky darkness above barely defined spectators at Cremorne Gardens. Whistler lets the fireworks dissolve into streaks and flecks of paint, leaving just enough of the setting to suggest a crowded night outdoors.

wikidata-Q64689806.caption: A young kitchen maid in a white cap and an olive-green jacket leans over a table, one hand flat on the board and the other holding a white jug painted with grey-blue leaves. Around her stand a brass bowl, a white two-handled jar, a dark upturned jug, stacked dishes, a brass mortar and pestle and a garlic bulb, and a basket with a white cloth hangs on the wall. Through a small hatch at upper left, a haloed Christ sits at a table with his followers.

wikidata-Q647202.caption: Medusa's severed head lies on a stone ledge with its face turned upwards, the eyes wide and red-rimmed and the mouth open, its hair a tangle of writhing snakes. Small snakes wriggle out of the pool of blood at the neck, beside a crumpled white cloth. In the foreground a black-and-yellow salamander, two spiders and a scorpion crawl near a tightly coiled snake.

wikidata-Q6474124.caption: The courtesan Lais of Corinth, a young woman with a gold cap over her fair hair, is seen half-length in front of a green curtain behind a grey stone ledge, holding one hand out palm up over its edge. She wears a red bodice with white puffed slashes and full orange sleeves, and her other hand rests on a dark blue cloth. A small heap of gold coins lies on the ledge, which is inscribed LAIS CORINTHIACA 1526.

wikidata-Q64766792.caption: Cardinal Alessandro Farnese, dark-haired and bearded, looks straight at us in a red biretta and a buttoned red shoulder cape with a watered pattern, worn over white sleeves. Behind him is a plain dark brown background with a green curtain drawn back at the upper left, and he holds a pair of brown gloves in one hand.

wikidata-Q648068.caption: Mary, in a deep red cloak, sits before a wooden trellis thick with roses, where small birds perch against a gold ground. The naked Child on her lap has one arm round her neck. Above her head two angels with dark wings hold up a large gold crown. A carved gilt arched frame with small angel musicians surrounds the painting.
wikidata-Q648068.collection: Église des Dominicains, Colmar (property of the Collégiale Saint-Martin)

wikidata-Q650526.caption: A carriage crosses the pale road between green fields, while a train trails white steam along the distant horizon. In this view of Auvers, rows of crops become bands of violet and green that lead the eye back and forth across the canvas.

wikidata-Q65057453.caption: An old, long-bearded Jerome in a torn white robe sits under a towering reddish rock, one hand raised and the other resting on an open book on a ledge. A lion sits facing him with one front paw lifted. A tiny rabbit crouches at bottom left; behind, a horse grazes on a pale plain with a haystack and a wooden fence, below green hills.
wikidata-Q65057453.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness

wikidata-Q65146651.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress and blue mantle, sits beneath an apple tree holding the Christ Child, who stands on her lap, while Joseph rests his head on his hand in the shadows at the left. To the right a ring of winged children dances hand in hand, and two partridges fly across the sky above them. A blue-and-yellow parrot perches on a branch at the upper left, a sunflower rises behind Mary, and fruit lies on the ground at her feet.

wikidata-Q6553555.caption: God the Father, white-bearded and wearing a tall white mitre, holds the slumped body of Christ, who leans back against him on a white cloth spread over his lap, with wounds in his side, hands and feet. The dove of the Holy Spirit hovers above them in golden light. Winged angels in violet, green, blue and red robes crowd round on either side, and small winged cherub heads appear in the clouds at Christ's feet.

wikidata-Q655657.caption: The Virgin lies in a bed against white pillows, her hands folded on a blue cloak and her eyes turned upward. Apostles crowd around the bed: one in a white vestment takes hold of a candle that another holds out, while others pray, lean in or sit on the plank floor. Above, Christ appears with arms spread in a ring of light, flanked by two angels holding his red mantle.

wikidata-Q656434.caption: A young woman with brown hair parted in the centre and smoothed down over her ears looks out from behind a grey ledge against a black background. Her face is turned almost straight to us, her eyes slightly to one side. A thin cord with a small jewel crosses her forehead. She wears strands of dark beads and a red dress with an embroidered square neckline, its white-puffed sleeves tied with wide olive-gold ribbons.
wikidata-Q656434.title: Portrait of a Woman, wrongly called La Belle Ferronnière

wikidata-Q6609114.caption: Copernicus, in a fur-trimmed dark green robe, half-kneels on a wooden tower roof at night and gazes up at the stars, his right hand raised and a pair of dividers in his left. Beside him a board bears a chart of concentric orbits, with books, papers and a lantern on the boards nearby. The brick towers of Frombork cathedral rise beyond the balustrade at the left, and a long wooden instrument angles up into the sky at the right.

wikidata-Q6609268.caption: The jester Stańczyk sits alone in a dark room, slumped in a high-backed chair in a red costume and red jester's hood, his hands folded and his eyes cast down. A sealed letter lies on the cloth-covered table beside him, and his jester's staff lies on the floor. Through an opening at the right, richly dressed figures crowd a red-lit room where a ball is going on, while the window at the left shows a dark tower and a comet in the night sky.

wikidata-Q661378.caption: Dr Nicolaes Tulp, in a broad black hat and a black suit with a white lace collar, sits at the right and lifts the muscles of a corpse's dissected forearm with a pair of forceps, his other hand raised. Seven men in white ruffs crowd in from the left, two of them leaning close over the arm and one holding a sheet of paper. The pale body lies on a table across the foreground, with a large open book propped at its feet in the lower right corner.

wikidata-Q6622215.caption: A huge gold figure 5 fills the picture, with two smaller 5s nested inside it, over the red, boxy front of a fire engine reduced to flat shapes. Angled grey and black buildings and white globe lights crowd around it. The name BILL is lettered in red at the top, CARLO appears in small dots of light near the centre, and the initials C.D. and W.C.W. sit in red along the bottom edge.

wikidata-Q663133.caption: Two young men play cards at a table covered with a red patterned cloth. At left one in a dark red velvet doublet studies the cards in his hand, while an older man in a feathered hat peers over his shoulder and raises a gloved hand with two fingers spread. At right a youth in a yellow-and-black striped doublet, a dagger at his hip, looks across at the young man and holds cards hidden behind his back.

wikidata-Q6644913.caption: A woman stands with her bare back to us, a white cloth wrapped round her hips and a gold hoop in her ear, raising one hand to the bun of her dark hair. Her other hand rests on a green-covered table beside a small open box. In an oval mirror with a red frame on the grey-green wall, her reflection looks down, her face lit and her arm lifted to her head.

wikidata-Q665337.caption: A long column of soldiers on foot and on horseback, many in armour and carrying pikes, climbs a steep rocky mountain path under tall dark fir trees. Near the middle, small among the crowd, Saul lies on his back in blue beside a fallen horse while men bend over him. Riders in black and in yellow on pale horses fill the right foreground, and at left the land drops away to a distant plain and sea.
