wikidata-Q666982.caption: A peasant in a hood, brown jacket and grey hose strides towards us, a stick in one hand, pointing back with the other at a tree where a nest robber in red breeches clings to the trunk, his hat falling. At the peasant's feet the path ends at the edge of a stream. Behind him a sunny meadow stretches to thatched farm buildings and two brown horses.

wikidata-Q6675297.caption: Looking west along Yosemite Valley, the tall tower of Sentinel Rock rises on the left and the sheer wall of El Capitan stands on the right, with the pointed spire of Middle Cathedral Rock far off in golden haze between them. The Merced River winds across the flat, tree-dotted valley floor. A grassy slope with boulders and trees fills the foreground under a sky of streaked orange and grey cloud.

wikidata-Q669872.caption: A rider in a tall blue headdress and gold tunic sits on a pale horse in a dark forest, one hand raised towards a stag on the right that carries a crucifix between its antlers. Hounds gather round the horse, a greyhound chases a hare, and deer, birds and a bear are scattered through the woods. A blank scroll lies across the front.

wikidata-Q67158982.caption: Two figures sit close together in a shaded interior, with a pale cat curled in front of them. The nearer figure holds a cigarette; beyond the open doorway, a dark dog and distant people occupy a much brighter space.

wikidata-Q67158983.caption: In a Tahitian landscape, a bare-chested man in dark blue shorts stands at right with both hands raised together above his shoulder, near white smoke rising from a small fire on red ground. Two peafowl, one deep blue with a long green tail, walk across the foreground. Behind them two figures stand near a hut with a sloping roof, and a slender palm leans across hills of orange, yellow and pink.

wikidata-Q6728393.caption: Mary, in a deep blue mantle over a red dress, holds the naked Christ Child as he stands on a parapet. He holds her chin with one hand, and his other hand shows at her far shoulder, while she looks down and away. A green cloth hangs behind them, with blue sky, clouds and hills on either side. IOANNES BELLINVS is lettered on the parapet.
wikidata-Q6728393.title: The Virgin with the Standing Child Embracing his Mother (Madonna Willys)
wikidata-Q6728393.collection: Museu de Arte de São Paulo (MASP)

wikidata-Q6728425.caption: Mary wears a pale veil under a dark mantle traced with fine gold lines, and holds the Child on her arm beneath a round-topped arch. He tugs at the edge of her veil and looks up at her. Above the arch, three winged angels on each side lean over the frame.

wikidata-Q6728519.caption: Matisse's wife Amélie sits against a plain blue background in a red headscarf patterned with yellow, her dark hair showing beneath it. She wears a dark blue-green robe with rust-orange leaf shapes and white trim flecked with black, and rests her hands one over the other on a yellow upright. Her pale face, with pink cheeks and red lips, is turned slightly to our left.

wikidata-Q673112.title: Apollo and the Shepherd Daphnis
wikidata-Q673112.caption: A naked young man sits on a rock at left, playing a wooden pipe. At right Apollo stands naked, one hand on his hip and the other gripping a tall staff. Between them a lyre leans against a tree stump. Behind are slender trees, a river with an arched bridge, a towered town and blue hills, with birds flying overhead.

wikidata-Q674846.caption: Inside the Café de la Gare at Arles at night, a green billiard table with a cue lying on it stands in the middle of a yellow wooden floor, under red walls and a green ceiling. The owner, in a white suit, stands beside it, and hanging lamps glow with rings of yellow light. A few customers sit slumped at small tables along the walls, and at the back are a counter with bottles and a vase of pink flowers, a clock and an open doorway.

wikidata-Q677682.caption: Christ, haloed and wrapped in a red cloak, stands in the air above an open tomb. He raises one hand and holds a staff flying a white banner with a red cross. Two winged angels fly on either side, one in lilac, one in green. Below, four soldiers twist and gesture around the tomb, whose lid lies askew, and behind them three haloed women walk along a path through green hills.

wikidata-Q680128.caption: Christ, crowned with thorns and with his eyes closed, bows his head beside the diagonal beam of the cross. Grimacing, gaping faces press in on every side against a dark ground. At lower left a woman lowers her eyes above a cloth printed with his face.

wikidata-Q681876.caption: Jeanne-Marguerite Lecadre, the wife of Monet's cousin, stands at the left of a sunlit lawn in a long white dress, holding a white parasol and facing away into the garden. In the centre a tree covered in pale blossom rises from a round bed of red flowers, with a yellow-green shrub and a row of small standard trees in flower to the right. Dark trees fill the background beneath a blue sky, and long shadows stretch across the grass.

wikidata-Q682750.caption: Orange-gold cliffs of a quarry, dotted with green trees and topped with grey blocks of stone, fill the foreground. Behind them the pale blue-grey peak of Mont Sainte-Victoire rises into a blue sky, and a tall, thin tree climbs the right edge.

wikidata-Q683274.caption: Dancers and seated friends fill an outdoor gathering at the Moulin de la Galette. Patches of sunlight break across faces, dresses and dark jackets, linking the foreground tables to the crowd beneath the trees.

wikidata-Q68496636.caption: Christ, in a blue mantle over a red robe, stands at the centre of a packed crowd of men, his arms hanging at his sides. One man presses a red rod against his head, another reaches a hand over his halo, and others clutch at his arm. Their hose is red or blue, and two carry swords; two buildings with blue roofs rise against the gold ground.

wikidata-Q685916.caption: Three labourers struggle to raise a heavy wooden cross to which the old, white-bearded Peter is already nailed, his head lower than his feet. One hauls on a rope over his shoulder with his back to us, another grips the cross beside Peter's feet, and a third crouches underneath, bearing it up on his back while one hand reaches for a spade on the rocky ground. Peter, naked but for a white loincloth, lifts his head and shoulders from the beam.

wikidata-Q686107.caption: Christ falls beneath the cross near the centre of a crowded landscape. The much larger mourners at the lower right stand apart from the procession winding towards Calvary.

wikidata-Q687182.caption: The artist's mother sits in profile, facing left, in a long black dress and a white lace cap whose ends fall to her shoulders, her hands folded in her lap and her feet on a low footstool. Behind her a framed view of the Thames hangs on a plain grey wall, and at left a dark curtain patterned with small pale flowers falls to the floor.

wikidata-Q688870.caption: God the Father, crowned and in a gold cope over a blue robe, holds the crucified Christ in front of him, while angels spread a green cloak out to either side and a white dove hovers at the top. Crowds of saints fill the sky: women with palm fronds and crowns at left, men at right, one holding stone tablets and another a harp. Below, a pope, a cardinal, a crowned emperor and a man in gold armour stand out in a crowd floating on clouds above a landscape with water. In the bottom right corner a tiny Dürer stands beside a signed tablet.

wikidata-Q6888851.caption: A domed church and ancient ruins around the Roman Forum fade into a golden haze, with a pale moon in the misty sky left of centre. Two tall columns carrying a broken piece of entablature rise on the right. In the foreground women and children gather on a slope at left, and goats climb and graze across the rocky ground.

wikidata-Q689236.caption: A town square is packed with small figures dancing, begging, playing games and trading. In the foreground a fat man in red hose sits astride a barrel and points a spit carrying a roast at a gaunt figure in grey with a beehive on its head, who sits on a red wheeled cart and thrusts back a long paddle bearing two fish; the pair are the allegorical Carnival and Lent. A church stands at the right, with people in dark cloaks gathered near it.

wikidata-Q6903108.caption: A tall pine trunk rises at the left edge, and its long branches stretch across the top of the picture, curving with the outline of Mont Sainte-Victoire beyond. The mountain, in pale pinks and blues, stands above a broad valley of green and yellow fields with scattered houses, and a railway viaduct crosses the valley at right.

wikidata-Q6925696.caption: Trees with red trunks and leaves dashed in blue and green crowd the foreground above yellow-green grass, with lilac strokes marking a path. Behind them the mountains are laid in flat patches of orange, coral and bright blue, and cream and pink clouds swirl across a green-blue sky.

wikidata-Q693746.caption: A lone, bare-headed monk in a dark robe, seen from behind, is on a pale strip of shore before a nearly black sea. A few white gulls fly over the water, and above them the huge sky passes from grey mist low down to clear blue at the top.

wikidata-Q697332.caption: More than two hundred children swarm a broad town square, seen from above, playing dozens of different games among stone and brick houses. In the foreground two children bowl hoops, one sits astride a barrel and a boy rides a hobby horse, while beyond the buildings at upper left a stream winds through green fields.

wikidata-Q6980131.caption: The newborn Christ lies glowing in a manger in a dark stable, lighting the face of Mary, who bends over him with her fingertips joined. Five angels gather at the left, most with their hands joined or raised, and an ox and a donkey look on from the shadows. Joseph stands in the gloom at the far right, one hand raised to his chest. Through a gap in the back wall, shepherds by a fire on a hillside look up at a shining angel in the night sky.

wikidata-Q698015.caption: Mary, looking down, holds up a red carnation by its stem, and the child on a cushion beside her lifts both hands toward it. Behind them, arched windows between slim columns look out on jagged blue mountains. A vase of flowers stands at the lower right.

wikidata-Q698228.caption: A great red curtain hangs across the top of the canvas above the Virgin, who sits with the infant Jesus on her arm and gestures towards St Dominic at left. He holds out strings of rosary beads in both hands to a crowd of kneeling people, two of them barefoot, who reach up towards him. At right St Peter Martyr, with a bleeding wound on his head, looks out at us and points back towards the Child, and at the far left an older man in a white ruff peers out from under Dominic's black cloak.

wikidata-Q698254.caption: Drovers bring a herd of cattle down a hillside track between bare trees, one swinging a long stick behind a white cow with black patches, while a man on a pale horse and others carrying poles follow at right. Beyond them a wide river winds through a valley between craggy rocks, under heavy dark clouds.

wikidata-Q698487.caption: A man and a woman embrace on a patch of flowered meadow, wrapped in golden robes against a speckled gold ground. He bends to kiss her cheek, cupping her face in his hands, with green leaves in his dark hair; she kneels with her eyes closed, flowers in her hair and one hand laid on his. His robe is patterned with black, white and grey rectangles and hers with coloured circles, and only their heads, hands and her arms, shoulders and bare feet show as skin.

wikidata-Q698993.caption: Jacopo Strada, a bearded man in black with red satin sleeves, a white ruff and heavy gold chains, leans across a table holding a small nude statuette of Aphrodite while he looks off to our right. A grey fur wrap slips from his shoulder, a sword hilt shows at his side, and on the table lie coins, a folded letter and a marble torso. Two books rest on a cabinet behind him, and a framed inscription hangs on the wall at upper right.

wikidata-Q699319.caption: The young artist, with chin-length brown hair and a white frilled collar under a fur-trimmed dark coat, gazes out from a round panel as though seen in a curved mirror. His hand, a ring on one finger, swells to great size across the foreground, while the room behind him bends round, with a window at upper left and part of a gilt frame at the right edge.

wikidata-Q700251.caption: A woman reads beside an open window, her face faintly reflected in the glass. Behind her, the painting of Cupid uncovered during restoration changes the room’s balance; a green curtain partly screens it from view.

wikidata-Q700834.caption: Io, nude and seen from behind, sits on a white cloth draped over a bank and leans back with her head tipped up. A dark grey cloud, Jupiter in disguise, wraps a dim hand-like shape around her waist, and a faint face in the mist meets her lips. A large earthenware jar stands at right, and the antlers of a drinking deer show in the shadows at lower right.

wikidata-Q71254844.caption: Lucretia, bare to the waist against a dark background, tips her head back with her eyes turned upward and her lips parted, holding a dagger whose point rests at the side of her chest. Strings of pearls run through her auburn hair and pearl drops hang from her ears, a sheer veil and pale drapery slip from her arms, and her other hand is spread open at lower left.

wikidata-Q7200240.caption: Ludovic-Napoléon Lepic, bearded, in a top hat and grey coat with a cigar in his mouth and an umbrella under his arm, strides across the Place de la Concorde with his two small daughters in grey coats and black hats and a lean grey dog. At the far left a man in a top hat, perhaps the playwright Ludovic Halévy, is cut off by the edge of the canvas, while behind them a carriage and a rider cross the wide, empty square in front of a long stone wall.

wikidata-Q720602.caption: Painted almost entirely in pale and deep blues, the view looks across the Thames to the dark band of the Chelsea shore, where small pale lights glint and the tower of Chelsea Old Church rises at the right. A low, dark barge lies on the water at left, and in the foreground a lone fisherman in a hat stands at the water's edge, a long thin rod angled towards the barge. A small dark panel at the bottom centre holds a butterfly mark.

wikidata-Q7232280.caption: Empress Isabella of Portugal sits beside a window that opens onto a blue mountain landscape, a heavy red-and-gold patterned curtain hanging at the left. Her golden hair is braided up and threaded with pearls, and she wears a high white ruffled collar, a dark red velvet bodice edged with gold embroidery, and gold-brocade sleeves slashed to show white puffs, with pink silk beneath. A long string of pearls loops from a jewelled brooch at her breast, and her hand at the right holds a small open book on her lap.

wikidata-Q7232305.caption: The writer Pietro Aretino, with a long greying beard, is set against a dark background and turns his head to look off to the right. A wide red cloak with broad, sheen-streaked lapels fills almost the whole canvas, opening over an olive-green doublet and a heavy gold chain. A gloved hand shows near the bottom, just right of centre.

wikidata-Q7232350.caption: Van Gogh's mother is shown head and shoulders against a flat bright green background. She wears a high-collared dark dress with a thin white edge at the neck, and a dark headdress of large ribbon loops tinged with green. Her face, pale with green and pink strokes, is turned slightly to the right, and she looks out with a faint smile.

wikidata-Q727875.caption: A naked young woman with long golden-brown hair lies on white sheets and pillows over a red couch, looking straight at us and holding a small bunch of roses in her right hand. A small dog sleeps curled at the foot of the bed. Behind her, beyond a dark green curtain and screen, two maids are busy at a painted chest in a tiled room, one kneeling in white and one standing in red with a garment over her shoulder, while a potted plant stands on the window sill.

wikidata-Q728027.caption: Philip’s outstretched arms are bound to a beam as men haul on ropes to raise him. His pale body hangs against an open blue sky, while onlookers gather below, some absorbed in the execution and others turning away.

wikidata-Q729194.caption: A court jester, traditionally thought to be Sebastián de Morra but now identified by the Prado as the jester known as el Primo, sits on the floor against a plain brownish wall and stares straight out at us. His legs point towards us so that the pale soles of his shoes face the viewer, and his closed hands rest on his thighs. He has dark hair and a full beard, and wears a green doublet with white lace collar and cuffs under a red cape edged in gold.
wikidata-Q729194.title: The Buffoon El Primo

wikidata-Q732011.caption: A festival procession of barefoot young women and children in flower crowns comes down marble steps between pale stone buildings, carrying baskets and branches of blossom; a girl at the front right plays a pipe. Onlookers lean over the rooftops and balconies above, waving and dangling garlands of purple flowers. Under the central arch, figures watch from a box, with a gold standard on tall blue poles hung with purple garlands in front of them.

wikidata-Q732821.caption: A friar in a grey habit, at a green table, points a long stick at a figure drawn on a framed slate lettered EVCLIDES, his other hand on an open book. Behind him at right a young man with long red hair, in a fur-trimmed coat, looks out at us. A glass polyhedron, half full of water, hangs on a thread at upper left; a wooden many-sided solid sits on a red book at right, and a quill, inkwell and dividers lie on the table.

wikidata-Q734082.caption: Small white sails scatter across blue-green water as spectators watch from the beach at Sainte-Adresse. The curved shoreline carries the eye past seated figures and parasols towards the houses on the low rise beyond.

wikidata-Q735326.caption: Before a dark rock tomb, the fainting Virgin in a black mantle slumps sideways with Christ's pale body across her lap, while John, in blue and red, holds her up from behind. A kneeling woman in red over blue presses her cheek to Christ's face, another in a lilac dress and green cloak holds his feet, and a third, behind, covers her mouth with her green cloak. Haloed men stand at the sides: at left an old man bare to the waist holding a stone and a long-bearded man with a sword, at right a grey-bearded man in blue and yellow holding keys and a book.

wikidata-Q737062.caption: A naked young woman with reddish hair and a pink flower behind her ear reclines on white pillows and sheets, resting her left hand on her thigh and looking straight out at us. She wears a black ribbon tied round her neck, a gold bracelet and pearl earrings, with a flowered shawl spread beneath her. Behind her, a Black servant in a pink dress holds out a large bouquet wrapped in white paper, and at the foot of the bed a black cat stands with its tail raised.

wikidata-Q7401211.caption: The dead Saint Eulalia lies on her back on snowy paving, arms flung wide and long auburn hair spread round her head, with a red cloth over her lower body and her bare feet pointing away from us. Beside her at the right rises the base of a tall wooden cross bound with ropes, and grey and white pigeons gather on the snow around her as flakes fall. Behind, a helmeted soldier with a spear stands by the cross, a woman in white kneels, and a crowd of onlookers, children among them, watches from in front of a colonnade while a white dove flies above.

wikidata-Q7401482.caption: John the Baptist stands barefoot in front of a dark cliff, bearded and half-naked in a garment of animal skin, his right arm raised with a pointing finger. A thin staff topped by a cross leans against his left shoulder, and a white lamb lies curled up at the lower left. To the right, trees and a small waterfall lead back to blue hills under a cloudy blue sky.

wikidata-Q7448288.caption: Rembrandt faces us squarely with his hands on his hips, wearing a black beret and a loose brown robe tied at the waist with a sash, a dark collar and a strip of white shirt at his throat. Light falls on his lined face, which looks straight out from a plain dark brown background.

wikidata-Q745098.caption: An angel plays the violin from music held by Joseph, who watches from the left. On the other side of the angel’s white drapery, Mary rests her head against the sleeping child, dividing the scene between attentive listening and sleep.

wikidata-Q746716.caption: A youth with curly auburn hair, in a grey-and-white patterned doublet with full cream sleeves and blue breeches, kneels at the edge of still, dark water. He leans out on both hands to look down at his reflection, and the water mirrors his arms, sleeves and bent knee across the lower half of the canvas. All around is black shadow.

wikidata-Q747914.caption: The court jester identified as Juan Calabazas sits low in a dark greenish suit and cloak with a broad white lace collar and lace cuffs, his hands clasped over one raised knee. He grins with narrowed, squinting eyes. A gourd lies on its side on the floor at the left and another stands at the right, and a small glass of red liquid sits at the lower right, against a plain brown wall.

wikidata-Q7571529.caption: On the left, three girls gather beside a slender tree at the edge of pale, still water: one in a pink-red skirt stretches up into its branches, a small one stands nearby, and another kneels in a red headscarf to gather flowers from the grass. A larger leaning tree spreads its grey-green foliage across the right and top of the canvas, and soft hills fade into a misty sky on the far shore.

wikidata-Q766212.caption: Six nude men bathe from a rocky stone pier in still water edged by woods: one reclines at the left, one sits with an arm raised, one stands with his hands on his hips, and one dives head first at the right. In the water below, a red-haired man standing waist-deep reaches up towards the pier, a reddish-brown dog paddles nearby, and at the lower right Eakins himself swims towards the dog. Dark green trees fill the background, with a sunny meadow at the upper right.

wikidata-Q7727514.caption: Matisse stands in profile at the left in blue-and-white striped pyjamas, one hand in his pocket, facing his wife Amélie, who sits on the right in a black dress with a green collar on a blue chair. Between them, against a flat deep-blue wall, a window with a black curling iron railing opens onto a green garden with a tree trunk, round blue beds dotted with red flowers and a pink building beyond.

wikidata-Q7727872.caption: A maid in a white cap, white collar and blue skirt stands on a step at the right, holding a dish and the hand of a little girl in a yellow skirt who looks up at her. To the left, through a brick archway with an inscribed tablet above it and a red shutter beside it, a woman in a black jacket and red skirt stands with her back to us at the end of a passage. The sunny courtyard has a herringbone brick floor, a wooden bucket and a broom in the foreground.

wikidata-Q7728258.caption: Christ hangs dead on the cross under the INRI scroll, his grey-green body streaked with red blood from the nails and the wound in his side. Mary stands at the left in a pale pink head-cloth, grey mantle and purple robe with her hands clasped, and John stands at the right in a green robe and red cloak, gazing up at Christ with his hands folded. A skull and bones lie at the foot of the cross, under a dark sky with a few stars above a low horizon.

wikidata-Q7731855.caption: The Queen of Sheba, wearing a crown and a red dress, comes down the steps of a columned palace at the right with her attendants, while two men in the foreground carry a chest into a rowing boat. Ships lie at anchor in the harbour, one moored beside ruined columns at the left and another near a round tower and a bridge. The sun sits low over the sea left of centre, lighting the clouds and the rippling water.

wikidata-Q7733345.caption: The mother of the Persian king Darius, in a blue cloak lined with ermine, kneels with the women and children of the royal family before a group of soldiers at right. Among them Alexander stands in a deep rose costume with his arms spread, beside his friend Hephaestion in armour and an orange cloak. Behind the kneeling women rises a white marble arcade, with onlookers leaning over its balustrade and a monkey perched on a parapet at left.

wikidata-Q7735099.caption: A red fox, seen from behind, flounders through deep snow, one dark foreleg stretched out ahead of it. Above, two large black crows swoop down with wings spread, and more crows fly in low at right. Beyond the snowy rise lie dark rocks, a reddish-brown thicket and a green sea under a grey sky, with a sprig of red berries poking through the snow at left.

wikidata-Q7737113.caption: A long line of barefoot young women in pale silvery-grey robes, some with blue sashes and leafy wreaths in their hair, comes down a curving stone stair. They carry musical instruments, among them long trumpets, pipes, a violin and cymbals. White doves perch on a tiled roof at the top, against a patch of blue sky.

wikidata-Q7738501.caption: A shirtless Black man in pale trousers lies propped on the deck of a small dismasted boat that tilts in heavy blue-grey waves, his face turned to the right. Sharks, some with open jaws, swim close around the boat, and jointed green and yellow stalks spill from the hold and over the side. A waterspout rises from the sea at upper right, and a distant sailing ship shows on the horizon at upper left.

wikidata-Q7746028.caption: King Arthur lies asleep in dark armour on a bier under a gold canopy decorated with relief panels, dark curtains hanging behind him. His head rests in the lap of Morgan le Fay, seated in white at the left end, and at the other end a crowned woman in green rests her cheek on her hand. Women in robes of rose, green, red and white sit, kneel and stand around the bier and in the pavilion, which opens onto a flowering meadow.

wikidata-Q7747960.caption: A man in a red waistcoat, presumably the lock-keeper, strains at a crowbar with one knee raised against the post of a wooden lock gate on the River Stour. Beyond him a dark barge waits in the lock under a tall, leafy tree at right, a man in a white shirt holding its rope. At left a boy in a red cap, a dog and a horse wait by the far gate, and a church tower stands far off across flat green meadows under grey and white clouds and blue sky.

wikidata-Q7749405.caption: A woman draws a glowing circle around herself and a smoking cauldron, holding a crescent-shaped blade in her other hand. Her pale dress stands out against the earth and rock, while dark birds wait beyond the line.

wikidata-Q7754055.caption: A man is strangled at the left while another attacker twists his arm; a bound woman faces away in the foreground. Jagged limbs, tilted furniture and cramped space turn the room into a scene with no apparent escape.

wikidata-Q775407.caption: Behind green iron railings, between open green shutters, the painter Berthe Morisot sits in a white dress with a fan in her hand, leaning on the rail. The violinist Fanny Claus stands at right in white with a flower in her hair, pulling on a glove and holding a green parasol, and the painter Antoine Guillemet stands between them in a dark suit and blue tie. A boy, probably Manet's son Léon, is half lost in the dark room behind, and a hydrangea in a blue-and-white pot and a small dog with a ball sit at the foot of the balcony.

wikidata-Q7759351.caption: In a dark cave, Christ in a purple robe with a gold sash stands on the edge of a tomb with his right arm raised high. Below him at right, Lazarus, pale and wrapped in a white shroud and head cloth, lifts his head from the grave. At left, Mary Magdalene, lit, with her hands raised, and three old men, two of them in turbans, lean forward to watch, while a sword, a quiver and other belongings hang on the wall above the tomb.
wikidata-Q7759351.collection: Los Angeles County Museum of Art

wikidata-Q7761325.caption: A Shoshone encampment of tipis, horses and people spreads across a green meadow in the foreground, with tall trees at left. Beyond, a waterfall pours down between cliffs into a still lake, and snow-covered peaks of the Wind River Range rise into a pale blue sky.

wikidata-Q776175.caption: Under a tree in a golden field of grain, a group of harvesters sit eating from bowls, bread and a basket, while a man in a white shirt sleeps sprawled on his back beside them. At left two men cut the tall grain and another comes up a path through it carrying jugs, while figures bend to bind sheaves among the stooks at right. Beyond, the land falls away past farms, a church, a hay wagon and a pond to a wide bay with ships.

wikidata-Q7769644.caption: A bearded man dressed as a dervish, in a long red robe and a striped turban, bends forward to watch five tortoises crawling over a stone floor strewn with green leaves. A ney flute rests in his hands, clasped behind his back, and a small drum hangs between his shoulders. Behind him are walls of blue tiles and an arched niche with gold calligraphy, with a window at the left.

wikidata-Q782639.caption: A woman drinks from a wine glass while a man waits beside her with a jug. The patterned window, tiled floor and cloth-covered table give this small encounter an unusually spacious setting.

wikidata-Q783215.caption: A smiling youth with long curling hair leans out of a dark background, his bare shoulder turned towards us. His right arm crosses his body and the hand is raised, forefinger pointing upward; the fingers of his other hand show at his chest. Dark fur hangs at his side, and a thin cross is just visible in the shadows at upper right.

wikidata-Q783563.caption: The sick prince Antiochus lies back on a canopied bed under a dark green curtain, while the physician Erasistratus, wrapped in a grey mantle, keeps one hand on him and raises the other to his mouth, looking across the room. Another figure lies collapsed face down across the bed in red and orange drapery. At far left Stratonice, in a pale violet robe, stands apart with her head bowed, in a red-walled room of columns and painted decoration.

wikidata-Q7840471.caption: Gentlemen in powdered wigs and knee breeches fill a corner of the Tribuna in the Uffizi, its red walls hung frame to frame with paintings above shelves of busts and statues. Near the centre the Venus of Urbino, a painting of a reclining nude, is held up before a group of visitors, while at right others gather beneath a marble statue of Venus. At left a second group crowds round a painting of a woman and a small child, and more sculpture lies across the floor in front.

wikidata-Q7920622.caption: A nude Venus, wearing a pearl necklace and gold bracelets, reclines on a bed draped in dark red velvet and looks down at a small brown dog that paws up at her. At left an organist in a black doublet and golden sleeves keeps one hand on the keyboard but turns to look at her. Through a large window behind them, a garden with a fountain stretches back between rows of tall trees, and a red curtain hangs at upper right.

wikidata-Q794077.caption: Two fair-haired women sit at either end of a carved stone sarcophagus in a wide landscape. At left one wears a full pale satin gown with a red sleeve, gloves and a wreath of leaves, holding flowers in one hand and resting the other on a dark lidded jar. At right the other is nude but for a white cloth over her lap and a red cloak, and holds up a small dark vessel trailing smoke. Between them a winged child reaches into the water inside the sarcophagus, beside a shallow metal dish. A towered town rises at upper left; a village with a church spire stands by a lake at right.

wikidata-Q797902.caption: A young woman's head tilts toward the viewer's left, her eyes lowered and almost closed. The face is fully modelled in light and shade, while loose, wavy hair is sketched around it in quick dark strokes. Her neck and shoulders are only roughly indicated.

wikidata-Q798034.caption: A nude young man with long dark curls and a few leaves in his hair sits on a shadowy bank under dark trees, one leg crossed over the other and a spotted animal skin across his lap. Beyond, at left, a deer stands on a sunlit slope and a stag lies in the shade, before a stretch of water and pale blue mountains.

wikidata-Q8058274.caption: Caillebotte’s brother René stands bareheaded at an open window, looking across the balcony towards a sunlit Paris street. His dark suit frames the view, while a red armchair draws the eye back into the shaded room.

wikidata-Q8067460.caption: On the left the royal family, headed by King Sigismund, gathers with richly dressed courtiers beneath a red canopy, a white dog at their feet. wikidata-Q80869.caption: Griet, in a metal cap and breastplate over her skirt, strides to the left with a sword in her right hand and a sack, a basket and pans under her arm. Behind her a crowd of women in white headscarves beats down small devils and monsters, while more creatures crawl over the ground. Fires burn under a red sky across the ruined buildings and towers beyond.

wikidata-Q8187529.caption: Manet sits at his easel in light grey trousers, a brush held out to the canvas and a palette in his other hand, with Zacharie Astruc seated beside him in a blue-upholstered armchair. On a red-draped table at the left stand a white statuette of Minerva and a dark jar.

wikidata-Q822535.caption: Lorenzo offers Isabella a plate as the diners crowd around a brilliantly patterned table setting. Across from them, her brother kicks towards the dog resting its head in her lap, interrupting the lovers’ quiet exchange with a gesture of cruelty.

wikidata-Q822541.caption: A woman presents an order of release while supporting her sleeping child and her wounded husband. His face rests against her shoulder as the dog rises to greet him; the guard’s red coat and the child’s blue wrap punctuate the dark doorway.

wikidata-Q829572.caption: Camille, who would later become Monet's wife, stands with her back half-turned to us before a dark reddish-brown curtain, her face seen in profile and her eyes lowered. wikidata-Q835286.caption: Venus lifts a flower crown towards Mars as Cupid loosens his sandal below. Behind the reclining pair, three attendants handle his helmet, sword and shield, turning the god of war’s disarmament into an elaborate scene of leisure.

wikidata-Q838074.caption: A woman in a deep blue mantle stands in a garden holding a child, who presses his face to her cheek with one arm around her neck and a string of red beads in his other hand. At the left a tall metal fountain topped by a small lion spills thin streams into its basin, in front of a hedge of red roses and a low stone wall.

wikidata-Q956541.caption: General Wolfe lies dying on the battlefield in a red coat and breeches, held by officers in red uniforms while a man in a blue coat presses a white cloth to his body. wikidata-Q956738.caption: A pair of worn, dark leather work boots stands side by side on a bare greyish-brown floor, their laces undone and one long lace trailing loose at the right. wikidata-Q958245.caption: A young couple sit huddled together in an open boat as it leaves England, the bearded man in a brown greatcoat and hat, the woman wrapped in a grey shawl with a bonnet tied by a pink ribbon. wikidata-Q959537.caption: Apostles crowd around the Virgin's body on a draped bier, holding candles, a palm, a censer and a book. Behind them a wide window opens onto a lake crossed by a long covered bridge, and the pink and white chequered floor runs back towards it.

wikidata-Q959628.caption: Two figures float through a pale ochre sky, one hiding her face in a bright red cloak, the other pointing ahead towards a huge flat-topped rock crowned with buildings. Below them a crowd of riders and people on foot gathers on a ridge. In the dark foreground at lower right, two dark figures, apparently soldiers, point long guns towards the crowd.

wikidata-Q960157.caption: In a carpenter's workshop strewn with wood shavings, the red-haired boy Jesus in a white smock holds up a cut palm, while his mother Mary, kneeling in blue, turns her face up to his for a kiss. Joseph, bald and in a red shirt, leans over the workbench to look at the hand, and an old woman in an orange shawl rests her hand on a pair of pincers on the bench. At right the young John the Baptist carries in a bowl of water, at left a bare-chested young man leans on the bench, and through the open door sheep crowd a fold.

wikidata-Q960447.caption: A striped tiger crouches in tall jungle grass with its body pressed low, eyes wide and fangs showing, one front paw reaching forward. Wind bends the trees and leaves towards the right, fine silvery streaks of rain run over everything, and thin white lightning flickers across the grey sky at upper right. A bush of red leaves stands out on the right.

wikidata-Q965124.caption: A young man with an upturned moustache and a small pointed beard smiles out at us from under a broad black hat, his elbow thrust out and his left hand set on his hip. He wears a wide white lace collar, a black sash across his body and a dark jacket with slashed sleeves embroidered in gold and coloured thread. A Latin inscription at upper right gives his age as 26.

wikidata-Q965822.caption: The Virgin, in a dark blue mantle over a red dress, sits enthroned with the naked Christ Child standing on her knee, and lowers a hand towards Francesco II Gonzaga, who kneels at the left in dark armour with his hands joined. At the right the infant John the Baptist stands on the throne's base beside Saint Elizabeth, an old woman kneeling in a yellow turban. Overhead, a bower of leaves and fruit where birds perch holds a branch of red coral on strings of beads, and the base below shows Adam and Eve either side of a tree with a serpent wound round it.

wikidata-Q966681.caption: In a round picture, Mary sits sideways on a chair whose turned upright, banded and topped with gold, rises at the left. She wears a white turban striped with gold and a patterned green shawl over a red sleeve, and hugs the Christ Child, in a yellow tunic, close to her. Her cheek rests against his head as she looks out at us. At the right the young St John, a thin cross at his shoulder, joins his hands and looks up at them.

wikidata-Q96953521.caption: Seen from above, a nude woman with red-brown hair stands bent double in a wide, shallow round tub, one hand pressing a sponge against its floor. A white towel spills over the rim at the left, blue drapery hangs behind her, and the corner of a red upholstered seat stands on the patterned carpet at the left.

wikidata-Q97097631.caption: Death, a skull-headed figure with withered brown flesh, steps up behind a young nude woman and pulls her long red-gold hair, pointing downwards with his other hand. She weeps, hands clasped at her chest, with a transparent veil across her hips and a grey-green cloth behind her. They stand on stony ground against a dark background, and an inscription runs along the top.

wikidata-Q972295.caption: Leonidas, naked but for a plumed golden helmet, a sword belt, a red cloak and sandals, sits on a rock at the centre with a sword in one hand and a round shield and spear at his side, while his Spartans make ready around him in a rocky pass. At the upper left a warrior clings to the cliff to carve an inscription, young men raise flower wreaths beside a stone altar, and in the foreground one kneels to tie his sandal. At the upper right trumpeters on a height blow long horns as men reach up for weapons hung in the trees, and at the right of centre an old man embraces a young one. A temple stands among the rocks in the distance.

wikidata-Q974674.caption: Under a thatched roof built against a rocky cave, Mary kneels with her hands pressed together before the infant, who lies on a white cloth and reaches up towards her. At the bottom, angels and men embrace while small devils slip into cracks in the rocks. Three lines of Greek run across the top.
wikidata-Q974674.title: Mystic Nativity

wikidata-Q977777.caption: Proserpine, with masses of wavy dark auburn hair and a long blue-green silk robe, turns her head to one side and holds up a pomegranate, broken open to show its red seeds; her other hand grips her wrist. A panel of verse is set in the top right corner, and a scroll with the painter's name lies along the lower left.

wikidata-Q98113753.caption: The Lady of Shalott stands barefoot inside her round loom, in a bright green-and-blue bodice, a cream chemise and a pink silk skirt, with loose threads wound round her and her long dark hair flying up above her head. Behind her a large round mirror, cracked across, reflects an arched window with a river landscape and a knight riding past. Two birds flutter by a tall silver lamp at the right, her wooden pattens and blue irises lie on the patterned floor, and gilded reliefs line the walls, among them a haloed figure reaching for apples in a tree at the right.

wikidata-Q984058.caption: Women spin and wind wool in a dim workshop: at the left an older woman in a white headscarf works a spinning wheel while a young woman leans in beside a red curtain, and at the right a young woman in a white blouse and dark blue skirt, her back to us, winds yarn from a reel. Between them a woman in an orange skirt sits low on the floor, and a cat lies among the scraps of wool. Through an opening behind, on a brighter raised floor, the helmeted goddess Pallas confronts Arachne in front of a tapestry with small winged figures flying in its sky.

wikidata-Q9850868.caption: A young man with tousled dark hair and a red-and-gold cap, dressed as a jester in a costume of red and black stripes with a small white ruff, plays a lute and glances up to the right with a closed-lipped smile. wikidata-Q99569815.caption: A young man with shoulder-length auburn hair, in a dark buttoned tunic with a high collar, looks straight at us in front of a grey-framed window that opens onto pale blue sky. Resting on the ledge, he holds in both hands a round frame set with a much older gold-ground painting of a bearded, haloed saint, a fragment from fourteenth-century Siena.

wikidata-Q999836.caption: Sailing boats lie moored in a shallow harbour at dusk under a streaked violet sky, with a thin crescent moon low among the clouds above the sea. In the foreground a dark rowing boat, lettered on its side, rests on the water's edge, and at the right a wooden hut, nets and poles with small flags stand on the shore. Further out, a few sails move across the open water.
